Finish a match, alt-tab — it's already analyzed: head-to-head build order timelines, opponent profiles with alias history and private notes, win rates by map and division, leaderboard, meta tier list, tournaments. apps.name: Brilliante Photo Viewer

apps.name: Eternal Solitude Demo
apps.short_description: ETERNAL SOLITUDE is a new turn-based 4X fantasy game, set in the World of Eternal Solitude combining deep racial society development, empire and city building, tactical  combat, spells, espionage with far-reaching consequences of every decision. Become the true magic overlord, or die as a slave!

apps.name: Eternal Swordsmith Demo
apps.short_description: Become an undying elven smith in a shop simulation about the lives behind your blades. Reopen the workshop, forge your first magic sword, decide whom to trust with it, then watch time pass and learn whether its owner becomes a hero or falls to the blade. Play the free prologue of Eternal Swordsmith.

apps.name: Eyes Wide Open Demo
apps.short_description: For two days, Work for a dystopian Inspection Bureau, Determine whether the subjects are humans or not, Uncover secrets, Endure psychological horrors and reach your work quota - or else.

apps.name: Fab.exe Demo
apps.short_description: Build a semiconductor fab, route FOUPs and improve yield and delivery. This free demo includes five story missions and Endless Fab with no time limit within N28/N16. Expand your Phases, choose your start and rival pressure, and save your progress.

apps.name: False Fortune Demo
apps.short_description: Play the opening of False Fortune, a narrative crime RPG about rebuilding a ruined life. Explore Fiorenza and Riviera locations, investigate financial evidence, use dialogue and leverage, manage relationships and reputation, and decide whether Adrian pursues proof, power, or revenge.

apps.name: Fate Candle: Three Kingdoms - Chronicle Restored Demo
apps.short_description: Armies are easy to raise. A true general is hard to recognize. After the fire at Red Cliffs, heroes scatter under aliases. Rise from one city, judge them by deeds, and restore their names. Govern, forge bonds, grow your faction, and win ten-slot battles to end the chaos before the world collapses.

apps.name: Feed The Forest Demo
apps.short_description: A short, innocent incremental forest-builder. Unlock snail powers to spread life in a barren desert. Feed the mysterious Forest with juice. And remember: Blood is a type of juice.

apps.name: FINAL FANTASY XVI DEMO
apps.short_description: Play the opening section of FINAL FANTASY XVI. Save data can be carried over to the full version of the game.

apps.name: Firewheels Tidy Up Sort Together Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo: sort the Rescue & Future, Track & Moto and Torque 64 Collector departments of a messy diecast toy car shop, solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Try the first skills, 4 characters and 3 songs before the full game.

apps.name: Five Hearts Under One Roof Demo
apps.short_description: Yuman’s, the player, once solitary home and routine are now invaded by five beautiful women! Each has her unique charm – the 'childhood friend of 20 years,' the 'first love and former idol,' the 'demanding boss,' the 'bold younger girl,' and the 'shy recluse.' Who will you choose?

apps.name: Flesh Made Fear Demo
apps.short_description: Tank controls. Fixed cameras. Pure Terror. Set in a haunting world of twisted experiments and occult nightmares, this game brings back the survival horror mechanics you know and love while pushing the genre into terrifying new depths.

apps.name: Flesh Mill Demo
apps.short_description: ENTER THE CAMP. FEED THE MACHINE. BECOME SOMETHING WORSE. Flesh Mill is an incremental horror RPG where prisoners are nothing but fuel for your ascent. Grow stronger, unlock grotesque upgrades, and face increasingly horrific bosses in brutal turn-based combat.

apps.name: Forgefall Demo
apps.short_description: Forgefall is an active incremental game where your lantern cuts through a scrolling forest. Break trees, rocks, goblins, and chests, aim the resources they drop, build processors, and buy permanent upgrades that make each run more productive.

apps.name: Forklift Logistics Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: This demo includes a short tutorial and four increasingly challenging warehouse missions. Learn to handle the forklift as you move cargo and load trucks. Put your precision and balance to the test.

apps.name: Fractal Space | Demo
apps.short_description: Live the memorable experience of a first-person, story-driven adventure and puzzle game! Avoid traps, use your Jetpack and Taser-Gun to think your way through Zero-Gravity puzzles of this mysterious space station.

apps.name: Froggin' Around Demo
apps.short_description: Froggin Around is a two player local co-op game where you play as two mischievous frogs on a magical quest! Use your stretchy, bouncy tongues to swing, grab objects, and help each other hop through puzzles and chaotic challenges in this light-hearted, physics-based co-op adventure!

apps.name: FROGGY HATES SNOW Demo
apps.short_description: Play the demo for Froggy Hates Snow - A survival roguelike where a frog digs through freezing snow, uncovers treasures, unlocks upgrades, and battles mystical creatures. Find the escape door — or defeat the final boss to survive.

apps.name: Frontier Control : Invasion Demo
apps.short_description: Frontier Control: Invasion is a Real-Time Strategy survival game in which you play the commander of a human space colony under the attack of outer space robots. Build your base, train your colony, and fight herds of enemies and bosses.

apps.name: Frutiger Home Demo
apps.short_description: Decorate your dream frutiger home in this cozy co-op frutiger aero house decorating game. Pick a home layout, add from a wide range of frutiger-themed decor and hang out with your friends!

apps.name: GG Land Demo
apps.short_description: A game where building is fun and easy. Featuring a challenge mode to truly test your skills in building! Once you are done, you can share your creation with your friends and see if they can beat your time!

apps.name: Gloamfall Demo
apps.short_description: Play the first two acts of Gloamfall, a pixel-art dark-fantasy roguelike with twin-stick combat and action-RPG loot. Three heroes, four biomes and four lords to topple, with a new arsenal every run.

apps.name: Global Protocol: New World Order Demo
apps.short_description: Command any of 261 real-world countries in this 2026 grand strategy game. Build your economy, lead armies, and navigate deep diplomacy. Features built-in modding support and 12 supported languages. Shape the global order through espionage, nuclear deterrence, and AI-driven geopolitics.

apps.name: Global Rescue Demo
apps.short_description:
Build your own base in Global Rescue and take command of firefighting, police, EMS, and SWAT operations — either in your hometown or any city around the world!
Manage your fleet, hire staff, and take on a variety of authentic operations. Are you ready for your shift?

apps.name: Go! Super Awesome Monkey! Demo
apps.short_description: Play as SAM in Go! Super Awesome Monkey and save the world from AI Tech Overlords in this cute 3D Platformer!  Collect pizza slices, coins, & floppy discs by spinning, dashing, and slamming (and more!) in a variety of levels. Play at your own pace: explore or speedrun to rise up the leaderboards!

apps.name: Grid Demon Demo
apps.short_description: Turn a cyberpunk machine swarm against itself in a fast top-down bullet-heaven roguelite. Hack enemies into temporary allies, install run-changing Neural Patches, unleash your Grid Demon Mode and break the Wardens guarding each deeper grid.

apps.name: Grimlane Demo
apps.short_description: Grimlane is a tower defense game with cards. Build and upgrade towers, fight waves of monsters, and develop your economy. Use cards from your deck to construct buildings, activate abilities, and strengthen your defense.

apps.name: Grog & Grudges Demo
apps.short_description: Run a pirate tavern in this hectic but cozy time management game where everything you do is a minigame. Pour grog, grill your catch, fire kegs out to ships and throw out rowdy drunks.

apps.name: Hakurokuゲームコレクション Demo
apps.short_description:
Hakuroku’s board games are now playable digitally!

In the demo version, you can play one of the three titles in solo mode, in Japanese only.
Please note that some parts of the screen are still in beta and may differ from the final version.

apps.name: Handful of Dice Demo
apps.short_description: Try the tactile digital dice tray for tabletop gamers. Pick up and throw physics-driven dice, watch them settle, then read the results. Try custom dice in the Workshop. Saving custom dice pouches is part of the full game.

apps.name: Heartreave Demo
apps.short_description: The Heartreave demo: a turn-based hack-and-slash where every fight is played with cards. Assemble a party, solo or in online co-op, and craft unique builds by combining cards, passives, talents, relics, creature hearts and island hearts to find the best synergies.

apps.name: Horde of Distraction Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental game inspired by classic RPGs. Fight monsters, collect rare gear, progress through a vast skill tree, and defeat powerful bosses!

apps.name: Industrial Luck Defense Demo
apps.short_description: Try equipment procurement, merging, placement, and a fictional investment market in this free solo demo. Play EASY or NORMAL and decide whether to chase a market gain or turn your cash into more rigs.

apps.name: Infinitum: The Backrooms Story Demo
apps.short_description: INFINITUM is a horror open-world survival co-op story game for up to 4 players. Explore endless procedurally generated levels and uncover multiple endings, with every playthrough offering a unique experience. Play the demo version which has some limitations during the Steam Next Fest!

apps.name: Into the Restless Ruins Demo
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you create the dungeon you fight through. Each night use your cards to expand the ruins then battle through them, harvesting Glimour from the lost souls and improving your deck. Can you reach The Warden and defeat it, so that The Maiden will grant your heart’s desire?

apps.name: Journey Through the Undead Demo
apps.short_description: Blast through hordes of zombies in a stunning, mutated world. Use guns, melee, and grenades to survive eerie ruins and deadly swamps. Includes the first 3 missions of the full game.

apps.name: Junk Rush Demo
apps.short_description: You’re a degenerate gambler with 28 days to pay your vig to the mob with your hotdog stand! Embark on a chaotic adventure with your mocking AI and schizophrenic Goblin. Explore the island, find bizarre ingredients, create insane hotdogs, break rules, cause chaos and do whatever it takes to survive!

apps.name: Just in Crime Demo
apps.short_description: Just in Crime is a detective video game in which you play a detective dog and a wizard cat. With a twist; you are able to travel back in time and examine the crime scene a few seconds before it happened.

apps.name: Keplerian Space Discovery Demo
apps.short_description: Travel through the solar system in your own spaceship! The motion of each celestial body is accurately reproduced by the Kepler equation.

apps.name: King’s Escape Demo
apps.short_description: The old war game of the North, brought to life. Lead the king's last guard to freedom, or close the ring and take his crown, across seven historic rule sets of Tafl. Battle a cunning computer, a friend at your PC, or anyone online.

apps.name: Klostyn Demo
apps.short_description:
Klostyn is a sci-fi shooter that stays true to the late-'90s FPS style.
The protagonist fights alien creatures and space pirates on a distant planet.

apps.name: Konekomi Castle Demo
apps.short_description: Fifty years in the future, Japan is shaken by reports of a one-eyed alien. Chasing the story north, indie journalist Pandora gets caught in a snowstorm and seeks shelter in Konekomi Castle.

apps.name: KRIS: The Last Good Summer Demo
Kusan : City of Wolves Demo
apps.short_description: Kusan: City of Wolves is a high-octane hardcore top-down shooter set in a brutal urban jungle ruled by gunfire and corruption. Play the demo and wishlist today.

apps.name: Lelu Demo
apps.short_description: Get your gears in motion for a captivating monochromatic adventure where you play as Lelu, a small but determined clockwork toy who has gained consciousness and found a taste for freedom!

apps.name: Librarian Together: Manga Tidy Up Demo
Liminal City: Axiom of Maria - Chapter One Demo
Littlest Catalyst: Swarm Defense Demo
apps.short_description: Command a crew of tiny bots, build a modular space base, and repel relentless alien swarms. Build, upgrade, defend, and don't forget to pet the crew members.

apps.name: Logosmancer Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of Logosmancer. Cast every spell with your voice: say FIREBALL, FREEZE, FLY, TRANSFORM or FART. Play King of the Hill online with friends and the full co-op Sandbox mode on Sands of Kheperu, and level your wizard up to 10.

apps.name: Lone Lines: RPG Demo
apps.short_description: Control a living warrior on wheels in a procedural off-road RPG: fight, choose, uncover the hidden, and survive in the beautiful yet brutal Dead World.

apps.name: Looks Fine on Paper Demo
apps.short_description: Looks Fine on Paper is a spatial logic puzzle game. Deduce each room's shape and position from area requirements and clues. Resolve interconnected constraints involving rooms, doors, windows, and furniture. Every decision can affect the entire layout. Can you satisfy every condition at once?

apps.name: Loot Frog Demo
apps.short_description: Loot Frog is an incremental action bullet hell about breaking pots, collecting gems, and fighting an evil cult. Upgrade your gear, unlock new abilities, explore diverse biomes, and push deeper into increasingly chaotic battles.

apps.name: Lost Traces: False Awakening
apps.short_description: LOST TRACES: FALSE AWAKENING [DEMO] is a FIRST-PERSON PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR demo. Experience Evelyn Strom’s descent into a cyclical nightmare, where the secret of GENESIS has awakened her terrifying PSYCHIC powers. The prelude to the Lost Traces Saga.

apps.name: Lurks Beneath Demo
apps.short_description: Investigate a little girl's disappearance at a rundown trailer park. Play as Detective Partridge and cross examine three suspects to find the truth with fully freeform interrogation. Type anything and ask anything you want.

apps.name: Magic Academy Demo
apps.short_description: Play as the Headmaster of a magic academy in this adult visual novel with card-based RPG adventures. Restore your ruined estate, recruit witches as teachers, and shape their fates. Explore procedurally generated maps, battle monsters, and unlock animated NSFW scenes.

apps.name: Mary-san Demo
apps.short_description:
She's back.
Become a cute French doll and explore alleyways and houses. Recover your lost body parts to unlock new paths. An action-adventure game where you must recover every missing piece of your body.

apps.name: Match & Ruin Demo
apps.short_description: Plan the flow of cards across three mercenaries' hands in a roguelike card battler. Match ranks or suits to set up the next attack, defense, or skill. Reshape the shared deck and combine relics to fight through fallen kingdoms.

apps.name: MedCom Origin Demo
apps.short_description:
MedCom Origin is a story about russian city in which the pathogen outbreak occurred. PMCs shoot people right on the streets of the city, parks and squares are turned into warehouses for corpses
Welcome to the city, welcome to the hell.

apps.name: MEGANAUT Demo
apps.short_description:
A 3rd person narrative horror game with modernized retro 3D graphics, and unique floating mechanics.
Travel past The Habitat walls into the deep megastructure in search of your missing friend Seija, and find out why he left.

apps.name: MINN ~Min inn~ Demo
apps.short_description: An otome game that isn't quite otome — or simply, a visual novel. A modern gothic story of dreams, writing, and death. Multi-POV. You are the protagonist—a sleepwalker, a writer, and one bound by a promise to the dead. Please be sure to read the content guide and notes.

apps.name: MMOS: MMO Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Run your own fantasy MMO in a single-player management sim. The demo is the full sandbox, no time limit: design the world, classes, pets, loot, dungeons and raids, then watch simulated adventurers play, guild up and chase rare drops. Full game adds scenarios, expansions, cash shop and more.

apps.name: Monster Chef Demo
apps.short_description: FIGHT! COOK! SERVE! Get a first taste of Monster Chef in this action RPG demo with roguelite and simulation elements. As Pranzo, a tiny chef-warrior, cook monsters on the battlefield, explore Delizia’s first biome, rebuild your inn, and begin your rise through the ancient Monster Chef Order.

apps.name: MonsTile Demo
apps.short_description: A groundbreaking roguelike deck-building defense game on an 8x8 board! Strategically place monsters and trigger synergies to fend off adventurers. Having fled across dimensions from an unbeatable hero, you arrive in worlds of fantasy, apocalypse, wuxia, and cyberpunk to battle their heroes.

apps.name: Moonlit Journey:  Homestead Demo
apps.short_description: Purchase your homestead, master unique skills, and uncover hidden secrets in a cozy top-down farming RPG where the world transforms through all four seasons.

apps.name: Mummy's Escape Demo
apps.short_description: Play the early levels of this puzzle-adventure. Explore ancient crypts, solve challenging 3D puzzles, and outsmart the tomb's security. A small taste of the challenges waiting for you in the full release.

apps.name: MusicManiaz Demo
apps.short_description:
Play the drums in a rhythm game anyone can pick up, packed with lo-fi. (Over 20 lo-fi songs alone!)
50+ original tracks across all kinds of genres! Besides drums, play Melody and All Mix at three difficulties!
Add your own favorite songs, auto-generate the chart, and play as much as you want!

apps.name: My Name Is Vincent Pogo Demo
apps.short_description:
Welcome Pogo Pals - It is Time!!!

In My Name Is Vincent Pogo Demo, you’ll have the chance to explore an early portion of the game! Check out the store page for more information about what the game is about!

Remember, It's not so hard!

apps.name: My Staff Are Dead! Paranormal Tycoon Demo
My Summer (InsanErotica) Demo
apps.short_description: In My Summer, you can have a happy ending (Nice Guy Ending or Bad Guy Ending), a neutral ending (Open Relationship Ending) or a sad ending (NTR Ending) depending on how you play.

apps.name: Necrocyte Demo
apps.short_description: NECROCYTE is a first-person open-world zombie survival game. Explore an unpredictable wasteland filled with dynamic wildlife and mutated enemies. Scavenge randomized loot, build your shelter, master diverse weapons, and unlock extraordinary cybernetic abilities.

apps.name: Night of Vargold Demo
apps.short_description: Hunt wolves that devour the night in a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder where cards become buildings. Enemies attack both you and the board. Read their attack zones, place your buildings, and turn even their destruction into part of your strategy.

apps.name: Ninpō! ~Shinobi Journey~ Demo
apps.short_description:
“ Ninpō! ~Shinobi Journey~ ” is a 3D action-adventure RPG.
A horde of succubi from another world has invaded, throwing the human realm into chaos…!
Join the seductive ninja Sana on her thrilling journey across a Japanese-style world ♥

apps.name: No Away From Keyboard Demo
apps.short_description: An online desktop idle game where every keystroke earns Score. Discover hidden costumes by typing secret words, team up with friends for bonus rewards, avoid going AFK, and climb the global leaderboard.

apps.name: NOT Home Free Demo
apps.short_description: A 4-player online co-op game set in a uniquely crafted liminal world. Pay your bills, fortify your home, and try to survive the uninvited “guests” waiting for you after dark.

apps.name: Oath of the Necromancer Demo
apps.short_description: Raise the bones of the fallen and create an army of the undead - warriors, archers, mages, monsters & beasts. Take revenge on the old tyrant, build a sanctuary, and resurrect ancient heroes to aid in your battle. All in the name of the Greek-Egyptian God of life & death: Serapis.

apps.name: Oboro no Ichi Demo
apps.short_description: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

apps.name: Oh Apollo! Demo
apps.short_description: Fulfill your role as the priestess of Apollo's oracle in Delphi and bring the temple back to glory in this cozy narrative management game!

apps.name: Olaf the Boozer Demo
apps.short_description: Olaf wakes up with a legendary hangover and a missing royal crown. Retrace your drunken rampage across the kingdom to save your head! In this comedic puzzle adventure, fixing the mess creates the maze: every object you repair becomes an obstacle blocking your path.

apps.name: Once a Porn a Time 2 Demo
Our Life: Now & Forever Demo
apps.short_description: A paper airplane, two new neighbors, four autumns, and a one of a kind life. Create an experience that’s all your own in this near-fully customizable, choice-heavy story where you grow from childhood to adulthood.

apps.name: Paid Parking Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Old Gus has retired and left you his run-down two-space parking lot. Take tickets, collect every fare, keep the place spotless and deal with the town's worst drivers as you grow it, space by space, into a 135-space complex in this first-person management sim.

apps.name: Parasomnia: No REM Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror demo where you experience a distorted memory from the protagonist’s past through an episode of sleepwalking. Explore the No REM state, suspended between dreaming and wakefulness, and close your eyes to reveal clues hidden from the waking world.

apps.name: PECADO Demo
apps.short_description: PECADO is a first-person folkloric horror experience set in the “España profunda”. Listen to the word of God.

apps.name: Phobopetra Demo
apps.short_description: A Soul, A Story, A Stone. 1962 Antarctica. An expedition unearths a stone that shatters reality. Trapped in a shifting 1960s estate, you must use its unnatural light to reveal hidden secrets. Time is bleeding away in this cinematic mystery. Can you escape before the heartbeat stops?

apps.name: Pirate Twist Demo
apps.short_description: A top-down naval roguelite where steering is aiming. The free demo sails the First Sea with Captain Rourke: arm a rebuilt sloop at Port, pick your lane across a chart reshuffled every run, and duel a boss captain. Buy on this computer and your captain keeps every level.

apps.name: Pizzeria: The Pizza Restaurant Sim Demo
apps.short_description: Build your own pizzeria from scratch! Roll the dough, slice the toppings, cook your sauce in a pot, bake the pizza in the oven and serve your customers. Tweak your recipes, furnish your restaurant, manage your money and become the neighborhood's favorite pizzeria.

apps.name: Plague Inc: The Board Game: The Video Game Demo
Please Fix! Demo
apps.short_description: You are the entire IT department. Grab the right tool, race to the right desk and fix it yourself, before your coworkers' patience runs out and someone throws their monitor. A funny time-management game about one very long week at the office. Bring the emotional support duck.

apps.name: Porn and Cards Demo
apps.short_description: Once a Porn a Time: Porn and Cards is a wild NSFW space-western adventure where sexy aliens, deck-building strategy, and fully animated sex scenes collide in a story full of chaos, comedy, and seduction.

apps.name: Potato Factory Demo
apps.short_description: Run your own potato chip factory, from peeling by hand to full automation! Make chips, build production lines, and grow your business with robot helpers. Wait… are these chips headed for space?

apps.name: Project P.I.T.T. Demo
apps.short_description: Feed rubber ducks to a corporate void. Build physics contraptions. Chain combos for profit as the Maw grows hungrier... and larger. Brutalist PSX satire meets first-person sandbox chaos.

apps.name: protocolNullDemo
apps.short_description:
In EAcity, the DICE gang rebelled against large corporations, causing a series of clashes between the two groups.
The city turned into chaos. Aims to end this conflict. Two gang members, K-12 and Z4, were kidnapped and forced to sabotage DICE headquarters.

apps.name: Prowl Demo
apps.short_description: Prowl is a fast, turn-based roguelite where combat plays out through patterns. Pick an animal. Modify its attacks and movement, manipulate the board, and outplay overwhelming odds one tile at a time.

apps.name: Pulse Drive Demo
apps.short_description: In PULSE DRIVE, you tap inputs to the beat to drive faster! It's an arcade Rhythm Racing game featuring a music-powered hover vehicle.

apps.name: Pumpkin Reaper Demo
apps.short_description: Pumpkin Reaper is a Halloween action roguelike with 1,069 skill synergies to discover. Arrange spells, summons, and upgrades in a five-slot Ritual Circle to awaken powerful Arcana. Fight endless waves, test wild combinations, and push each run further. No permanent power upgrades.

apps.name: Rahasya Demo
apps.short_description: Enter a cursed ancestral haveli and uncover the truth behind a forgotten bloodline while surviving a reactive entity that watches, listens, learns your habits, and adapts to how you survive. Explore hidden rooms, solve ritual-based puzzles, and survive

apps.name: Railminer Demo
apps.short_description: Drill, collect, upgrade! Try the beginning of Railminer: mine stone and ore, sell your haul and improve your mining train. Discover the first upgrades in this free, time-limited single-player demo.

apps.name: Re:Blade Demo
apps.short_description: A playable demo showcasing the core combat and progression of Re:Blade.

apps.name: Realindustry Demo
apps.short_description: Experience the first 5 tech tiers of a hyper-realistic industrial simulation. Master 102 real materials and 152 accurate recipes using actual chemistry. Your factory grows. Your efficiency improves. Someone notices. Welcome to the Realindustry Demo, Director.

apps.name: RECOLLECTION Demo
apps.short_description: A man's only lasting memory is the one place he never really left. The Dream Valley Hotel. Explore whatever is remembered of it, and try to piece together what exactly is going on.

apps.name: RED RESET Demo
apps.short_description: RED RESET a thrilling fast-paced combat, story-driven adventure where you come across memorable characters in a world where not everything is as it seems. Experience a history filled with secrets only the keen-eyed will unveil.

apps.name: Reel Risk Demo
apps.short_description: It's your typical fishing game with a slight catch. Sail out solo or with a crew of up to four, keep your boat running, and reel in whatever bites. The longer you stay out, the worse it gets. Just make sure you come back alive.

apps.name: Return to Planet Zoveka Demo
apps.short_description: A physics-driven 2D incremental space-mining sim. Help a family herd cosmic dust, automate production, unlock research, and turn a single inherited station into a vast operation. Enjoy a relaxing, colourful journey to heal Zoveka.

apps.name: RichBashDemo
apps.short_description: “RichBash” is an online party board game. Roll dice around the island to buy land, collect tolls, match with the Book of Fate and global events, and create famous scenes in small games. Support various fun outfits and stand up interactions. Suitable for friends to block and pit against each other

apps.name: Rolling Stock Demo
apps.short_description: Rolling Stock is an online co-op train loading game for up to 4 players. Handle various types of cargo, ensure a tight fit, and help your friends when things get heavy. This new fully physics-based puzzler is rolling out cross-platform on Windows and Linux!

apps.name: Sample Gunpowder Demo
apps.short_description: Solve challenging puzzles through gunpowder crafting, inventory management, and resource planning. Master 12 levels, discover hidden items, and uncover the secrets of a world plunged into darkness.

apps.name: Sanctuary: Shattered Sun Demo
apps.short_description: Command vast armies across the surface of a star-encompassing Dyson Sphere in this next-gen RTS. Shatter the map itself with superweapons, freeze oceans to create new invasion routes, and control hundreds of units in your quest to dominate humanity's greatest megastructure.

apps.name: Sandustry Demo
apps.short_description: Explore and mine fully destructible worlds. Automate increasingly complex production chains. Delve deep to uncover an ancient civilization’s powerful secrets and learn to love the sand in this factory game where every pixel is a valuable resource.

apps.name: Scared Crow Demo
apps.short_description: Scared Crow is a 5×5-grid roguelite deckbuilder. Add up to three ability stickers to each card, plan each week before the Boss arrives, and turn humble cards into build-defining powerhouses. Clear a run, challenge other players’ winning decks, and climb the leaderboard.

apps.name: ScarryLand: The Potion Goes Wrong! Demo
apps.short_description: Grandpa’s potion went horribly wrong, animals act like humans, and humans became animals. He’s gone, so find a potion, put it in the tea stall to calm the chaos for a while, and take Bonky along.

apps.name: SCP: Antimemetics Division Demo
apps.short_description: Deadly memory-altering SCPs have breached containment. Most are invisible without special equipment, and can fill your mind with hazardous knowledge…or leave you an empty husk. Scavenge, survive, and escape this procedurally-generated SCP nightmare.

apps.name: Seashell Hoarder Demo
apps.short_description: Try Seashell Hoarder's cozy first-person collecting and sorting loop. Gather shells on the beach, carry them to the workshop, and place 500 shells on the correct shelves before the demo ends.

apps.name: Secrets of Grindea Demo
apps.short_description: Demo of Secrets of Grindea, a fantasy Action RPG. It's playable by yourself or in co-op with up to three friends! Features an unrestricted skill system, fluid and challenging combat, and an engaging story. For additional value, there's also a fleshed out, challenging roguelike mode!

apps.name: Sender Unknown Demo
apps.short_description: Work the night shift in an underground sorting facility. Weigh packages, compare their contents, and meet your quota by 6 AM. But beware, some packages hide dark secrets. Identify bad batches, earn cash, and survive the night in this tense PSX-style horror job simulator.

apps.name: Service, please Demo
apps.short_description:
Manage and decorate your hotel, cook for your guests, clean their rooms, park their vehicles, and carry out mafia assignments while paying off your debts to them. Do you think you can handle it all?



Featuring Music by Matthew Pablo

apps.name: Shapes of Memory Demo
apps.short_description: A free demo of Shapes of Memory. Assemble 4 hand-illustrated puzzles from the Suitcase Stories universe, each available in 3 difficulty levels. No timers, no pressure. Just you, the pieces, and a moment of calm.

apps.name: ShatterRush Open Pre-Alpha
apps.short_description:
ShatterRush is a multiplayer parkour FPS where fluid movement meets massive mechs in fully destructible levels. Wallrun, grapple, and smash through cover to outplay your foes in kinetic, high-speed combat as the map changes with every fight. 

Join the rush in our free Open Pre-Alpha & wishlist now!

apps.name: Shrooms Demo
apps.short_description: Explore a dark isometric forest alone or in 1–4 player co-op. Gather and test hundreds of ingredients, brew potions and monster oils, build a home, and uncover why a dwarf village has held exactly thirty-four souls for two centuries.

apps.name: SHROT Demo
apps.short_description: Make your way through destroyed Las Vegas and fight aliens, robots, and degenerates (zombies) in this goofy, funny, male-oriented humoristic FPS inspired by boomer shooters!

apps.name: Silent Mainland Demo
apps.short_description: Silent Mainland is a Roguelike deck-builder mixing positioning and board tactics on a 5×12 battlefield. Every card is a life-or-death choice. As monster waves surge like a tide, only sharp positioning and smart deckbuilding carve a path to survival.

apps.name: Silicon Sprint: Data Center Incremental Demo
apps.short_description: An active incremental about running an AI data center. Sweep your cursor through swarms of data packets to turn them into cash, then pour it into racks, GPUs, drones and more. Keep it cool, keep it powered, and grow your company from one laptop into AGI.

apps.name: Silly Polly Beast Demo
apps.short_description:
This story is about a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast, and in order to become free she was forced to study its nature. A story-driven shooter with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you.
How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?

apps.name: SIT or DIE Demo
apps.short_description:
Music plays, chairs appear. Lie, cooperate, deceive. 
In a closed cylinder, up to 12 players face unpredictable survival rounds. Find a chair or be eliminated. It's more than a chair—it involves rules, order, perception, and lies. Who will you trust, and who is deceiving you?

apps.name: Six is Devil Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental game about rolling dice until all dice land on 6. Improve your odds, corrupt your dice, and place bets to achieve the perfect roll. Can you get all 6s?

apps.name: SKROLL Demo
developers: Emilio Rivas, Luis Suárez, Rubén García

apps.name: Skybreak Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo for Skybreak. Learn the physics-driven flight model, run the practice drills, cruise the city in Free Roam, and fight AI drones in Team Deathmatch and Destroy the Base. Offline, no account needed. Online multiplayer is in the full game.

apps.name: Slender Island Demo
apps.short_description: Slender Island is a first-person survival horror game where you find yourself on an abandoned island with a goal of stealing all the treasures hidden in its dungeons. However, Slender Mouse and other monsters won't give them up without a fight.

apps.name: Snow White and the Dwarf Slaves Demo
apps.short_description: This demo lets you play through the outcome of the first tribute in Year 10.

apps.name: Soft 17 Demo
apps.short_description: A blackjack roguelite with a debt to pay. Climb from table to table, stack items that bend the rules, and face dealers who play dirty. This demo contains the entire first floor. The full game has three, plus the House itself.

apps.name: Sort Them Socks Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy sorting game. A room is buried under thousands of pairs of socks, you, and 64 empty cabinets line the walls. Match every pair by colour, pattern and price, hang it on the right rod, and watch the shelves fill up one satisfying row at a time.

apps.name: SpiritVale Demo
apps.short_description: A class-based action MMO inspired by classic RPGs. Explore a fractured world of monsters and ruins, build your own playstyle, and fight alongside friends in real-time, cooperative combat.

apps.name: Star-Soldier Demo
apps.short_description: This is a sample of the main game. You get 24 levels, of the coming soon retro classic. Which has 114 levels! of action packed arcade fun.

apps.name: Stellar Forge Demo
apps.short_description: Feed a cold clump of dust and find out what ignites. The free demo takes you from the first dark proto-mass to your first ignition, with the five lightest elements and room for two bodies. Your save carries over to the full game on the same PC.

apps.name: Still Pines: watchtower Demo
apps.short_description: Explore a snow-covered forest, investigate an isolated watchtower, restore failing equipment, and uncover unsettling clues in this atmospheric first-person psychological horror demo. As darkness falls, every sound leaves you wondering what might be lurking among the trees.

apps.name: STONKS-9800: Stock Market Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Simulator of an 80s Japanese stock market businessman. Chill, catch a retro vibe and watch your profits grow in the text-based game STONKS-9800.

apps.name: Stop The F Demo
apps.short_description:
Stop The F is a first-person puzzle game made in the style of old games.
Use a camera capable of capturing objects from reality into subspace and bringing them back.

apps.name: SUMMER -14 Days Vacation- Demo
apps.short_description: It's a day in summer holiday. You made a phone call to an old lady running a guesthouse on a small island. She cheerfully welcomed you as she asked you to look after her daughters. This marks the beginning of your 14 special days with two girls in a nostalgic island.

apps.name: Super Cabbage Kabumi Demo
apps.short_description: The roguelike all about bonking cabbages! Make incredible builds with a vast array of items, wield powerful weapons, change the game entirely with pets, and so much more! The demo version has a limited item pool and an abbreviated run.

apps.name: SUPERANCHOR Demo
apps.short_description: SUPERANCHOR is a 2D physics puzzle game with terminal-based storytelling. You can't control the ball—reposition the anchor to rotate and swing the maze under gravity. Use momentum and mechanisms to find a way out. But what seems like routine training may reveal problems that aren't yours to solve.

apps.name: Survival Machine Demo
apps.short_description: Build your base on a machine in constant motion, travel through biomes with different resources, and prepare for the night when a zombie threat is much higher than during the day. Would you go solo or explore this new world with your best friends?

apps.name: SUSHISNK Demo
apps.short_description: Link your sushi and break through! Auto-attack, match three to upgrade plates, and mix Sushi Families and Specialties. Beckoning cats and giant seafood await in this demo: Services 1–10 at Challenge Level 0. Defeat the Service 10 elite to clear it!

apps.name: Sí Jefe Demo
apps.short_description: Sí Jefe (Yes boss) is a first-person roguelike set in Mexico where drugs will be your best (or worst) ally. Explore a world where every day is a unique, bizarre, and chaotic adventure. No risk, no gain!

apps.name: Talystro Demo
apps.short_description: Combine cards, dice, and creative logic to defeat your numerical adversaries! Talystro is a deckbuilder with a mathematical twist, namely you have to match the value of your enemies to destroy them! Build your deck, power up your dice and crush your enemies!

apps.name: Tattered Banners Demo
apps.short_description: Lead a mercenary company in a turn-based tactics RPG set in a dynamic, simulated world shaped by your actions. Recruit, equip, and evolve your warband to survive a fantasy realm where the land itself changes. This demo showcases core mechanics that will be expanded in the full version of the game.

apps.name: Temporal Minesweeper Demo
apps.short_description: Reason across time: a cell that is safe now may be a mine the next moment. With only the clues and rules, solve the puzzle step by step — without ever guessing. Combined rules build on one another for a pure brain-teaser.

apps.name: The Alleyway Demo
apps.short_description: Trapped within in a looping British alleyway, you must complete disturbing tasks for a demonic rubbish bin while surviving murderous children's TV puppets known as, Huggles & Friends. A surreal and macabre first-person horror based on the Seven Deadly Sins. Welcome to the Eternal Darkness.

apps.name: The Car Game - Play with friends
apps.short_description: A funny racing game with 2000's like handling of cars and 90's graphics.

apps.name: The Case of the Cryosleep Killer Demo
The Dream Machine: The Definitive Edition - Demo

THE GRAVEYARD DUTY: FALL OF THE LAST DEMON
A cybernetic wave-based FPS. Take Graveyard Duty deep inside a classified facility. Defend the Core from AI drones that want to wipe out humanity. Survive endless waves with bullet multipliers, dash, time stop, and shield

apps.name: The Last Disease Z Demo
apps.short_description: The Last Disease Z is a co-op survival experience where everything is against you. Abandoned cities, zombies and bandits, a struggle for resources and a place to live. Build, unite, and survive.

apps.name: The Last God Demo
apps.short_description: Play the first two pantheons of The Last God: the Pagan and Norse realms, six gods to bring down, two classes to master, and Nightmare for those who survive it.

apps.name: The Legend of Fancy Realm Remake Demo
apps.short_description:
The Legend of Fancy Realm Remake is a story driven tactical RPG that brings a long cherished SRPG classic back to life.
Set in a vast fantasy world shaped by ancient wars, the game weaves together turn based tactical combat and character focused storytelling, where every decision carries weight.

apps.name: The Portsmoor Abysm Demo
apps.short_description: Explore the Catacombs of Portsmoor, push boulders, avoid deadly traps, face otherworldly monsters, and solve mind-bending puzzles. The Portsmoor Abysm is an atmospheric puzzle game with Sokoban-like mechanics, inspired by classics such as Boulder Dash, Supaplex, or Emerald Mine.

apps.name: The Tainted Lands Demo
apps.short_description: Tainted Lands is a turn-based tactical RPG in an eldritch fantasy setting. Lead a band of adventurers to traverse a forbidden wilderness where ancient horrors lie in wait. Recruit companions, scavenge relics, and face the Outer Gods.

apps.name: The Tragic Loss of M. Slazak Demo
apps.short_description: The Tragic Loss of M. Slazak is a Lovecraftian point & click mystery centred around a man's search for his missing grandfather, as he finds out that nothing in the man's curious life is as it seemed...

apps.name: This mountain? Got it from my gramps. Demo
apps.short_description: Explore the mountain with zero funds.

apps.name: THUNDERBOLT Demo
apps.short_description: THUNDERBOLT is a Roguelike Deckbuilder played on a tactical grid. Position yourself carefully and fight enemies room-by-room to escape the alien-infested Thunderbolt!

apps.name: Tidy Up Ltd.: A Cozy Co-op Cleanup Demo
Tidy Up the Wonderlands of Mirad Demo
apps.short_description: Sort 2500+ tiny lands in this cozy tidy-up. Each piece rises as real land you can walk on, and every one earns you upgrades.

apps.name: Tidyspell Demo
apps.short_description: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magic tidying game. Lift and place every object with your wand, catch invisible thieving spirits, fly on your broom, brew potions and step through doors into rooms that are bigger on the inside.

apps.name: Tony The Mole Demo
apps.short_description:
Play as Tony, a curious little mole with a serious digging habit, a taste for worms, and a dream of reaching the surface.
Help townsfolk, repair gadgets, collect delightful hats, and explore hidden spaces as you uncover the story of Pebblegrove.

apps.name: Torreta Demo
apps.short_description: Try Torreta up to wave 20.

apps.name: TrackBlitz Demo
apps.short_description: Try TrackBlitz for free! Race 10 tracks, the two easiest of each tier. Level up to 5 and unlock your first garage items. Race your friends and other Steam players. Get the full game for all 60 tracks and the world leaderboards.

apps.name: Trivia Tricks Friend Pass
apps.short_description: Play The Ultimate Trivia game for free! Have one friend own the full game, host a lobby and share a room code! apps.name: Typing Break Demo
apps.short_description: This is a wild typing roguelike shooter! Type in awesome guns, mow down your enemies, and unleash a storm of bullets!

apps.short_description: This is the Prologue/Demo of Underfang, this is how to story Started. Is optionnal but we recommend to play it before playing the Full Game.

apps.short_description: Descend into your own broken mind in this psychological survival horror. Survive twisted manifestations of your psyche, defend your shelter, and shape your fate through choices that lead to multiple endings.

apps.short_description: A gifted ballerina, Anya enters a prestigious academy—only to be haunted by nightmares of mind-controlled students and unholy rituals. Are they mere dreams or a twisted reality? Uncover the truth hidden beneath the velvet curtains of Valse des Fleurs.

apps.name: VHOLUME Demo
apps.short_description:
Try a first slice of Robert’s bureaucratic quest through the derelict capital of Afro-Eurasia.

The demo includes 4 levels, multiplayer, shortcuts, and a few surprises.

Run, jump, climb, slide, and exploit momentum as you search for the fastest route.

apps.short_description: Try the opening of Video Game Store: Tidy Up. Clean discs and manuals, rebuild retro games and start putting a chaotic shop in order. The same gameplay as the full game, with an earlier stopping point.

apps.short_description:
The first French POV slasher film in FMV, shot to keep you on the edge of your seat
Voiceless is an interactive live-action slasher film designed as a faux single take: every decision is made in real time.

apps.name: Void Step Demo
apps.short_description: Every song you own is a level you haven't played yet. Drop any audio file and the game builds a first-person neon obstacle course from its beats, energy, and rhythm. Jump, slide, and strafe through your music. No music files? Fetch from Newgrounds SongID directly!

apps.name: Vroom Boom Demo
apps.short_description: Arcade car combat. Pick your armed car and battle bot cars until one is left running. Boost, jump and double jump through six arenas, survive waves with a boss every five, or settle it with a friend in split screen.

apps.name: Watch and Whisper Demo
apps.short_description: A microphone-based surveillance game. Monitor a magical ball for paranormal anomalies. Draw precise sigils and whisper incantations to banish them. You must keep the cursed mirror sealed until the ritual is complete to finally defeat the lurking demon!

apps.name: When Life Gives You Lemons Demo
Your Mistress
apps.short_description: Meet Your Mistress! A flirty desktop companion who tracks your cursor and lets you customize her look.

apps.short_description:
Zero hero is an endless roguelike, each wave of enemies and unique combinations. Collect Waboshi to buy new weapons and upgrades outside the game and get further and further in the challenges with the number of kills and waves.

apps.short_description: This is a horror survival game.Join the female protagonist to explore an abandoned subway station full of mysteries, seeking escape in oppressive darkness. Balance exploration, puzzles, and combat—one mistake may plunge you into endless abyss. Arm yourself constantly to face terrors from the depths.

If you defeat a host of enemies and take down the final boss, Minya will graduate successfully. This game focuses primarily on third-person combat and treasure hunting.

apps.short_description: Grid Game is a roguelike deckbuilder. Master grid-linking strategies to unleash vastly different scoring potentials from the exact same divine card combo. Beat diverse bosses across changing poker layouts, and enjoy another layer of fun via casual asynchronous card swapping.

Sleep well enough, and a hidden deep-unconscious challenge awaits.

Alegraz is a roguelite strategy card game where you personally shape your cards in every run. Each run progresses with a deck built entirely from scratch, driven by the choices you make along the way.

apps.name: Aliens Took My Stuff
apps.short_description: In this 1-4 player co-op simulator, you are aliens stealing people's personal belongings straight from their homes to study their DNA. Use telekinesis, turn invisible, and deploy advanced sci-fi gadgets to rob houses clean. Just avoid getting caught by angry Earthlings!

apps.name: ALife: Becoming
apps.short_description: A sci-fi exploration and automation sandbox: walk tiny planets, gather and haul resources, raise bridges between worlds, and train Sparks by recording the trails they learn to follow. Show the path, don't script it, in a physical world that stays surprising.

apps.name: All You Can Love: Hotel Paradiso
apps.short_description: Leave your worries at reception. Tom’s romantic getaway has become a holiday for one. Explore a sunny seaside hotel with more charm than stars, solve puzzles and flirt your way into trouble in a classic point-and-click comedy. The women of Hotel Paradiso have plans of their own.

apps.name: Almarti: Trade in the Woods
apps.short_description: Almarti: Trade in the Woods is a point-and-click puzzle game. In the woods by the lake, a female who calls herself Almarti hopes for your help. Please follow her guide, do sort of things, and finally achieve that ulterior purpose……

apps.name: ALOES Tactics
apps.short_description: A midcentury fantasy auto-battle roguelike strategy game.

apps.name: Anarchy Legends Online
apps.short_description: Anarchy Legends Online was a free-to-play multiplayer tactical action third-person shooter inspired by classic competitive multiplayer games that focused on team-based tactics and real individual skills.

apps.name: Anatolian Soup Simulator
apps.short_description: Run a small Anatolian soup restaurant by hand. Buy stock at the market, haul in the delivery, connect the gas, cook the pot, serve the tables, and wash up before tomorrow. Reinvest every lira into new tables, a second dining hall and a mangal grill, and build the restaurant yourself.

apps.name: Anatomy of a Dream
apps.short_description: Wake up inside a forgotten dreamscape where reality unravels around you. Explore impossible spaces, uncover the remnants of those who came before, and discover why the dream refuses to let you wake.

apps.name: Angelic: The Chaos Theatre Prelude
apps.short_description: Coming Soon...

apps.name: Anvil United!
apps.short_description: A wacky co-op strategy for up to 4 players where every level is a new crafting challenge and a randomized reward opportunity.

apps.name: Anvilborn
apps.short_description: Mine ore, forge gear in many rarity tiers and send your hero through ever more dangerous zones into the endless depths. A calm crafting idle game with research, orders, companions and gems – it keeps working while you're away.

apps.name: APART
apps.short_description: APART™ Is a third-person adventure game that follows an undead child with a severed arm companion whose bond seems to defy death. Survive and explore a world plunged into darkness after a tech breakthrough turns biological remains into humanity’s most valuable energy source.

apps.name: Apocalypticlick
apps.short_description: The world ended. Somebody still has to sort the scrap. Found a settlement, gather resources, and try to keep the roof on while the wasteland keeps knocking. An idle survival builder with research, expeditions, events, raids, and consequences.

apps.name: Aposis: Infinity Hero
apps.short_description: A sci-fi roguelike RPG about an agent from the past awakened deep inside the Cradle, a colossal AI-controlled megacity.

apps.name: Apothecary Grounds
apps.short_description: Explore a seemingly empty land where a lonely graveyard is your only familiar landmark. Gather the items needed to unlock a sealed crypt, uncover the secrets beyond its door, evade the relentless Apothecary who guards the grounds, and unravel the mystery buried beneath them.

apps.name: Apple Picker
apps.short_description: Start with an apple tree, end with a multiverse turned to pulp in this creepy idle incremental game. Pick apples. Produce more apples. Cause the apple-fication of reality. Uncover the source of this all-consuming apple obsession. But whatever you do, (don't) shoot the unicorn.

apps.name: Arachne's Loom
apps.short_description: A block-dropping roguelike deckbuilder with no time pressure. Sew your quilt piece by piece, combining unique shapes and powerful combos to score massive points. Craft dazzling patterns, build your strategy, and face Athena in a duel of ever-increasing stakes.

apps.name: Arcadian Invasion
apps.short_description: The bullet-dodging, commander-hiring, combo-building arcade roguelite. Fill your ship with auto-firing commanders and rule-breaking upgrades between waves, survive the alien armada, and crush bosses that each remix a classic arcade game.

apps.name: Archa
apps.short_description: Archa is a 2D platformer all about movement, combat, exploration, and score! To complete a level, you must gather a certain amount of points, and find the exit. Points are given by collecting and attacking enemies.

apps.name: Archer Vs. Wall
apps.short_description: Defend against the unstoppable walls! Improve your skills, pick relics, and fire so many arrows you won't even know!

apps.name: Archronica
apps.short_description: Stack Blessings on the board and unleash Resonance. A deliberate, board-focused card battler fought across a 2×3 grid. Build two-element decks, awaken your Legends, and follow the tale of the Awakened as an ancient Demon Lord stirs. Solo battles and story mode. Earn cards by playing.

apps.name: ArcMages
apps.short_description: Choose your spellbook and blast your rivals off the map in turn-based online artillery battles. Hurl fireballs, call down meteors, summon dragons, and carve the destructible battlefield into fortresses or craters. One turn, one spell, one perfect shot.

apps.name: Ares Program
apps.short_description: Build and defend an underground colony on Mars. Manage oxygen, heat, food, water and power, then draft individual survivors to fight raiders. Guide colonists through body-part injuries, rescue and treatment as your settlement grows.

apps.name: Article 7
apps.short_description: Article 7 is a short political thriller where you play as Arvenia’s Minister of Civil Authority during a national crisis. Review documents, weigh conflicting information, speak with members of the press, and decide whether to grant emergency powers to the Chancellor.

apps.name: Ascending Realms
apps.short_description: A medieval fantasy real-time strategy game with fast-paced autobattler combat where you command forces across contested realms in the war between the technological Ironclad Pack and magical Arcane Talon. Choose your faction or hero and advance your ideology in the war-torn world of Reznara.

apps.name: Asteroid Mining Corporation
apps.short_description: Blast asteroids, collect resources, upgrade your mining systems, and build an increasingly absurd mining operation for the galaxy's only trillionaire. Every asteroid destroyed brings you closer to unimaginable wealth. Unfortunately, most of it belongs to the corporation.

apps.name: Astral Core
apps.short_description: Build your empire. Name a star. Leave your mark on the universe forever. Explore space in this incremental idle game. Visit other players' stars, conquer their systems, discover powerful synergies, and automate your space empire.

apps.name: Astral Forge: Desktop Alchemist
apps.short_description: A desktop alchemy game. Type and move your mouse to gather resources; control the heat, forge items, find rare affixes and fill your collection. Exchange supplies with other players. Eligible items can enter Steam Inventory and the Community Market. Internet required.

apps.name: Astral Inc.
apps.short_description: A co-op horror about repairing abandoned facilities on alien planets.

apps.name: Astril: A Living Star
apps.short_description: Become a living star. Every battle makes you bigger. Overpower rivals in explosive beam duels, bring down colossal guardian bosses, and leave enemy planets in ruins.

apps.name: Astroid : Vector Zero
apps.short_description: Asteroid : Vector Zero is a fast-paced arcade space shooter where momentum, precision and quick reactions keep you alive. Blast through asteroids, dodge incoming threats and master your ship as the chaos escalates. Easy to learn. Hard to master. One more run.

apps.name: Aw Hell: An Oh Hell Card Game
apps.short_description: The bar's back room, seven chairs, and a deck of cards. Aw Hell is the trick-taking game of calling your shot: bid exactly how many tricks you'll win, then take that many and not one more. Play friends online, the house bots offline, or ranked for a rating.

apps.name: Ba-Dum-Chit Dungeon
apps.short_description: A cute rhythm dungeon crawler where the whole dungeon moves to the music. Hop across isometric pixel floors, jump on the beat as tiles burst, bump monsters and take down giant instrument bosses across 30+ stages with 15 animal friends.

apps.name: Baby Peak
apps.short_description: Baby Peak is a chaotic, physics-based multiplayer platform game where four babies race at the same time, and where reflexes and strategy collide. Your goal is simple: jump, climb, sabotage your rivals, and be the first to reach the golden pacifier. Explore the party modes and different levels.

apps.name: Backrooms Anomaly: Pools
apps.short_description: An anomaly-spotting horror game set in looping liminal poolrooms. Study your surroundings and identify changes ranging from subtle details to terrifying entities. Turn back if something has changed, continue if everything seems normal, and then use your camera to document the anomalies.

apps.name: Backrooms: Liminal Egress
apps.short_description: Welcome to the Backrooms. A huge open maze that never ends, escape with your friends or escape alone. Can you find the exit? In this horror game, you enter the Backrooms and must fine a way out! What could you do to survive? But be aware, you are not the only one here.

apps.name: Backrooms: Splatter
apps.short_description: You're the night-shift paint crew in an office that never ends. Spray paint to reveal invisible floors, fake doors and hidden signs. But spraying is loud, and four things in the dark are listening. PSX horror for 1–4 players, solo or online co-op. PIGMENT CO. is not liable.

apps.name: Bankshot!
apps.short_description:
Real Physics, where every shot matters.

Real Pool with Roguelike progression with an expansive meta-progression. Create your build with powerful items and charms, adapt to every table, and earn your place in The Hustle.

Or play it Old-school and enjoy the real physics and custom tuned opponents

apps.name: Banshee Bash
apps.short_description: Banshee Bash is a local-multiplayer party game. Fight with up to 3 friends (or add bots) to battle as a team, or in an epic free-for-all. Stack spell books to create unbalanced chaos and grab potion bottles to stay in the fight.

apps.name: Baryon Mass Collision
apps.short_description: Escort a mothership through brutal asteroid storms in this physics-driven space roguelike. A single reactor powers your shield, surge, and weapons.

apps.name: Battle Planes Multiplayer
apps.short_description: The classic pen-and-paper planes game, now online. Hide 3 planes on a 10x10 grid, then take turns firing at your opponent's sky. Every hit is a clue: find the head of each plane to shoot it down. Fast matches vs the computer, random opponents or a friend with a room code.

apps.name: Battle Refrain
apps.short_description: “Battle Refrain” is a co-op boss rush for up to four players. Four people swallowed by a labyrinth must defeat the giant bosses beyond its doors to escape. Read their devastating attacks, leap clear and slash into openings. Choose your next door together and help fallen allies to their feet.

apps.name: Battlegeuse
apps.short_description: The colonyship finds a very old solar system called Battlegeuse. General Brenner takes one of his best men, Captain Carter, known for his space explorations, and gives him a very difficult task: recovering information from the planets to defeat the lingering threat.

apps.name: Baukiste
apps.short_description: Build conveyor plants and run them with your own PLC program, in the built-in training PLC or with CODESYS.

apps.name: BEACON 09
apps.short_description: You're a prisoner sentenced to work at a crumbling lighthouse. Every night, you race against the clock, repairing whatever fails before your explosive collar decides your time is up. Repair, explore, survive in this terrifying first-person horror game.

apps.name: Bean in a Ball Pit
apps.short_description: A handful of beans are hiding under a ridiculous number of balls. Wade into a colorful physics pit, sink balls for cash, and build a gloriously excessive cleanup operation with belts, cannons, bots, cranes and wind rings. Somewhere underneath it all, your beans are waiting.

apps.name: Beards vs. Claws
apps.short_description: Dig tunnels, build bridges, and blast your way through walls towards victory in this highly dynamic arena first-person shooter - every obstacle is a potential door

apps.name: Bearing 2889
apps.short_description: Orsivellum paid your team well for ninety days at a remote lighthouse. Now you're waking up on the floor of a locked room, the last few weeks are blank, and the building is empty. A first-person co-op escape room for 1 to 4 players.

apps.name: Beeing Hive
apps.short_description: Beeing Hive is a relaxed hive-building simulation with clicker elements. Design the inside of your beehive, click for resources, optimize comb layouts and bee roles, and protect your colony from wasps, moths, a woodpecker, and a hungry bear.

apps.name: Before the Sun Sets
apps.short_description: Explore a medieval fantasy world in a story driven adventure built around intense and skill based sword combat with real directional blocks, feints, dodges, and parries.

apps.name: Below the Ashes
apps.short_description: Forty years after the sky caught fire, your group goes underground to survive. Lead a crew, dig into a world of cave-ins, floods and darkness, and face what is climbing up from the deep. Alone or in online co-op with up to 8 players.

apps.name: Below the Bell
apps.short_description: A first-person descent under a quarry town, one square at a time, with a hand-bell for magic. Everything down there shows its blow before it lands, and the changes you ring keep the dead in their place.

apps.name: Between Two Midnights
apps.short_description: Experience a story of temptation, passion, and emotional discovery as Adrian navigates tangled secrets, rising jealousy, and intense romance to decide where his heart truly belongs when the night finally ends.

apps.name: Beyond the Mortal Gate
apps.short_description: A story-driven xianxia RPG with a built-in local LLM. Talk to AI villagers in your own words—ask around, borrow gear, commission work, or pass word through friends. Villagers act only on what they witness or hear, turning your words and deeds into evolving rumors, favors, and consequences.

apps.name: Beyond the Pier
apps.short_description: Set sail for an uncharted New World. Explore unknown islands, build thriving colonies and compete with rival factions in a living world where every voyage, battle and decision spreads rumors that shape your reputation, economy and diplomacy.

apps.name: Big Bug Billionaire
apps.short_description:
Watch 150+ abstract, pixel-art insects scurry and fly across your desktop,
while customizing your setup freely with a wide variety of decor.
Turn your desktop into your very own terrarium, breed rare bugs, and sit back to rake in idle cash!

apps.name: Billionth Soul
apps.short_description: Grow humanity’s last colony from one thawed sleeper to one billion souls aboard a failing generation ship. Draft cards, build powerful grid combinations, and trade population against dwindling life support in this idle roguelite deckbuilder.  The billionth soul is the hardest one to save.

apps.name: Billo-Bricks
apps.short_description: Save the World by destroying Bricks!

apps.name: Bings
apps.short_description: Dive into a nostalgic notebook world in Bings. Navigate challenging physics-based puzzles and overcome obstacles in this sketch-art style precision game. Test your reflexes, time your moves perfectly, and conquer every doodle-filled level.

apps.name: Black Pine: Incident Response
apps.short_description: In 1980, the anomalous “Katabasis” event upset humanity’s control of Earth. Five years later, its remnants fight to stay alive, and you find yourself in Appalachia’s Blair County Exclusion Zone. Survive alone or in a group of up to six in this first-person co-op survival RPG.

apps.name: BLACKBOX-market poker-
apps.short_description: BLACKBOX blends poker strategy with market trading in a high-stakes simulation. Build powerful hands, make calculated trades, and manage risk as every card combination influences your profits and losses. Chase big gains—but one decision can change everything.

apps.name: Blades & Trades
apps.short_description: Forge your legacy as both merchant and hero. Explore Zoldar, battle monsters for rare materials, and craft epic gear. Team up with friends to build a thriving shop in the village markets or arm yourselves to conquer the dangerous depths of the wild.

apps.name: Blamcon's Light Gun Arcade
apps.short_description: You're own classic Arcade built for PC Light Guns and mouse. Destroy space debris, protect your city from an attack, take out an alien horde from below, break gems with your rail gun, fly solo breaking defenses over an alien world, fight though an alien world, and protect earth in your straighter.

apps.name: Blamcon's Light Gun Madness
apps.short_description: Light Gun Madness is a travelling shooting show for your PC Light Guns. Test your skills, play with friends. A great party game. Use one light gun and pass it around to see who gets the best scores or play head to head with 2~4 light guns at the same time. You can use a mouse but it's not the same.

apps.name: BlissFlow
apps.short_description: Lose yourself in Blissflow, a first-person procedural odyssey through digital dreamscapes. Run, vault, and explore surreal biomes, driven by dynamic atmospheres.

apps.name: Blocade
apps.short_description: Race your pawn across the board and drop walls to cut off your rival, but never seal them in. Blocade is a free two-player strategy board game: ranked matches against real people on PC and mobile, a daily 128-player tournament, puzzles and a ladder of bots.

apps.name: Blood & Ledger
apps.short_description: Port Aldrich, 1920. You start as a young nobody and follow your family for eighty years. Rackets, businesses, elections or a police badge: in this city everyone plays by the same rules as you, and nobody forgets.

apps.name: Bloodrights
apps.short_description: An unknown disease has wiped out half of the city's population. The main characters managed to survive the outbreak. However, it's not as if everything went without consequences

apps.name: Blooming Courtyard
apps.short_description: Blooming Courtyard is a cozy logic puzzle game on a grid. Follow the placement rules to solve hundreds of puzzles. Enjoy the scenery of all four seasons as you fill your little sunlit courtyard with flowers and greenery!

apps.name: BloooBleee
apps.short_description: Two slime games in one. In Versus, up to four players stack blocks into wobbly towers, bomb each other's builds and climb clear of the rising water, on one couch or online. In Together, two players merge, split and carry blocks through ten co-op puzzle levels.

apps.name: Blubber
apps.short_description: A turn-based sliding puzzle game about a very hungry seal. Push off and glide across the ice until something stops you, bounce off posts, ride ramps and eat fish along the way; every move costs food. Battle bosses, tackle 500+ levels, build your own, and play party games with friends.

apps.name: Boardroom
apps.short_description: Build. Grow. Dominate. A deep CEO simulator for finance professionals and ambitious founders, run your own finance firm and turn it into a formidable giant in the world of finance!

apps.name: BodgeBall
apps.short_description: Multiplayer dodgeball that blends FPS intensity with ridiculous chaos. Hit opponents with balls or knock them offstage to send them to the bench, then catch a ball to bring teammates back into the fight.

apps.name: Boku Boku
apps.short_description: Boku Boku is a Cozy Building sandbox game. You can build houses, create your own worlds, and make new friends. Explore a wondrous world, and leave your mark in this pixel paradise.

apps.name: BombBazled
apps.short_description: Your best friend is the most dangerous bomb in the room. BombBazled is an online co-op party game for 1–8 friends: bomb through monster dungeons, grab the gold and escape together – or break the pact at the gate and get branded JUDAS. Proximity voice chat included.

apps.name: Bone - عظمة
apps.short_description: A 4-player co-op game where skeletons escort a fragile orb on a wagon.

apps.name: Bongo VPet - Taskbar Buddy
apps.short_description: A tiny VPet device lives on your desktop and its pixel pet hops with every key you press. Earn Bongo Points while you work, feed treats, open Bongo Boxes and hunt rare Color pets, skins and devices you can trade on Steam.

apps.name: Boom or Bloom
apps.short_description: Run a fireworks workshop with up to 3 friends. Every extra scoop makes the shell bigger and worth more - and brings the workshop closer to blowing up. One listens with the stethoscope, one steadies the shell, one holds the bucket. Light the fuses at night: a sky full of fireworks, or a crater.

apps.name: BosaTella Loopa
apps.short_description:
Junk Robots. Monster Hordes. Unhinged Firepower.

Team up in this co-op looter shooter to get filthy rich, discover absurd weaponry, and blast away the dangerous monsters that lurk within "The Loop". Tear through the subway, catch the train (or don't), and blow all your money on even more firepower.

apps.name: Bottle King
apps.short_description: From collecting bottles in the city park to founding the Cosmic Deposit Council: gather empties, hire helpers and grow a recycling empire that stretches from a small town to the edge of the universe. A relaxed pixel-art idle game that keeps running on the side.

apps.name: Breadventure
apps.short_description: A lore rich, party-based RPG about the loaf who became a legend - Collect delicious companions, then fight, cook, and schmooze your way to the top of Hester's HQ. Features multiple endings and a diverse assortment of eggs.

apps.name: Breeder Protocol
apps.short_description: Drop into a living alien hive with up to three friends. Reach the stranded crew before the breeders do, bring the uplinks online and fight your way to extraction. A twin-stick co-op roguelite where every hive is new and every run builds a deadlier squad.

apps.name: Breeding Pit
apps.short_description: You are the Dark Lord. Breed an orc horde in the pit beneath your tower, where every whelp inherits real genes from its sire and dam. Send them to war in retro turn-based battles, and raise a dynasty strong enough to put out the Light.

apps.name: BROODHOUSE
apps.short_description: Your deck is alive and it breeds. A creature card hits for its whole strain's population, so your power sits in the cards you never draw. Push past carrying capacity and the overflow turns feral in your hands. A roguelike deckbuilder about a colony that grows faster than you can hold it.

apps.name: Bros Survivors
apps.short_description: Two players, one body, absolute chaos. Survive enemy hordes in this co-op Survivors-like. Merge with a friend into a giant mech: one controls horizontal movement, the other vertical. Will you coordinate or die trying?

apps.name: Buddy Bug
apps.short_description: In a microscopic insect world tucked away in a corner of the city, gather your friends, fight bravely, and use all sorts of innovative gadgets to carve out your own territory. In this cooperative, rogue-lite game, you will embark on an exciting and exhilarating journey.

apps.name: Bulken
apps.short_description: Escape from a giant derelict spaceship filled with lurking enemies. Each run offers new challenges that stand between you and the Bridge.

apps.name: Burgerama Anomaly
apps.short_description: Serve or die in a late-night pedestrian underpass kiosk. Prepare different burgers, fry ingredients, and manage your supplies - all while inspecting your customers for inhuman traits. Follow the night's rules, survive various hazards, and uncover the truth behind the mutations.

apps.name: Bus Terminal Simulator: Prologue
apps.short_description: Experience an immersive terminal management simulator. Manage passengers, organize schedules, inspect luggage, catch smugglers, and prevent illegal activities. Not every passenger is innocent  some will try to trick you or smuggle illegal items. Stay alert and run your terminal efficiently.

apps.name: BUS: Bro u Survived
apps.short_description: Ride through the apocalypse with your friends! BUS: Bro U Survived is a co-op story-driven adventure featuring your very own bus! Fight zombies, gather resources, help other survivors, and solve puzzles. Can you uncover the truth about the beginning of the epidemic and decide the fate of the island?

apps.name: BUZZ or DIE
apps.short_description: The rules are simple. Dive into your opponent's mindscape and search for secrets. Turn those secrets into content and make a short video. Gain the most Likes from the audience to win.

apps.name: Caeldovar Online
apps.short_description: Old School MMO RPG Game with the inspiration of Runescape. Explore and shape the world as your character evolves into new items and methods of training. Greet fellow adventures in the wilds...or hunt them - Your call!

apps.name: Camping Resort Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and run your own campsite in this cozy management sim. Turn an empty stretch of coast into a camping resort with a character all its own: lay out paths, place pitches, glamping and bungalows, shape the landscape, and welcome guests who each live their own little holiday.

apps.name: Candy Diggers
apps.short_description: Drill through candy planets, catch sweet critters and fuse upgrades into wild synergies in this cheerful digging roguelite. Every run brings candy home to your factory town, where belts and buildings turn it into coins for bigger, deeper runs. Save the candy universe from the Evil Veggie Council!

apps.name: Canvania
apps.short_description: Draw the world as you explore it in this hand-drawn Metroidvania.

apps.name: Canyon Torque
apps.short_description: Build, armor and arm your ride for a 50 km trip through a zombie-infested canyon. Refuel, hunt, cook and survive the night. Discover 18 vehicles, tow cargo or your bike, and compete in circuit races, drag tournaments, Enduro and the launcher.

apps.name: Capsule Arcade
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person tidying game in a neon capsule-toy arcade. Crack open capsules, sort 216 cute figures into their display cases and bring six dark floors of Hoshizora Capsule Hall back to life, one glowing machine at a time.

apps.name: Capy Farm
apps.short_description: A short incremental game where you build a farm run entirely by capybaras. Expand your fields, automate production, earn massive profits, and outperform rival farms to win the Grand Harvest Competition.

apps.name: Card Train
apps.short_description: Card Train is a retro pixel-art strategy card game for 2–4 players. Play from your hand, match cards in the shared train, and choose when to collect. Challenge AI or Steam friends online, customize decks and matching rules, and turn luck into thrilling comebacks!

apps.name: Carnosis
apps.short_description: Carnosis is a horror dungeon crawler where you steal the bodies, skills, and minds of fallen enemies. Sever limbs to disable deadly attacks, manipulate emotions to gain trust, and forge broken builds through a roguelike reward system.

apps.name: Carpet Box
apps.short_description: Explore an abandoned house with seemingly no exit, as you quickly uncover the terror that resides hidden beneath the walls...

apps.name: CASE: Animatronics Redux
apps.short_description: CASE: Animatronics Redux is a truly scary and challenging first-person stealth horror on PC. The police department's security system has been breached by an anonymous hacker. All exits are locked. Metallic thumps are getting closer. Are you ready to face your nightmares again, Detective Bishop?

apps.name: Castle Come
apps.short_description: Castle Come is a mecha builder and survival action game. Scout a strange land full of bandits in search of new parts, defeat enemy castles and loot the wreckage, recruit crew to man your growing arsenal of weapons and build your way from an agile fortling into a hulking, monster machine.

apps.name: Castle of the Winds
apps.short_description: Castle of the Winds is a classic early Windows roguelike. Set in a world inspired by Norse mythology, players explore procedurally generated dungeons beneath a quiet village, battling monsters, discovering magical items, and unraveling the mystery of an ancient evil.

apps.name: CastleWright
apps.short_description: Rebuild ruined castles, manage resources and workers, raise your army, and conquer enemy outposts as you restore a fallen kingdom.

apps.name: Cat Chaos: Tidy Up!
apps.short_description: Cat Chaos Tidy Up is a cozy organizing game! Pick up 4,800 adorable cat toys, sort them onto the right shelves, earn money, and unlock powerful abilities to tidy up the entire shop.

apps.name: Cat's Endless Stroll
apps.short_description: Pick a cat and a place, and a slow stroll begins. Wander through gently changing scenery as your cat grows, little by little, into a shape all its own. Keep it in a small window on your desktop while you work, or walk together with your Steam friends.

apps.name: cat.exe
apps.short_description: cat.exe is the chill desktop cat you've always wanted. No idler mechanics, no clicking, just a plain cat.exe to hang out at the bottom of your screen while you use your computer.

apps.name: Catch Meow If You Can
apps.short_description:
An online co-op survival game for up to 4 players.
Play as a famous, award-winning cat. While the owner is away, different types of burglars invade the mansion. Explore dark rooms, solve puzzles, outsmart intruders, fight back, and escape without getting caught.

apps.name: Catch the Button
apps.short_description: A chaotic reaction game where every single click counts! Chase the moving button, build insane streaks, survive unpredictable events and watch out for tricks. Think you're fast enough to catch it?

apps.name: Cats & Cans Co.
apps.short_description: Me-meow! (Translation: You almost finished a 12-hour warehouse shift, but an earthquake hit!) Meow-meow-meow! (Translation: Grab your friends and tidy up this massive warehouse! Sort thousands of cans and clean up the trash!) Meow-meow-mew!? (Translation: Are we ever going to sleep tonight!?)

apps.name: Cats & Rhythmical Restaurant
apps.short_description: A cozy cat restaurant that lives on your desktop and comes alive to whatever you're listening to. While sound plays, your cats head out for fish, cook, and serve hungry guests; when it's quiet, they get bored and doze off. Recruit cats, dress them up, and grow your seaside diner.

apps.name: Cellsssss
