apps.short_description: Build a viral army and clash with human cells in a large-scale strategy auto battler. Combine infantry, ranged units and cavalry, plan your deployment, and set each legion’s stance. Earn DNA through battle and expand your research tree to evolve your swarm.

apps.name: Centauri B
apps.short_description: Defend your planet from waves of enemies in this 2D space shooter! Destroy your enemies, survive each new wave, and choose upgrades to grow stronger. The longer you survive, the higher your score. Try to beat your own record and discover how far you can go!

apps.name: Champion Tennis
apps.short_description: AI takes part in every development workflow behind Champion Tennis, a single-player 3D tennis game with extraordinary powers. Charge your returns, unleash meteors, lightning, ice and tornadoes, and build your skills through cup tournaments against computer rivals.

apps.name: Charwick
apps.short_description: A pixel-art bullet heaven roguelite where your weapons fire on their own: you dodge, choose and build. Pick one of 8 specialties, fuse it with a second into one of 28 fusions, and survive 25 waves across 5 biomes to face the Lord of Charwick.

apps.name: Check Please!
apps.short_description: Run chaotic restaurants in this fantasy medieval realm! Seat demanding magical creatures with your Demon Chef and serve over 100 unique dishes as you upgrade your taverns all across the kingdom! As the only human trapped in this fantasy medieval realm, your only way back to Earth is to wait tables.

apps.name: CHECKBORNE - A CHESS ADVENTURE
apps.short_description: Challenge 20 chess masters from around the world to duels across the board. Defeat them one by one, prove your skills, and fight your way to the top to become the ultimate CHECKBORNE Champion.

apps.name: Cheesty
apps.short_description:
In a world built for humans, you'll have to evade scientists, solve puzzles and use your sense of smell to find your way in this adventure about freedom, belonging and home.

You play as Brie, a daring lab rat in search of the rodent paradise… Cheesty.

apps.name: Chess Club Manager
apps.short_description: Tycoon game to build and manage your own chess club from the ground up. Balance training, sponsors, tournaments and turn a tiny local club into a global success.

apps.name: ChimpUP!
apps.short_description:
ChimpUP! is a chaotic movement focused co-op party game where you and your friends battle, race and swing fast.
Armed with two independent grapple hooks for arms, swing around in a chaotic surreal world. Master the movement, sabotage your friends, race to the top, create cosmetics and maps.

apps.name: Chinese Pancake Simulator
apps.short_description: Run a tiny pancake stall beneath an overpass. Cook every order by hand, crack the eggs, add the toppings, give the right change, and work toward achieving your life dreams.

apps.name: Chisel Me This
apps.short_description: Chisel Me This is a 1-8 player party game where you and your friends compete to create statues of various prompts. Sculpt large marble blocks, mold clay, and sabotage competitors as you create artistic masterpieces!

apps.name: Choppy Waters
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build your cards, not just your deck. Combine ingredients, each with its own effect, into sushi, then serve it to hungry pirates in turn-based battles. Spend gold to grow stronger, but run out and your voyage is over.

apps.name: Chrono Seoul
apps.short_description: Chrono Seoul’s unique Time Table combat lets you use the hero’s mechanical arm and future-reading ability to predict enemy actions and respond with precise attacks, defense, and evasion. Each run offers new patterns, and at every chapter’s end, an Existence corrupted Seoul awaits.

apps.name: CLAM
apps.short_description: Clam is an odd pet rat; googly-eyed, unpredictable and hyper-vigilant. One night she gets curious with the front door of the rat mansion and escapes with no way back in. Now she’s a tenant. Is the sharehouse as hospitable as home? Is the bond refundable? Find your way, tell your friends - it’s CLAM!

apps.name: Click vs X: Popup Ad Hell - 画面いっぱいの嫌がらせ -
apps.short_description: All you wanted was to watch a video, but bad popup ads are taking over your screen! Chase down escaping 'X' buttons with millisecond precision in this 90s OS desktop survival action. A 100% fixed, muscle-memory challenge. Speedrun all 50 chaotic stages and conquer the global leaderboard!

apps.name: Clocks Sleep at Zero
apps.short_description: A puzzle game where every clock must count down to zero together!

apps.name: Cluttermancer: Tidy Up the Nightmare Alley
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person tidying sim set in a bustling alley: 5 magical shops and 6,666 items to sort. Every shop on this street is chaos, every shelf has a rule, and every misplaced wand is your problem now.

apps.name: Cobble Climber
apps.short_description: Cobble climber is a difficult climbing game where each hold has a countdown. Taking too long will increase the risk of drowning in the rising water level.

apps.name: Code Red RTS
apps.short_description: A free Cold War real-time strategy game in full 3D. Build a base, mine ore and lead the Allies or the Soviets across 16 maps. Fight the computer, battle friends with up to eight players, or climb the ranked 1v1 and 2v2 ladders.

apps.name: Codys Collectathon
apps.short_description: Collect every item, dodge hazards and reach the portal before Cody runs out of oxygen. Explore 21 single-screen caverns in 8-bit or 16-bit graphics. Play the main campaign for free, with optional paid DLC for extra modes, the Level Editor and community-pack features.

apps.name: Coin Pusher Millionaire
apps.short_description: Spin the slots, fill your coin pusher with prizes, and push your way to a million! Buy upgrades, unlock higher tiers with bigger rewards, and complete collections in this satisfying coin pusher game.

apps.name: Complete Horror
apps.short_description: This is a horror survival game.Join the female protagonist to explore an abandoned subway station full of mysteries, seeking escape in oppressive darkness. Balance exploration, puzzles, and combat—one mistake may plunge you into endless abyss. Arm yourself constantly to face terrors from the depths.

apps.name: Compost Apocalypse Survivors
apps.short_description: Survive the hordes and defeat the bosses in steam(ed)punk bullet heaven where the vegetables bite back. Wield ridiculous weapons, upgrade and evolve, and mulch monstrous bosses solo or in 2-player online or couch co-op. Gather Scrap, grow stronger, and fight your way up the compost heap.

apps.name: Confiscated!
apps.short_description: Your phone has been confiscated. So has everyone's stuff. It's all locked in the caretaker's office, and he's still in the building. A short first-person comedy-horror chase through a British primary school: sneak, distract, and leg it before the bell.

apps.name: Conglomerate
apps.short_description: One Earth, millions of cities, competing companies. Conglomerate is an economic simulation where every city is a moving part and every company is part of a shared global economy. Build supply chains, hire local workers and expand city by city.

apps.name: Construction Store Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and run your own construction supply store from the ground up! Arrange products, keep shelves stocked, serve customers, manage employees, set prices and expand your store. Grow from a small shop into a thriving business and make your store the go-to place for builders!

apps.name: Conversations with My Imaginary Friends
apps.short_description: A free collection of explorable scenes capturing conversations spanning two decades between the creator of To the Moon and the fictional characters they've created. About life, making games, and everything in between.

apps.name: Cook Together
apps.short_description: Cook Together is a chaotic co-op drug creating game where you and your friend run a basement lab, to create drugs for big boss. Finish the product in time without blowing yourselves up. Upgrade your lab, perfect the purity of your products and become the biggest producer in town.

apps.name: Corrupta
apps.short_description: Harvest the remnants of a shattered world in this action RPG roguelike. Explore distinct factions, collect magi hearts, and bind them to your weapons to shape your build. Combine their powers, grow stronger, and defeat the bosses that rule its ruins.

apps.name: Cosmic Race
apps.short_description: Cosmic Race is a sci-fi Combat Racing game inspired by retro arcade racers. Race across vibrant alien worlds, defeat opponents in destruction-rich environments, and become the Cosmic Champion.

apps.name: Cosmic Seance
apps.short_description: A cosmic detective game. Summon old gods, interpret visions, and trade your sanity for the truth. Unravel the enigma before madness takes you.

apps.name: Count My Coins, Coin Counter!
apps.short_description: Count coins with a cast of silly characters as you add up currencies, convert their money, appraise jewels, and pick out forgeries.

apps.name: Cowboy Rumble 牛仔大乱斗
apps.short_description: Grab a gun, take the high ground, and turn the fight with your cowboy's ability. A pixel-art platform shooter with 2–4 player local battles and 2v2 online objectives: contest control points, escort a parade cart, or plant and defend an explosive charge.

apps.name: Cowboy!Duel!
apps.short_description:
A fast-paced Western cowboy duel game.
Load your revolver, steady your breathing, and fire in the split second between life and death.
Face off against friends in gunfights and challenge legendary cowboys from around the world;
Earn bounties and become an undefeated legend of the Wild West.

apps.name: Cozy Cat Room: Focus Time with Your Cat
apps.short_description: Turn time spent working or studying into time shared with a cat. Settle into a room you've made your own, find a work-and-break rhythm with a Pomodoro timer, and unlock new furniture as your focus time adds up.

apps.name: Cozy Paws
apps.short_description: Cozy Paws is a cute pixel-art idle game that lives on your desktop. Your cats keep battling adorable mice while you work or play. Collect over 50 cats, dress them up, explore 40 areas and watch the numbers grow while it runs in the corner.

apps.name: Cozy Witch Store
apps.short_description: Cozy Witch Store is a first person organizing simulator. Help Selene the witch to sort potions, chests, grimoires and other magical objects after a little incident. Tidy up the store, earn coins and upgrade your skills.

apps.name: Crafty Marbles
apps.short_description: Build whatever you want for your marbles! Crazy races, chaotic machines, chain reactions, battles, or anything else!

apps.name: Crave
apps.short_description: Ceaseless hunger draws you yet a bit closer to the gates of Foghorn. Devour men and beasts alike to acquire a wide array of combat abilities. Through shadows and mold, track down the paling memories of this bygone kingdom, all in a classic hand-drawn action platformer.

apps.name: Crazy Pipes 3D
apps.short_description: In this fast-paced 3D puzzle game, connect pipes before time runs out, while avoiding obstacles and dynamites. Boost your score by using more pipes. Advance in the Normal mode with growing challenges or play randomly generated puzzles in the timer-less Endless mode.

apps.name: Crazy Road Shop Wars
apps.short_description: Run your own shop, compete against rival store owners, and sabotage the competition in this chaotic online multiplayer shop management game. Stock shelves, set prices, unlock new products, and do whatever it takes to become the ultimate retail king.

apps.name: Crime & Anomaly
apps.short_description: Fight to keep your mind in the shadow of crime and the unknown. Crime & Anomaly is an indie psychological horror that drags you through the dark corridors of 1860s Saint Petersburg. Inspired by Dostoevsky’s Crime and Punishment, every creaking floorboard and flicker of light can shatter your sanity.

apps.name: Crimson Oathfall
apps.short_description: Build a monster that fights your way. Tear through swarms in a dark fantasy action roguelite, fuse mutations and graft organs from fallen guardians. Return to the refuge, unlock new forms and venture out to bring its missing people home.

apps.name: Crimson Princess
apps.short_description:
Beat 'em up(Belt Scroll) Action Game.
Control princesses with distinct fighting styles—one-handed sword, brawler, musket, greatsword, and hammer. Chain switches that shift range and tempo with support attacks to keep the pressure on.

apps.name: Cripta
apps.short_description: A co-op roguelike for up to five heroes. Descend a crypt that changes every run, pick gifts, curses and relics, level your skills at the anvil and face the Kings of six worlds, alone or with friends, all the way down to the Hollow Seraph.

apps.name: CropKeep
apps.short_description: Hold the farm, upgrade your mercenaries, and take down enemies for relics that make you stronger. Even when you fall, the growth you banked stays with you.

apps.name: Crown Clash
apps.short_description: Crown Clash is a RTS game. Choose your cards, attack, defend, and turn the tide with luck! Outsmart your opponents and claim victory in fast-paced battles.

apps.name: Crownfront
apps.short_description: A turn-based medieval strategy game played on a board that sits on the floor of a room. Gather wood and food, build farms and barracks, raise an army and take the enemy castle. Every unit you own eats every turn, so your farms decide how big your army can get.

apps.name: CruiserOrder
apps.short_description: Restore order to a cruise ship off Benidorm. Pick up 4,300 products, complete 64 objectives across 16 shops and solve preparation tasks. Upgrade your abilities, discover hidden souvenirs and play at your own pace in this single-player organizing game.

apps.name: CryptidCam
apps.short_description: Head into the woods at night to lure out and take photos of creatures like The Loch Ness Monster, The Loveland Frogman, Bigfoot, and more fan favorite cryptids in this short, light hearted photography adventure.

apps.name: Crytter Crawlers
apps.short_description: Crytter Crawlers is a 2.5d Creature-Collecting Bullet-Heaven Deckbuilding Roguelike where YOU play as Cryptids! Find dozens of Crytters! GROW your Crytters into several stronger forms, earn new weapons, discover new upgrades, and fight back against a multitude of post-apocalyptic threats!

apps.name: Cursor Ship
apps.short_description: Pilot a ship shaped like a mouse cursor through the solar system. Slingshot around planets to break your speed limit, mow down swarms of enemy arrows, and take on the King Cursor. Mouse only — aim, and the rest is pure speed.

apps.name: Cyber Pizzaiolo
apps.short_description: Build a cyberpunk mafia empire behind a pizzeria front. Recruit specialists, command car-based gangs, collect protection money and launder your profits. Lead four playable families in solo play or battle with up to six players. Your pizzeria is the front. The city is your business.

apps.name: Cyberdelic
apps.short_description: Cyberdelic is an immersive FPS - Use a combination of weaponry to pierce hostile shields, armour and flesh. Swap out cybernetic components to best suit your combat encounters. Explore an interconnected environment acquiring additional tools to your arsenal.

apps.name: CyberIdle
apps.short_description: Run, fight and grow stronger in CyberIdle, a pixel-art idle RPG. Collect coins and monster drops, unlock upgrades, craft gear from blueprints and shape your build with equipment bonuses. Let combat run automatically or tap to attack faster.

apps.name: D.A.M.N!
apps.short_description: Outplay your friends with cards instead of out-rolling them! In a cheerful race to the finish: help your partner, get in your rivals' way, combo, knock out, freeze, use ults... Collect awards, compare stats. Solo, in a team, with bots, hot-seat, cross-play online or offline — no limits!

apps.name: Danganronpa 2x2
apps.short_description: While on a school trip to Jabberwock Island, students are ensnared in Monokuma’s deadly game, forced into mutual killing and Class Trials to expose the culprit. Break through contradictions with high-speed detective action. Includes both a brand-new scenario and the enhanced original!

apps.name: Dark Hours: Anomalies
apps.short_description: Dark Hours: Anomalies is a 1-4 player co-op horror game. The Trickster has trapped your crew of thieves in an endless loop. Memorize every room and spot the anomalies to break the curse. Miss one and you start over. Can you beat it, or will you be trapped forever?

apps.name: DARK PRAY
apps.short_description: The game features an ATB (Active Time Battle) combat system with a variety of skill combinations. You can adjust the difficulty to your preference at any time during the game. The game includes multiple NPCs. You can also choose to kill everyone and venture through the world completely alone.

apps.name: Dark Sanctum
apps.short_description: DARK SANCTUM is a dark fantasy action roguelite with isometric combat. Survive relentless enemy waves, combine devastating powers, defeat bosses, and reach extraction to earn SkullCoins and strengthen your heroes between runs.

apps.name: Dark Tonic's Blunderbusted: Guns Out, Bluns Out
apps.short_description: BLUNDERBUSTED is a fast paced roguelike shooter for lightgun, mouse, or touchscreen! Dive into wild arcade action with crazy customized weapons and ridiculous powerup combos, destructible stages, and just... too many enemies.

apps.name: DARKDRAW
apps.short_description: Descend into the Abyss with a fading torch. Darkdraw is a roguelike deckbuilder where every battle is fought on a board, creature against creature, and the dying light changes the rules. Pick your clan, build your deck, keep your flame alive.

apps.name: Darkest Path
apps.short_description: Darkest Path is a 2.5D roguelike FPS that merges a modern-retro aesthetic with cosmic horror. Navigate through shifting nightmare realms, master diverse character classes, and survive the brutal corruption of a decaying world.

apps.name: DashBreaker
apps.short_description: From breaking asteroids to piercing massive warships, grow your small craft into a force to be reckoned with. DashBreaker is an active incremental game: dash through enemies, gather resources, and buy permanent upgrades. Unlock new abilities and wipe out more enemies with every dash.

apps.name: DATAWANDER
apps.short_description: Embark on a surreal exploration of a digital island. Explore a silent virtual world and discover never-before-seen moments of transformation and hidden paths.

apps.name: Dawn of Ramonda
apps.short_description: A relaxing single-player farming game set in the post-apocalypse. Rediscover the principles of agriculture, explore lands that have been reclaimed by nature, and build your settlement together with other survivors living off the land.

apps.name: Dawn Quest V ～天空の神々～
apps.short_description: For those who love classic, world-saving RPGs. Highly recommended for players seeking the traditional RPG experience. 256*256 world map for retro RPG lovers, explored using various vehicles such as ships, flying carpets, and dragons. 20 towns and 24 dungeons.

apps.name: Dawnheart Keepers
apps.short_description: Hold the line across a voice-acted 21-mission campaign, or begin a Long Dawn run: a generated board, no gold, and a card draft after every wave. Ten spires, 41 foes, online co-op for up to 9 Keepers, 6v6 Rival Keeps, and a level editor with Workshop. Fully voiced in English and Hebrew.

apps.name: Day 5
apps.short_description: It's Friday. The weekend is finally within reach. But when the same day begins to repeat, something is clearly wrong. Observe your surroundings, uncover the anomalies, and find a way to escape the loop in DAY 5, a third-person psychological horror game.

apps.name: DEADEYE
apps.short_description: Sail, fight, plunder, build! Start with a cutlass and a leaky raft, then crew a real ship, sink the navy, hunt sea monsters and claim an island of your own. The sea is shared, and nothing on it is safe.

apps.name: Deadtime Defenders 2
apps.short_description: Humanity's only defense against a relentless invading horde is BACK! Squad up or go solo. Collect legendary loot, complete high-risk missions, and create your perfect Defender in this online, co-op, side-scrollin', lootin’-shootin' RPG!

apps.name: Deal Me In
apps.short_description: Build wild upgrade combinations in a haunted casino. Fuse maxed cards into unstable bonuses, gamble across six games, and pay your growing debt while monsters hunt you. A first-person horror roguelike for solo play, 2–4 player online co-op or VS.

apps.name: Dearest Darling Dragon
apps.short_description: Raise your own baby dragon and date a hot dragon "daddy" in this silly and fantastical stat-raiser dating sim! 🥚🐉

apps.name: Delved Too Deep
apps.short_description: Delved Too Deep is a game about an endless stream of machines exploring the depths seeking to fulfil the Factory Imperative. Each new machine iteration is better than the last, their accumulated knowledge leading to revelations that may change the fate of those who wander the deep...

apps.name: Demon Corp
apps.short_description: Demon Corp is a 1–8 player co-op horror extraction game where you enter hostile locations, recover valuable loot, complete dangerous contracts, survive unpredictable creatures, and make it back alive before the company decides you’re replaceable.

apps.name: Demon Fish Dead Ahead
apps.short_description: Sail the seas of hell while you catalog the local fauna in this turn-based classic JRPG, but watch out... SOMETHING LURKS BELOW!

apps.name: Demon Slayer Rome
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based RPG. Battle demons and absorb their abilities, uncover secrets and progress in power, and save an Empire lost to sin as you go up against eight demon princes and the hordes of Hades! Demon Slayer Rome is turn-based Mega Man set in the time of the Roman Empire.

apps.name: Desert Survival
apps.short_description: Survive 15 minutes in a desert that wants you dead. Fight swarms out of Arabian folklore, forge elemental builds and weapon evolutions, answer daily contracts, and grow stronger between runs with deep skill trees. Free to play - every run tells a different story.

apps.name: Desktop Island: Idle Together!
apps.short_description: Desktop Island is a co-op life sim to be enjoyed through both an active or idle playstyle. Play solo, or with up to 5 friends to restore your island and create a communal hub. Meet the inhabitants, choose your profession, master deep progression, and gather resources to build your dream island.

apps.name: Desktop Maid Haru
apps.short_description: Endless hours at your desk, staring at your monitor until Haru appears by your side. More than a simple desktop companion, she helps you stay focused, keeps track of your time, and talks with you through her built-in AI. Customize your desktop and share your space with Haru

apps.name: Desktop MMO Guild Manager
apps.short_description: While you play your main game, your taskbar guild is fighting too. A tiny MMO guild lives at the bottom of your screen and keeps you company: guildmates hunt, play a match every hour and grow stronger, aiming for the top league title. Characters retire. Your guildmates don't.

apps.name: Desktop Slime Graveyard: Tap Reaper
apps.short_description: Slimes are invading your desktop, and every keystroke becomes a powerful counterattack. Unlock all kinds of weapons, draw wildly inventive artifacts, and collect strange and wonderful slimes. Fight alone or team up with friends to give the slimes a beating!

apps.name: DesktopHeart
apps.short_description: More than a mascot to watch: a 3D girl who lives on your Windows desktop. She lounges on window edges, naps, and hops between windows. Toss her around, have her sing to your music, dress and undress her piece by piece, and restyle her hair and eyes. Transparent overlay, one-time purchase.

apps.name: Destroyed Aperture
apps.short_description: Destroyed Aperture is a free community-made Portal 2 mod featuring a new full-blown campaign with 20+ levels of exploration and logic-based puzzles. Journey through a decaying Aperture facility, discover new testing elements, and uncover the truth buried in your forgotten past.

apps.name: Destruction Snake
apps.short_description: In Destruction Snake, you start with a basic mechanical snake and dive into swarms of enemies. Weave through the battlefield, shoot, burn, freeze, and destroy your way through the horde, collecting scattered resources to continuously strengthen your build.

apps.name: Devil May Cry 3: Special Edition
apps.short_description: Dante's past is now revealed as Devil May Cry returns to its roots.  Master Dante's multiple fighting styles while battling never before seen demons and new characters as you fight your way towards a brutal confrontation with Dante's mysterious twin brother, Vergil.

apps.name: DEVOUT
apps.short_description: In a world where angels and Heaven are real, a grieving young man seeks to witness them in order to be reunited with his deceased wife. Pray, explore, and suffer in the name of your devotion as you quell dangers and make your way to the visitation site.

apps.name: Dicewood
apps.short_description: A tiny pack of tiny creatures was lost in the woods. The food was scarce, they had to choose who will be left behind... Fight through the dark forest and save all the creatures.

apps.name: Dicey Darlings
apps.short_description: Dicey Darlings is a tabletop-style, turn-based tactical roguelike. Lead standees across hex battlefields as physical dice tumble into play. Choose your route, combine skills and items, and use positioning and terrain to beat tough foes. The dice bring chance. You choose your next move.

apps.name: Die Asche von Dornhain
apps.short_description: A fully voiced German narrative game where choices open different scenes, relationships, and endings. Levin and his friends can die, go missing, or survive profoundly changed. No single playthrough reveals the whole story.

apps.name: Die or Die
apps.short_description: Roll the dice and choose how you will die. Die or Die is a top-down shooter roguelite where you run, shoot and dodge enemies to get dice with which to disable threats or unlock abilities. Roll. Die. Repeat.

apps.name: Dig into the Orefields
apps.short_description: A top-down action shooter with persistent incremental progression. Mine Venia's materials, fight the Klapperiden, upgrade your mining ship, and rebuild your crashed mothership piece by piece to escape the planet.

apps.name: Digging Up
apps.short_description: Digging Up is a 1-4 player co-op digging adventure where you drill through a destructible alien planet, gather valuable resources, upgrade your gear, explore underground biomes, and dig your way back to the surface.

apps.name: DJ Little Rabbit and the Battle of the Beatz!
apps.short_description: DJ Little Rabbit and the Battle of the Beatz is an all-ages adventure blending high-energy rhythm-action gameplay with heartfelt RPG storytelling. Join Little Rabbit’s journey to win the ‘Battle of the Beatz,’ become a legendary DJ, and reclaim his family’s lost honor.

apps.name: Do You Know Me?
apps.short_description: How well do you REALLY know your friends? Answer questions about each other alone in soundproof booths, vote on who’s most likely to do something stupid, then survive chaotic co-op challenges. 1-8 players.

apps.name: Dodgeball Rush
apps.short_description: Fast third-person arcade dodgeball. Charge it, throw it, catch it, knock them out. Every catch can flip the match. Play solo against bots or with friends: up to 4 players on local split screen, co-op or versus. Free playtest opens in November.

apps.name: Dolly's Breeding Party
apps.short_description: A housewife with a loving husband, a very specific itch he can't scratch, and five men lined up to help. Infidelity, breeding kink, and the thrill of doing exactly what you shouldn't. A short, story-driven adult visual novel with animated scenes.

apps.name: Dolpen
apps.short_description: Join a penguin and a dolphin on a 2D pixel-art underwater adventure in search of hidden treasures! Explore the ocean, collect treasure chests, and bring them back before time runs out. Catch fish to grow stronger, equip items, unlock upgrades, and venture into the unexplored depths of the ocean!

apps.name: Don't Drop It
apps.short_description: Carry a fragile power core to its socket with a friend, and don't drop it! Whoever holds it can't jump: throw, catch and keep passing. Swinging cranes, steam jets and crumbling floors stand in your way.

apps.name: Don't Panic, Defend!
apps.short_description: Your soldiers fight on their own. You decide how they grow! Recruit troops, pick races and combine synergies to build a stronger army. It grows as enemies get tougher. Conquer six regions and beat their bosses. Lose, and you only lose gold: gear, star map and talents stay. Adjust and fight again.

apps.name: Dour Tower
apps.short_description: Stomp your way through floor after floor of a monster infested tower to reach the vampire king who stole all your blood and get it back.

apps.name: Dracanea: The Ragtag Regalia
apps.short_description: Dracanea: The Ragtag Regalia is a comedy adventure RPG featuring a washed-up hero who's turning 30, with talking dogs and hamburger monsters! Solve puzzles in the overworld to collect items, engage in turn-based battles with fighting-game button inputs, and even learn 150+ cooking recipes!

apps.name: Dragon Tribe Chronicles
apps.short_description: An epic strategy deck builder RPG where You play as one of the last True Dragons. A shapeshifting being capable of harnessing the power of slayed beings.

apps.name: Draught King
apps.short_description: The world's first pub-like. A deckbuilder where your cards are the ingredients - serve drinks to customers to meet an ever-increasing target, featuring crazy combos and insane effects.

apps.name: Dread Line: Metro
apps.short_description: Dive into abandoned metro tunnels overrun by mutant creatures. Find valuable loot, stay quiet, and try not to get ripped to pieces.

apps.name: Dream Fishing
apps.short_description: Explore atmospheric dream worlds and catch strange fish. Uncover secrets that have been submerged.

apps.name: DreeM Ascension
apps.short_description: Explore the DreeMScape Darklands and uncover it's dark secrets in this story-driven survival horror boomer shooter.

apps.name: Drop That Pen
apps.short_description: Drop your pen through cursed pegs, bounce it into the cauldrons below, and upgrade your board between rounds in this hand-drawn, slightly haunted roguelite pachinko.

apps.name: Drudgemark
apps.short_description: The dark marches on the King's Realm and you stand at its border. Forge steel, build up your keep and command your soldiers in formation. Then draw your own blade and fight beside them in first person, alone or with your friends in co-op.

apps.name: Druid of Hungwood
apps.short_description: An Adult Gay RPG/Visual Novel! The village of Hungwood is under attack, but where are all the heroes? An evil knight has imprisoned them all, allowing enemies to wreak havoc! It's up to the merchant/leaf-caster Rodin to form a party formidable enough to rescue the heroes and save Hungwood!

apps.name: Duck Casino: Gambling Simulator
apps.short_description: Bet big with fake money, losing never hurts! 12 casino games in one: Dice, Plinko, Mines, Blackjack, Roulette, Slots, Crash and more. Go all-in with a million? Sure. Broke? Top up with more fake cash and keep playing.

apps.name: Dulat
apps.short_description: Dulat is a puzzle-platformer where you manipulate how you interact with matter to overcome obstacles and restart the universe. Embark on this adventure, unravel its mysteries, and discover the secrets behind a broken world.

apps.name: Dumpster Gang
apps.short_description: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

apps.name: Dungeon Buster
apps.short_description: Build the dungeon. Send in your hero. Extract the loot. Grow stronger. Dungeon Buster is an incremental dungeon-building autobattler RPG built around permanent progression and deeper expeditions.

apps.name: Dungeon Dreams Wanderers
apps.short_description: Travel, form bonds, explore a vast world filled with multiple-outcome quests, with your custom created protagonist in an adventure that blends old school JRPG, life simulation and role playing.

apps.name: Dungeon Parkour Block Puzzle Adventure 2
apps.short_description: Use blocks falling from the ceiling to build a path for the adventurer.  Uncover the mystery why the blocks keep falling from the ceiling. Solve the puzzles and finally the mystery. The puzzle adventure continues.

apps.name: Dungeon Raiders
apps.short_description: Dungeon Raiders is a dungeon exploration game. Illuminate the dark with voice lights, avoid monsters, collect relics, and escape safely. Sell relics to gear up and meet the company quota every 3 days. One more look, or head back now? Challenge yourself against escalating quotas in limited time.

apps.name: Dungeonhand
apps.short_description: A single-player horror game about being hunted while you work. The contractors have given you ten nights to dig your debt out of an ancient dungeon. Everything you are carrying is lost when you die, and every death costs you one of the nights.

apps.name: Dungeonmancer
apps.short_description: A solo action-exploration dungeon crawler about defeating monsters, collecting loot, and overcoming bosses.

apps.name: DuoFall
apps.short_description: Pieces fall from the top and rise from the bottom - and you play both fields at once. Can you do it? Longer than your friends? Challenge them: same seed, live duel or leaderboard - every run is proven by replay. One mind. Two fields. Many blocks.

apps.name: Dusky Depths
apps.short_description: Withstand an onslaught of enemies and survive against all odds in this rogue-lite twin-stick shooter. Stranded on an uncharted planet, you will need to scavange for rare loot, upgrade your ship, and unlock ancient mechanisms to escape this strange and hostile place – solo or with friends.

apps.name: Dustium
apps.short_description: Dustium is a turn-based tactics roguelite where you analyze enemy actions and plan multiple moves for three characters in advance. You may know what the enemy will do, but predicting the outcome is up to you.

apps.name: Dustwire
apps.short_description: A co-op PvPvE extraction shooter made by two brothers. Drop into Wirehaven, a colorful overgrown city run by machines: loot, fight hunter drones and massive machine bosses, outplay rival squads, and reach extraction alive - or lose everything you carried in.

apps.name: DwarVein
apps.short_description: Welcome to DwarVein, a world where you a trusty dwarf venture forth into inhabited caves on the search for valuable Gems. Careful though, there are creatures lurking in the dark abyss. They have stolen your trusted companions and hid them within the caves! Will you achieve the highest score!?

apps.name: DYFWAS: Destroy Your Friends With Awesome Stuff
apps.short_description: Shoot, jump and smash your friends to pieces in arenas where anything can happen. Stack a wild variety of bonuses and build the playstyle that suits you, from brutal to twisted. 2–6 players: online, local with friends, or co-op against monsters.

apps.name: Dystopia VS Distortion
apps.short_description:
Build the ultimate pedalboard and crush despair with your sound!
A single-player pedalboard-building battle game. Rearrange your pedals to transform your tone and fight with a sound of your own.

apps.name: Echos of Eras
apps.short_description: Time broke, and you've been thrown back to the dawn of history. Cross the ages, from the Stone Age to the dinosaurs, and bond with the Echoes of each era. You don't catch them: win a turn-based battle and they may choose to follow you. A pixel-art creature RPG.

apps.name: Edenfall
apps.short_description: Unveil a mystical action-adventure where you shift between human, wolf, raccoon, and raven. Weave fluid combos across forms, purge corruption, and awaken the land’s lost beauty. Together with your spirit fox companion, embark on a soulbound journey of transformation, memory, and inner peace.

apps.name: Edenwound
apps.short_description: A brutally difficult dungeon crawler rpg with roguelike elements. Face the horrors of Eden and discover the secrets buried deep within the abyss...

apps.name: EEL KNOW:Perfect Pitch
apps.short_description:
Use the adorable garden eels' stretchy movements as clues to identify the notes in a melody!

Collect medals, fill your eel collection, and create custom melodies up to 32 bars to share with friends and stream viewers in this oddly addictive, laid-back music quiz game.

apps.name: Eletta
apps.short_description: Eletta is a mischievous action-adventure where you turn the environment into a weapon, setting up clever and chaotic traps to outwit enemies in ways that are equal parts hilarious and slightly devious.

apps.name: Elleros Origins: Season I
apps.short_description: Hi, We are merging this game with Elleros: Wytchsun. Everyone who purchased or used a trial key for Greylaw will receive a free copy of Elleros: Wytchsun when it is released. This title will become unsupported, and merged with Wytchsun. Thank you to everyone who participated in the limited run trial.

apps.name: Ember Folks
apps.short_description: Expand your city, summon an army of workers, mine resources and heat a dying star to millions of degrees in this incremental adventure. Discover new upgrades and synergies, prestige to unlock new mechanics and watch numbers go up - a lot.

apps.name: Emoji Battlefield - Island Warfare
apps.short_description: A chaotic rogue-like FPS set on a mysterious island where ancient tiki emojis rise to attack! Choose modifiers, unlock new arenas, and survive endless waves of emoji warriors. Dash, jump, shoot, and use jungle traps or temple hazards to outsmart the swarm.

apps.name: Enarian: Orbital Command
apps.short_description: A spaceship based RTS/RPG Hybrid, take command from your own outpost and lead wings of fighters, bombers, frigates and more, against powerful enemy fleets. Defend, Assault, Hack, Repair and Recover cargo for corporations and pirate factions building the strength of your ship and notoriety.

apps.name: Endless; Melody—NEMESIS
apps.short_description: The world ends, and so our story begins. Return to the world of Gaia for one last adventure, one final story before it is forever lost beneath the shadows of legends.

apps.name: Epica Primera
apps.short_description: Turn-based JRPG. Guide a group of cute girls through the forest and try to survive the horrors lurking inside using a language-based syntax spell system.

apps.name: Epoch Extinction
apps.short_description: A tense top-down survival shooter where dinosaurs overrun abandoned towns and forests. Scavenge resources, craft tools, and make hard decisions while deadly predators hunt you through familiar human spaces.

apps.name: Eras Showdown
apps.short_description: An auto-battler where the shop doesn't sell a single weapon. It sells materials — Stone Age to far future — and you forge the rest. Line up eight units, gear them, and send them against the saved formations of real players. Ten wins take the run. Ten losses end it.

apps.name: Escape from Gridlock
apps.short_description: A single-player turn-based pixel-art tactical extraction game. Enter the sealed-off zone, scavenge supplies, complete tasks, fight enemies, and extract before things fall apart. Bring loot back to your base, craft gear, unlock weapon skills, and prepare for the next expedition.

apps.name: Escape from Planet Pan: Scam Center
apps.short_description: A fake job offer traps you inside the notorious Planet Pan Scam Center. Enduring daily abuse from guards, you are forced to scam strangers into fake investments while secretly planning an escape. A unique Butterfly Effect system brings past characters into future runs so you can change their fate.

apps.name: Eswahr Eternal
apps.short_description: Eswahr Eternal wants you to become a King. You will wander across an eternal Kingdom. You will slay the four Giants of the Land. You will sacrifice your Principles for Power. You will take the Throne. You will rule. For Eternity.

apps.name: EtheriiA - Travelogue
apps.short_description: Etheriia - Travelogue is an adult visual novel where players set off on a sensual journey across different universes, from sci-fi to medieval to elven, fixing visual glitches and restoring order.

apps.name: Event Horizon Inc.
apps.short_description: A co-op space salvage game at the edge of a black hole. You and up to 3 friends fly a small tug down, cut loot out of wrecked ships and haul it home. But time runs slower down there: every minute you stay costs the big ship waiting above hours, and it won't wait forever.

apps.name: EVERHOLD
apps.short_description: EVERHOLD is a fast-paced isometric survival game where you face increasingly dangerous enemies and powerful bosses. Choose your character, level up, collect powerful weapons and items, and fight your way to the end.

apps.name: Excalibur's Swordstone Idle Forge
apps.short_description: Excalibur's Swordstone Idle Forge is a cozy little medieval clicker with a big appetite. You're a blacksmith pulling legendary swords from stones, handing them to knights, and stacking gold higher and higher

apps.name: EXOSHOCK
apps.short_description: EXOSHOCK is a 1–4 player co-op sci-fi PvE shooter driven by one vision: to deliver the most visceral combat. A hybrid co-op FPS where VR and PC players fight together in the same squad. Full cross-play. Play solo with AI teammates or in 4-player co-op. Solo works offline.

apps.name: Expeditionary Sustainment Command
apps.short_description: Command a U.S. Army Sustainment Company in a punishing military strategy campaign. Scout threats, clear routes, escort supplies, and lead armored and infantry offensives. Upgrade your fleet, develop your NCOs, and face the consequences of every loss.

apps.name: Extracto Proviso
apps.short_description: Sent to a distant planet to feed a war you never chose, you are the perfect extraction machine. Build sprawling automated factories, survive a wilderness that fights back, and uncover whispers in the soil that make you question your directive. Extract everything. Then decide who it's for.

apps.name: Eyes on Me
apps.short_description: Play Ashley as she becomes an adult influencer discovers her sexuality and see just how far you will go to please others. Will you stay an innocent fashion student or transform into an adult star

apps.name: FACTORIZE: 1
apps.short_description: 2 attacks. 3 defends. 5 heals. Combine cards to create numbers and fight with the power of primes in this turn-based deckbuilding roguelite. Factorization is automatic—read the enemy, build the number you need, and find your own answer from the same hand.

apps.name: Factory on a Train
apps.short_description: Mine, craft and extend your Factory on a Train! As you find more resources and unlock increasingly complex recipes, your train grows and your production increases. Choose the right cars to face the challenges of a post-apocalyptic wasteland.

apps.name: Factory Works Idle
apps.short_description: Build an automated industrial empire from stone tools to singularity tech. Click, automate, and research through 10 eras, then breach reality to conquer parallel dimensions with unique rules, resources, and threats. Idle factory builder with deep prestige and cross-dimensional logistics.

apps.name: Fading Faith
apps.short_description: A first-person dungeon crawler beneath Jerusalem. Your only weapon is a torch. When the Bells ring, loot doubles and the dark drains your Faith. Pay the city by night, or become another Gilded Dead.

apps.name: Fairwind
apps.short_description: FAIRWIND is a relaxing open-world sailing game about delivering cargo to distant ports. Deliver cargo, trade with merchants, upgrade your ship and discover new islands as you build trade routes across a vast archipelago. Play alone or with friends in 4-player co-op!

apps.name: FAKE ME
apps.short_description: Model, paint, and blend in! FAKE ME is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you create your own disguise. Use simple 3D modeling tools to build the object you’ll hide as. You can also create your own costume by modeling. Hide from the Seekers or find every Faker before time runs out!

apps.name: False Fortune
apps.short_description: False Fortune is a modern crime RPG where you investigate the conspiracy that framed you, rebuild your fortune, buy businesses and homes, find love, marry, take honeymoons and vacations in a living, breathing world, and shape Adrian Vale’s future through evidence, leverage, redemption, or revenge.

apps.name: Fat Goblins
apps.short_description: Prepare for goblin-packed, hat-stealing, and princess-fattening team based 16v16 combat! Siege the castle walls, rescue your pudgy princess, fatten up the enemy princess with delicious meat, unlock new hats & weapons, and kill each other repeatedly in silly and chaotic PvP war!

apps.name: Feltfall
apps.short_description: Fluffy felt animals. A merciless time limit. Feltfall is a roguelite deckbuilder about pulling off a harvest festival on a tiny wool-felt island. Pick your route, gather materials, craft cards on the spot, survive the storm-night showdowns, then answer a flood of animal requests at the festival.

apps.name: Femme Fury(Pure Classic Simple Action Game)
apps.short_description:
A fast-paced action game with a taste for lowbrow sexuality.
No puzzles. No complicated progression. Just you, your enemies, and a little bit of strategy. Use your surroundings, outsmart your enemies, and find your own way to take them down.
Simple, shameless, and unapologetically trashy.

apps.name: Fetch & Fire
apps.short_description: Fetch & Fire is a fast-paced FPS where every bullet matters. Shoot, move, retrieve your bullets, and keep the fight going. Master your weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and battle through intense combat arenas. How fast can you kill before you run out of bullets?

apps.name: Fetch()
apps.short_description: Fetch() is a top-down territory game where you never touch the controls. Write a Lua script and your dog does exactly what it says, which is occasionally what you meant. Mark more tiles than the other packs before the clock runs out and the ground is yours.

apps.name: Feuds
apps.short_description: A turn-based game of feuding rulers. Take a realm one contested land at a time, and settle every claim in a compact tactical battle where each unit you place is a promise, each arrow a threat, and every tile you hold is counted when the dust settles.

apps.name: FGTeeV Goozy
apps.short_description: Explore a house full of weird technology and slimy surprises as you attempt to save the FGTeeV family.

apps.name: Fighting Front
apps.short_description: Fighting Front is a retro-inspired turn-based strategy wargame. Command your forces, capture territory, and secure resources across procedurally generated battlefields. Fight on hexagonal, triangular, or square maps against challenging AI opponents.

apps.name: FILE 13
apps.short_description: A psychological horror game played entirely on a fake Egyptian desktop. Recover deleted files, read the metadata and follow the clues to find a woman missing for 14 months. Every answer pulls you deeper. Helping her is the mistake.

apps.name: Final Answer
apps.short_description: Your knowledge is your weapon in this deadly trivia roguelite. Answer questions to attack, collect powerful relics, and build unstoppable combinations. One wrong answer could end your run. Can you survive the Trivia Master's game show?

apps.name: Finders, Keepers
apps.short_description: Night work at St. Ossian's: go down into crypts that never end, carry up cursed and blessed relics, and sell them to the Keeper. Every curse pays better and frays your nerve. Die below and your haul stays down there with you, waiting for you to come back for it.

apps.name: Firewheels Tidy Up Sort Together
apps.short_description: A cozy co-op organizing sim in a diecast toy car shop. Sort 7,600+ blister cards and collector boxes of 200 car models onto peg walls, glass cabinets and giant wheel shelves, solo or with up to 4 players. Unlock skills and turn the pile-up into a perfect display.

apps.name: Firezone S.A.
apps.short_description: Explore a massive open world across iconic global cities. Drive, build businesses, take on missions, evade the law, grow your influence, and choose your path through crime, ambition, wealth, and power.

apps.name: Fishing Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Catch fish, build your store, and sell your catches!  Explore a mysterious world to find new areas, and new fish to catch.  Decorate to get wealthier customers to buy your big catches.  As you build up your store, a town will evolve around you!

apps.name: Fishing Store Simulator
apps.short_description: Open and manage your own fishing tackle shop! Stock the shelves, set prices, track trends in the newspaper, advise customers on the right gear, and expand your store. Grow your business solo or in co-op with friends!

apps.name: Flame & Blame
apps.short_description: A first-person co-op comedy for up to 4 firefighters who are very bad at their job. Drive the truck, blast the fire, rescue the panda, and blame each other when it all goes up in smoke. Bad at fires. Great at friendship.

apps.name: Flesh Mill
apps.short_description: ENTER THE CAMP. FEED THE MACHINE. BECOME SOMETHING WORSE. Flesh Mill is an incremental horror RPG where prisoners are nothing but fuel for your ascent. Grow stronger, unlock grotesque upgrades, and face increasingly horrific bosses in brutal turn-based combat.

apps.name: Flightless
apps.short_description: Emerge from an egg as a baby penguin, learning to waddle, slide, and live life as a penguin should in a dreamy post-apocalyptic Antarctica. Find your way in a wordless story of meetings and separations.

apps.name: FLIP OVER
apps.short_description: FLIP OVER is a puzzle game where you flip tiles to turn every tile white. Flip tiles with different rules and enjoy puzzles in many forms.

apps.name: Flume
apps.short_description: A pixel-art puzzle roguelike where every run is different. Flip tiles, swap cards from your hand and build a route to the finish before the flow catches up.

apps.name: Fogreaver
apps.short_description:
Shoot zombies. Earn cash. Take back your Base Camp and clear the surrounding areas. Bring home supplies, upgrade your weapons and head out for more.
Wake the hordes, lure them into traps or fight from horseback. Kill every last infected to keep what you earned. Then gear up for the next run.

apps.name: Food Delivery Simulator 2027 - Prologue
apps.short_description: Take orders on your phone, pick up meals from restaurants serving world cuisines and deliver them across a living city on foot, by bike, scooter or car. Start your courier career with the Prologue of Food Delivery Simulator 2027!

apps.name: Fool's Trigger
apps.short_description: Welcome to the table where life is the stake. Fool’s Trigger is a tense mix of Russian roulette and a card game for 6. Load your revolver, manipulate the cards, put lives on the line, and dare to find out who will be the unluckiest today.

apps.name: Forgotten Flower
apps.short_description: A mysterious adventure focused on exploration, puzzle-solving, and choice-driven progression as two young nobles navigate a mansion that warps into a mysterious and dangerous world after a sudden disaster. Will you uncover the truth hidden within its shifting halls before the darkness consumes you?

apps.name: Formula Cat
apps.short_description: Race robot vacuums as Mochi, a rookie cat chasing a championship. Take on 21 rivals across 31 circuits, master battery-swap pit stops, and choose a 10-chapter story, an open career, or a single race. Remap your controls and change difficulty anytime.

apps.name: Forsaken Lands
apps.short_description: A hardcore survival sandbox where 99% of humanity is gone. Scavenge, build, craft, drive, and endure brutal weather, storm hordes, and the infected. Alone or with friends, every day is borrowed time, one bite is all it takes.

apps.name: Frankenmine
apps.short_description: An incremental game where you dig through cursed tombs, harvest bones, flesh, and various resources; stitch together your own creature from nothing. Discover powerful artifacts, experiment with unique combinations, and bring your creation to life—piece by piece.

apps.name: FRAY
apps.short_description: Fray is an intense hack-and-slash arena fighter where warriors from five ancient civilizations—Aztecs, Egyptians, Greeks, Japanese, and Vikings—battle for supremacy. Spawn with nothing, fight for weapons, and master fluid combat to claim victory.

apps.name: Freakshow CardGame
apps.short_description: Welcome to the Freakshow! Battle your friends in this turn-based strategy between two players and their army of "Freaks". Build your own teams and explore wacky characters and different strategies in this free-to-play brand new card game.

apps.name: Frog Telephone
apps.short_description: Frog Telephone (蛙电话 / 蛙電話) is a folklore mystery adventure game rooted in computer science concepts. You play as an amnesiac phone operator at a Tokyo travel agency, reconstructing shattered reality through the spin of a dial, exploring the terrifying truth hidden behind Gero City's mystery.

apps.name: Frogs Can Jump
apps.short_description: Poke one frog and watch the whole pond jump. A cozy pixel-art chain-reaction incremental game: build longer chains, spend your coins on upgrades, open nine ponds that each play by their own rule, and knock the Toad King off his throne.

apps.name: From Dust We Came
apps.short_description: Competitive multiplayer FPS where the map is brand new every match. Nobody knows the layout, so it all comes down to how you play. Level up, master your guns, climb ranked, and bring your whole squad along.

apps.name: From the Ranks
apps.short_description: Enlist as a foot soldier in a grounded medieval tactical RPG. Control Rowan in turn-based battles while your comrades fight on their own. Choose your company, issue limited orders, and earn promotion through a campaign where recruits can die for good.

apps.name: Frontier Control : Invasion
apps.short_description: Frontier Control: Invasion is a Real-Time Strategy survival game in which you play the commander of a human space colony under the attack of outer space robots. Build your base, train your colony, and fight herds of enemies and bosses.

apps.name: FROSTVAULT
apps.short_description: Chip, melt and laser your way through giant blocks of ice to free the treasures frozen inside. Sell them, shelve them, upgrade your cozy glacier workshop, dig out on the ice with your cat Kartopu, and one day free the great mammoth sleeping in the glacier.

apps.name: Full Deck: Euchre, Spades, Hearts, and More
apps.short_description: Eight trick-taking card games in one deck - Euchre and four special versions, plus Spades, and Hearts. Learn each from a tutorial that deals you a real hands it plays it with you. Rewrite house rules to match how your family plays. No internet connection needed.

apps.name: Fusa
apps.short_description: Pet Pochi, earn purrs and turn an empty room into a home full of cats. Fusa is a relaxing pixel-art incremental game: furnish with over 140 pieces, watch your cats nap, play and ask for food, and grow your colony up to thirty companions.

apps.name: GACHA TACTICS
apps.short_description: MINIATURE TACTICS is a tabletop miniature autobattler. Choose pieces from the shop and arrange them on connected hex terrain. Combine skills, collect relics, and field transforming and combining robots as you aim for ten wins.

apps.name: GARITO
apps.short_description: A rigged slot machine refuses to pay. Rig it back. GARITO is a slots roguelike where you edit the reels mid-spin, wire your own paylines, and beat the payout out of boss machines — one strike at a time.

apps.name: Gate Singular
apps.short_description: One logic gate. Unlimited possibilities. Build circuits of millions of gates and run them on a blazing-fast simulator. Follow a guided tutorial from the basics to a working CPU, or design devices of any complexity on your own. Co-op included.

apps.name: Gbike
apps.short_description: Plasma bikes past 1,000 km/h on magnetic ribbon tracks laid over giant anime girls who are just living their day. Loops, wall rides, cannons, a 12-rider pack — and a story mode with cutscenes and on-foot stages. A futuristic racer in the spirit of the late '90s.

apps.name: GCR4 Geoff Crammond
apps.short_description: Geoff Crammond Racing 4 marks the return of a legendary sim racing experience. Featuring authentic driving physics, dynamic AI, full race weekends, and Steam Workshop support, GCR4 lets you relive the golden era of open-wheel racing with customization, realism, and depth.

apps.name: Gear Notes -ogre slayer-
apps.short_description: Japanese dark fantasy action RPG inspired by Momotaro. Experience fast-paced combat with combos, parries, and real-time character switching.

apps.name: GET FIT - Men's Fitness
apps.short_description: Train with pro trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer, level, and routine — then jump into 30 minutes of intense, rewarding, and ever-changing full-body workouts.

apps.name: Ghost Express
apps.short_description: Ghost Express" is a 2D storage-organizing puzzle game about Spooky, a ghost who's too cute to scare anyone. Fit each shop's goods into boxes piece by piece, then deliver them to the apartment next door. As the orders pile up and space runs out, can Spooky get the job done?

apps.name: Ghost Receipt - A Cyberpunk Pawnshop Simulator
apps.short_description: Run a cyberpunk pawn shop in a neon-soaked city. Buy, sell, negotiate deals, investigate mysterious items, and piece together customer stories through the items they bring, the secrets they hide, and the risks you choose to take and the profits they bring.

apps.name: GHOSTLESS
apps.short_description: Lead an uprising against AI in a post-apocalyptic world where you’re never sure who is human and who is machine. Scavenge for resources, find survivors to grow your base, root out android infiltrators and lead the resistance in a unique hybrid of 2.5D action-adventure and colony building.

apps.name: Ghosts Cast No Shadow
apps.short_description: In this cozy deduction game you keep a village gate at night in Joseon-era Korea, and some who knock are yogoe, monsters of Korean folktales in human guise. Raise a lantern, check the registry and ask questions, then let the humans in and seal the yogoe in a gourd with a talisman. Ten nights a run.

apps.name: Gimby
apps.short_description: Guard the Skull and Crown of the dead King of the Underworld. Explore, hunt, fish and build by day, then hold your tower against the horde each night.

apps.name: Girl & Scarecrow
apps.short_description: Something rotten roams the night. Venture deep into the woods behind your grandfather's house and track down an aviary lost to time in this fantasy visual novel game set in rural New Zealand.

apps.name: Glowing Dim
apps.short_description: Glowing Dim is a precision platformer where every jump counts. Guide Nina, a fire spirit who can only survive moments away from flame, through the Colombian Andes on her journey to become a shooting star. Master challenging levels, chain precise movements, and keep your flame alive.

apps.name: Go! Go! Shovelcar!
apps.short_description: Forget boring construction work! Take the dual-stick controls of a real physics excavator to scoop goldfish, make bento boxes, whack tanukis, and demolish houses. Earn your license, customize your rig, or let loose in the Sandbox!

apps.name: GOAL2D
apps.short_description: Fast, top-down, skill-based football: three-minute matches, five-a-side teams,s and one rule: whoever handles the ball best wins. In GOAL,2,D every shot, pass, and dribble is yours. Nothing is automatic, nothing is luck.

apps.name: Goblin Chief
apps.short_description: 3rd person PvPvE ARPG: Aid your goblin tribe on their quest to restore a Goblin Chief to the throne. Explore a goblin-centric world full of splendors and perils while dominating battlegrounds against the fractured tribes and invading forces.

apps.name: Goblin Mode: Loot & Lunacy
apps.short_description: A chaotic online co-op adventure for 2–4 players. Steal and throw shinies with your friends then build goblin technology to further your schemes. Destroy a village in a goblin truck then pickup the scraps or climb inside a trenchcoat with your friends and be a human for the day.

apps.name: God's Game
apps.short_description: A young woman is reborn as a princess in a fantasy world. Haunted by memories of her past, she feels out of place and detached, but at least there is peace... until the death game begins once again.

apps.name: Gonfalon
apps.short_description: A medieval real time strategy game where you plant banners instead of clicking every soldier. Grow a village, unlock buildings, survive ghosts and yetis, and march your army to conquer every rival kingdom.

apps.name: Goodbye, Mr. Sato
apps.short_description: An exhausted Japanese salaryman has seven days to get through. Work shifts, karaoke, humiliating rituals, and grotesque encounters collide in a genre-shifting psychological horror game where obedience has a price, but so does fighting back.

apps.name: Gooner Theft Auto Sex
apps.short_description: Gooner Theft Auto Sex is a chaotic third-person crime shooter set in Vile City - a place filled with gangs, guns, dangerous women, and extremely bad decisions.

apps.name: Gramps & Whiskers
apps.short_description: A grumpy old fisherman sits on your Windows taskbar and fishes while you work. His cat climbs your windows, naps on his lap and steals his catch. Dress them both up with hats and gear that grandpa fishes up along the way.

apps.name: Grave Orbit
apps.short_description: Defend a lone Core against waves from every direction. Collect the scrap enemies leave behind, build production chains and automated turrets, then carry your upgrades into the next, harder chapter. A sci-fi base-defense campaign across 4 acts, plus prequel and skirmish modes.

apps.name: Grid Forge TD
apps.short_description: Stop continuous waves of enemies by building a maze in this free flowing tower defense game. Purchase upgrades between runs to become even more powerful and go further next time.

apps.name: GRIDLOCK GAMBIT
apps.short_description: A chess-themed roguelike tower defense. Carve out the enemy's path yourself, place white chess pieces as towers, and hold back the oncoming horde. Advance each tower along its evolution tree to make it stronger and unlock devastating ultimate moves.

apps.name: Grimhold
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelike tower defense. Hold the wall against endless legions across ten acts, command 23 unique heroes and forge runs that never repeat. Every wave you survive is a choice; every choice reshapes the siege. How long can Grimhold hold?

apps.name: Grounds Crew
apps.short_description: Mow it. Blow it. Plow it. Take on 80 grounds-keeping jobs with a robot mower, a tractor and gang mower, a leaf blower and a snow blower. Lay perfect stripes, clear every leaf and push back the snow, from backyards and golf courses to castles and Christmas markets.

apps.name: Guess What's Behind!
apps.short_description: Guess the absurd image behind you while your friends give clues without saying the forbidden words. Simple, chaotic, hilarious!

apps.name: Guildmaster Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and lead your own adventurers' guild in a fantasy world. Recruit and train heroes, manage your guild, uncover legendary quests, and forge your reputation across four distinct regions. Every expedition brings new opportunities, difficult choices, and consequences that shape your guild's story.

apps.name: Guns & Goo
apps.short_description: Guns & Goo is a frantic 2D multiplayer shooter where fully destructible levels and constantly changing rules turn every battle into an unpredictable, laugh-out-loud showdown.

apps.name: GyroMon
apps.short_description:
GyroMon: The Seekers is a turn-based monster-collecting RPG with a roguelite heart. Pick your starter, build your team, and push through branching maps full of trainers, events, quests, campfires, merchants, and zone bosses. 
Every run is different. Every team is yours.

apps.name: HACKING INTO EREBUS
apps.short_description: HACKING INTO EREBUS is a terminal-driven hacking cyberpunk thriller. Jack into a hostile network and outsmart ARIA, a surveillance system that watches your every move. Breach nodes, override defenses and pry secrets from a crew trapped in cryosleep. Fight your way into Compartment Zero.

apps.name: Hakuroku Game Collection
apps.short_description: Hakuroku’s board games are coming to digital! The Early Access version is planned to include Hakoniwa Kings and Guild Build. Greedy Hunters! is planned to be added in an upcoming update.

apps.name: Halloween Fair: Tidy Up Together
apps.short_description: A little spooky. A lot to tidy. 2048 halloween items to be exact. Bring order to a moonlit Halloween fair in this cozy cleanup game for up to 4 players. Sort scattered decorations, earn festival sparks, and unlock upgrades that help the whole team turn a giant mess into a job well done.

apps.name: HamYam
apps.short_description: A fast-paced, competitive 2D platform racing game of hamsters competing through beautiful dream world tracks!

apps.name: Hanafuda Solitaire
apps.short_description: Ever wished Hanafuda had a way to play alone? Capture pairs and form yaku in pure Hanafuda, with new rules that let you play it solo, solitaire-style.

apps.name: Hanfall-Age of Stratagems
apps.short_description: Enter the turbulent world of late Han China in a single-player historical strategy game. Ink-wash landscapes and paper-inspired visuals frame an age of rival powers, human ambition and uncertain futures. Discover your own chapter in a changing era.

apps.name: Hanzi: Five Gates
apps.short_description: Combine 关 + 羽 into Guan Yu, or 枪 + 兵 into spearmen. Draw Chinese character tiles, build a six-slot formation, and let it fight automatically. Choose routes and relics, then rebuild your army around the tiles you find in this Three Kingdoms strategy roguelite.

apps.name: Hard To Get
apps.short_description: Hard To Get is a cheeky bullet heaven where you dodge relentless admirers while outrageous adult toys attack automatically. Customize your character, combine toys and upgrades, and survive increasingly wild parties.

apps.name: Hatch Flap
apps.short_description: Go on an adventure to find your lost little baby flamingo and bring it back home. Will you be able to move forward with the whole world against you?

apps.name: HAUL
apps.short_description: From broke and jobless to full-time flipper — source, clean, and resell your way through thrift stores, blue bins, and sketchy meetups in a small-town hustle sim.

apps.name: Hay in a Needlestack
apps.short_description: Someone lost a piece of hay in a pile of 50 million needles. Dig it out alone or with up to 5 friends. Bare hands bleed. Climbing bleeds. The deep needles are rusty. Melt what you dig into metal and build drills, machines, and drones to dig faster, or trade it for bandages and tetanus shots.

apps.name: Heir of the Dog
apps.short_description: A hilariously British point & click adventure. After drinking his uncle's secret formula, Cummerbund Bandersnatch undergoes a monstrous transformation. Solve puzzles, manipulate time and uncover the truth behind Victorian London's most secret society as you regain your humanity.

apps.name: Hell is Neon Colored
apps.short_description: A minimalist twin-stick shooter drenched in neon glow. Deep weapon customization and more than 350 weapon and ability combinations provide your arsenal as you delve deep in rogue-lite progression and complex mounting challenges.

apps.name: Hell Wait
apps.short_description: HELL WAIT is riichi mahjong crossed with roguelike deckbuilding. Stack your jokers. Upgrade your yaku. Try not to deal in. You'll need those fingers.

apps.name: Heroes Guard: Starforge
apps.short_description: Design and customize your fleet, get to know a colorful cast of pilots, and shape how they fight through personal feedback. Then send them into battle and watch your strategies and their personalities play out.

apps.name: Heroes Together VR
apps.short_description: Heroes Together VR is a 4-player co-op roguelite dungeon crawler. Pick your Hero, fight your way through Gobi Gulch, and figure out how to work as a team, because no run goes the same way twice.

apps.name: Heroic Frontline: Dawn Hymn
apps.short_description: This medieval‑fantasy card‑battle game focuses on hardcore combat and strategic gameplay. Breaking traditional one‑on‑one card duels, it deeply integrates hero progression, good‑evil conflict and town‑linked mechanics for a tactically‑rich, epic card battlefield.

apps.name: Hexing
apps.short_description: An incremental roguelike tower defense deckbuilder where strategic hex placement creates a self-sustaining dungeon. Build monster synergies, survive relentless hero waves, and prepare for the Demon Lord's arrival.

apps.name: Hextalia
apps.short_description: Build the path. Then defend it. Hextalia is a hex-based tower defense where you control the battlefield. Shape enemy routes with your towers, combine abilities to discover your own build combinations, and survive levels that punish careless builds.

apps.name: High Level Alchemy: Scenarios
apps.short_description: An anthology of action and slice-of-life short stories, following a group of not-so-"good" Alchemists, navigating brutal and bloody battles and the messy reality of living alongside each other.
publishers: North American Digital Institute of Arts

apps.name: High Roller Penny
apps.short_description: A bold pachinko-inspired roguelike. With bunny girls. Build your best pegboard with special pegs, balls and passive effects to reach legendary scores. Lose and get executed on the spot. Oh did we mention this is a death game?

apps.name: Highland Haven
apps.short_description: Discover your own private haven in the Scottish Highlands and bring this once thriving home for hairy “coos” back to life. Craft goodies to sell, optimize your farm, and grow a pasture of cute highland cows roaming free on the bottom of your screen in this relaxing idle game.

apps.name: HighLevelWorker
apps.short_description:
Play as high-altitude construction workers and tackle ridiculous tasks assigned by your foreman!
Your clients are a bizarre cast of iconic gaming characters-from bomb-plating terroristes and Assassin-hating Templars etc.
Team up with up to 8 players in chaotic co-op construction!

apps.name: HiroBot: Clean & Restore
apps.short_description: HiroBot: Clean & Restore is a relaxing single-player game you can enjoy at your own pace. Clean up dirt, dispose of trash, and restore objects. Reach every nook and cranny with your jetpack, and experience the satisfaction of bringing grimy areas back to life!

apps.name: Hitch Happens
apps.short_description: Hitch Happens is a story-driven hitchhiking simulator where every ride turns into a new adventure. Hitch rides, meet quirky drivers, make choices, and get caught up in unpredictable situations.

apps.name: Hold the Dawn
apps.short_description: Build by day. Survive the horde by night. Hold the Dawn is a 3D wasteland tower defense with unique auto-fighting heroes, tactical towers, zombie waves, and co-op over Steam, LAN, or local play.

apps.name: Hollow Space
apps.short_description: In Hollow Space, you are transported to an abandoned space station drifting on the edge of the galaxy. A rescue crew responds to a mysterious SOS signal, only to find that something terrifying lurks in the shadows. Will you dare to face the danger, or will you become the monster yourself?

apps.name: Holylands: War of Faith
apps.short_description: Holylands: War of Faith is a third-person historical action shooter set in Jerusalem’s Old City.  featuring two-timeline gameplay, survival combat and a narrative-driven experience . Explore a story of faith, , conflict, and human struggle across two eras in Jerusalem and human resilience

apps.name: Honel's Identification
apps.short_description: An administrative office in a fantasy world. Review documents from humans, elves, orcs, and beastfolk to uphold the republic's order. Follow the rules, or overlook suspicious files for personal gain? The choice is yours. Heroines await after work. Your decisions shape the republic's future.

apps.name: Hop!
apps.short_description:
Take control of a revenge seeking bunny in Hop! a 2.5D cartoon-styled game. 
Jump, kick, dodge the uncontrollable riders, and seek your payback.

apps.name: Hornienfeld: The Oblivion of Nymphilgina
apps.short_description: Defend Hornienfeld as the mighty knight Biggus Dickus in this lewd fantasy Action RPG. Explore dungeons, slay enemies, seduce women and uncover the enchantress's dark plot.

apps.name: Hot Farm Gauge
apps.short_description: The farm gauge is running hot! Hammer the handle, yank the crank, and bash the bolts down to keep the steam under control. Give it everything you got to see how long you can handle the pressure!

apps.name: Hot Head Alchemist
apps.short_description: In this RPG Maker MV, the seductive furry alchemist Delphine crafts potent potions that drive anyone wild. A rare ingredient leads her on a perilous journey across mystical realms, facing corrupted guardians and dark betrayals. Master crafting, magic, and alchemy in this thrilling adventure!

apps.name: Hot Machine
apps.short_description: Fill a felt table with hopping slot machines, hire Regulars to pull the levers, and climb from one penny slot to trillions. Every pull costs money. Go broke, borrow from the Shark, or declare bankruptcy and come back stronger.

apps.name: HOTEL10
apps.short_description: A horror game combining the search for anomalies with an escape. If there are no anomalies, you move forward; if there are, you turn back. Aim to escape the hotel alongside your chinchilla.

apps.name: House Of Trauma
apps.short_description: From Shooteo's YouTube Channel comes House of Trauma, a first person horror game where you play as Gabriel, a CPS worker assigned to a possible case of abuse of a child named David at a mysterious home. You soon find that this house hides much darker secrets than you could've ever imagined.

apps.name: How Many Tickets Does It Take To Win The Lottery?
apps.short_description: An incremental about one simple question. How many tickets does it take to win the lottery? Scratch tickets, match the numbers and spend your winnings on more tickets, until you are scratching millions at a time. The jackpot odds are realistic, 1 in 290,472,336, and nothing you buy changes it.

apps.name: Hungry Hoist
apps.short_description: Mine, fight, and cook to evolve your panda! Hungry Hoist is a solo or co-op dungeon-crawler about gathering and selling as much loot as possible. Dig deeper into the mine to discover darker, more twisted dungeons containing new enemies and puzzles, as well as shinier loot to sell or craft with.

apps.name: HuntCore
apps.short_description: HuntCore is a Monster-Collecting Roguelike. Join the CoreSeekers to fight and catch magical beast called Hunts. A big story awaits you to discover.

apps.name: HUNTMAZE
apps.short_description: HUNTMAZE is a challenging first-person survival horror where you must navigate a procedurally generated maze, evade deadly traps and a relentless hunter, and use tools to mark your path and find your way out.

apps.name: Hyper Arcane Mage Battle
apps.short_description: A mage platform battler for up to 8 players (Local multiplayer or Online). Earn spell cards and build between rounds until the winner is crowned at the match standings.

apps.name: HyperSkate
apps.short_description: Race across a sprawling alien landscape on a futuristic hoverboard in this sci-fi, VR exploration and racing game. Reach speeds of 300mph, leap from towering mega-structures, and explore the secrets of an alien world alone or with friends in multiplayer.

apps.name: HypnoFish Inc.
apps.short_description: HypnoFish Inc. is a first-person incremental game about working for the world's largest fishing corporation. Hypnotize fish, sell your catch, purchase upgrades, and uncover the mystery of this fishy business!

apps.name: HYPNOSYNC
apps.short_description:
RHYTHM x HYPNOSIS. You are forced into being the manager of the brand new music game arcade, HYPNOSYNC!
With your newfound hypnosis ability, hypnotize customers to the beat and turn them into your very own mindless employees!

apps.name: Hyposolus
apps.short_description:
Hyposolus is an action role playing game with strategic elements.

A long time has passed and the world is shattered. Experiment with different perks and spell combinations to defeat enemies. Explore the floating islands and discover the past.  Reach the spirits calling for you.

apps.name: Hypothesis Sudoku
apps.short_description: A classic 9×9 Sudoku game built around logical deduction and branching hypotheses. Mark assumptions separately from deductions, manage candidates, backtrack through multiple branches, and progress through ten chapters containing 100,000 puzzles.

apps.name: I Feel Great
apps.short_description: A short interactive narrative where you experience the daily grind, job, and exhaustion of a young woman — through simple interactions like typing and exploring. Inspired by the song "I'll Always Kill Myself Too Late" by Reclaimant of Life.

apps.name: I Married the Demon Lord's Daughter
apps.short_description: Adult-Only dark fantasy political romance Visual Novel where victory came with an unexpected price. You defeated the Demon Lord - only to inherit his throne and find yourself caught between two warring worlds.

apps.name: I stole my boss' boy toy
apps.short_description: You find a terrified young man hiding in your apartment hallway. The twist? He just escaped from your sadistic boss. Desperate for college tuition, this brilliant art student was tricked by a shady agency. Now, hide him, protect him and plot your revenge. Your choices dictate his fate!

apps.name: IAI BREAKER
apps.short_description: Turn your enemy’s strike into your opening. Deflect bullets with iaido slashes in this bullet-hell swordfighting action game. Press the attack or hold your ground? Read your foe’s attacks and break through with a decisive counterstrike.

apps.name: Idunn's Grace - A Hero's Tale
apps.short_description: Master the four elements as a shape-shifting slime in a 16-bit puzzle-platformer adventure. Alter your form to solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and retrieve Idunn's stolen apples to restore a withering world.

apps.name: Ignitement
