apps.short_description: Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to tend your land for you. Gather wood, stone, and water, raise wind vanes and solar panels, and watch a cracked desert slowly bloom into a luxuriant green oasis.

apps.name: Quiz Show Simulator
apps.short_description: Run your own high-stakes quiz show by crafting questions, choosing contestants, and making production decisions to grow your audience, boost ratings, and earn more money!

apps.name: R-01: A Space Survival Adventure
apps.short_description: A 2D space survival sandbox in an infinite asteroid belt. Mine, build a base with light and air, and share it with living companions who each have their own genome and moods. Fly through eleven biomes as you build a rocket and find your way home.

apps.name: Raise the Army From Zero Tactical RPG
apps.short_description: A turn-based strategy RPG inspired by classic games. Start with one companion and recruit allies with diverse abilities. Strengthen bonds to improve their support skills. Each stage limits your party by hiring budget or automatic selection.

apps.name: RamiRami
apps.short_description: A roguelite deck-building game where you fight with Rami. Be careful to choose wisely the cards you decide to add into your deck after each game ! Discover a strange path through a dreamlike world, collect cards and face bosses with twisted rules, alone or with a friend !

apps.name: Random Realm
apps.short_description: A fast-paced multiplayer first-person shooter set in dynamic arenas. Players engage in tactical gunfights, utilize precise shooting and agile movement, and work with teammates to claim victory in ever-changing battlefields.

apps.name: Rank Risk: Guess the Order
apps.short_description: Rank six answer cards in the correct order, choose how much RP to risk, and use limited attempts to solve each puzzle. Build streaks, chase bigger payouts, and climb the leaderboards in this fast-paced trivia ranking game.

apps.name: Rapid Miner
apps.short_description: Rapid Miner is a desktop idler: a tiny pixel mine floats in the corner of your screen in Pocket Mode, and your typing and clicks keep the miner swinging while you work. Open the full game to explore caves, beat bosses, grow a village and Rebirth.

apps.name: Re.がんばりみのりこ ～お姉ちゃんの試練～
apps.short_description:
Tosa Laboratory's very first title returns as a full remake!
Smash your enemies with farming tools! Send them flying with vegetables! Experience Minoriko Aki's powerful 2D action adventure, completely renewed!!

apps.name: Re: The Adventures of Dreik and Xitilon
apps.short_description: Dreik visits a friend and ends up in another world, living inside a giant statue of Lenin—with his own clone out to kill him. Explore, solve bizarre puzzles, and find a way home in a 3D comedy adventure with anime-style storytelling, absurd humour, and moments that hit hard.

apps.name: Reactance
apps.short_description: A first-person duelling game where every fighter is a scientist. Read your opponent's guard, then block, parry and strike back across ten arenas, from a station under a black hole to the inside of a living cell. Free to play, with rollback netcode, 2v2, Ranked and a Laboratory to meet in.

apps.name: Reality Drift
apps.short_description: Reality Drift is a strategic roguelike racing game. Race through a series of strange worlds, choose upgrades, cards and relics, and decide which track will be next - your decisions are just as important as how you drive!

apps.name: Realm Runners
apps.short_description: Realm Runners is an isometric extraction action RPG. Fight through hordes and face bosses that test your timing. Loot gear, shape your build and survive a brutal tournament for a chance to claim your one true wish. Extract with your loot or push your luck. Get greedy and you might die wishing.

apps.name: Realms at War
apps.short_description: A chess-inspired fantasy tactics game where every move matters. Command armies, outthink your opponent, and experience the depth of wargaming with the clarity of chess.

apps.name: RealmWalker
apps.short_description: Master elemental magic in this third-person action roguelite. Choose your spells, discover powerful cross-element synergies, and create unique builds. Enhance your power through passive Auras and risk the consequences of Corruption as you fight to escape Setsara.

apps.name: Reaper GoStop
apps.short_description: You are dead. At the gates of the afterlife, judgment is settled over a game of Hwatu. Real Korean flower cards and authentic Go-Stop rules meet runaway score-multiplier deckbuilding. The hand you draw is the life you lived. Outplay the Reaper to pass, or fall to hell and face the gate again.

apps.name: Recast:DeathOps
apps.short_description: Revived from a Cryonic state after World War III, you are a Recast clone waking to an Earth overrun by alien pirates and gigantic monsters pouring out from random portals. Explore an open world, forge alliances, and take your planet back. Play solo or in multiplayer.

apps.name: Reddy & Smoky's Flappy Storm
apps.short_description: Flap through a raging thunderstorm as Reddy, a plucky red parrot carrying his kitten co-pilot Smoky! Dodge tornadoes, chase high scores, and conquer the storm in this one-button arcade thrill-ride.

apps.name: Reel Tiny
apps.short_description: Become the fisherman you were always meant to be in Reel Tiny. Experience life as a tiny creature in a big world as you catch fish and make friends. Trade with the town to upgrade your lures and fishing rod. Earn new fishing licenses to explore new sections of the creek and become an angling legend!

apps.name: Refugee of a Lost Age
apps.short_description: A civilian survival sim in a collapsing dynasty. Chop wood, break rocks, pick herbs, farm — but this is no cozy farming game. Fight tooth and nail for every grain of food. Villagers aren't there to be befriended: only barter, deceit, robbery. To survive, will you do wrong — or stay human?

apps.name: Rend
apps.short_description: A shooter primarily focused on constantly aiming at various difficulties.

apps.name: Reperta
apps.short_description: An idle collecting game where no two finds are alike. Pick a world, press EXPLORE, and every artifact comes out with its own rarity, finish, preservation and a serial number counted across the whole server. 104 artifacts, 8 finishes, 16 worlds and a player Market. Any roll can be the one.

apps.name: Replay Value: Second Hand Games
apps.short_description: Run a second-hand game store from scratch! A Job Simulator where you buy and sell used games, negotiate with colorful customers, make profit and upgrade your shop! Clean up retro finds, and stack your shelves with the most popular game with replay value!

apps.name: Resident Evil 3: Raccoon City Demo
apps.short_description:
Experience a taste of this stunning re-imagining of Resident Evil 3.

Play a section of the opening of the game, specially tuned for this demo, and get a glimpse of the tragedy that befalls Raccoon City.

apps.name: Return to Planet Zoveka
apps.short_description: A physics-driven 2D incremental space-mining sim. Help a family herd cosmic dust, automate production, unlock research, and turn a single inherited station into a vast operation. Enjoy a relaxing, colourful journey to heal Zoveka.

apps.name: Revenant of Tsushima
apps.short_description: Enter a world where Japanese folklore comes to life. In this first-person horror adventure, explore haunted shrines, investigate supernatural mysteries, and collect wandering spirits as you uncover the secrets concealed beyond the sacred torii gates.

apps.name: Rhythm of Deck Builder
apps.short_description: Move to the beat in this rhythm roguelike deckbuilder! Step on cards to use them, or leave them on the board to support you. Recruit enemies, upgrade and fuse your cards, and discover powerful Game Changer combinations as you explore the islands.

apps.name: Rip It! Card Collector
apps.short_description: A single-player incremental game where you rip boosters and collect cards to complete the ultimate collection. Sell dupes, upgrade your gear and automate your setup to pull more cards, quicker! Enjoy the satisfaction of ripping packs, filling your binder, and gathering all sets. Let's get cracking!

apps.name: River Secret
apps.short_description: A story about a beautiful river that hides deadly secrets beneath its calm surface.

apps.name: Robologs
apps.short_description:
Robologs is an arcade shooter where you fight against out-of-control zombie robots.
Fight against an endless army in abandoned areas! Choose your character and weapons, team up with your friends, and see how long you can survive.

apps.name: Rocket Scrapyard
apps.short_description: Tidy up a private space company's scrapyard, collect rocket parts into sets on your racks and build your own rocket every evening. In the morning it launches – will it reach the edge of space, orbit, or help build a space station?

apps.name: Roll to Hell
apps.short_description: Launch a tire down a brutal 7,000-metre descent to Hell in this physics-driven incremental roguelite. Smash through shifting biomes, hoard resources and upgrade your way deeper. Roll solo, or ruin friendships in up to 4-player couch PvP.

apps.name: Roll to Riches
apps.short_description: Gather, Build and Advance your settlement with every roll in the incremental city builder Roll to Riches. Mine iron, gather wood and cut stone to make your settlement prosper. Trade with merchants every minute and transform your small camp into a wealthy Norse empire.

apps.name: Rollamon
apps.short_description: Raise one monster on your stat sheet. Draft dice, spend XP, race for Arena Medals, and win on Contest Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.

apps.name: Roomies
apps.short_description: Play alone or share one house with up to eight players. Each of you plays a housemate. Cook, build, pay the house tax from the jar and throw parties together. Keep everyone fed, rested and friends, and put out the kitchen fire before it spreads.

apps.name: Rotland
apps.short_description: A brutal zombie survival sandbox in an Earth-sized procedural world. Scavenge, craft, and build a home or mobile base. Drive cars, sail boats, pilot planes and helicopters, or take to the rails on a train. Survive alone or with friends.

apps.name: Rozmari
apps.short_description:
Fantasy medieval RPG following the plight and pilgrimage of a rabbit lass.
Navigate environmental puzzles and use survival skills to combat harsh challenges on your journey.
Discover ancient lore hidden within the spirit world to help you find the way.

apps.name: Rummage Row
apps.short_description: Open your own stall at the flea market. Buy cheap from the secondhand dealer, set out your goods, name your price and haggle with every customer. Grow your reputation, trade with neighboring sellers and find the pieces your story customers are hunting for. A warm, relaxing secondhand business game.

apps.name: Rusty Flagon
apps.short_description: Beyond the last safe village lies a forest filled with monsters. Build and manage a thriving medieval inn, welcome weary heroes, expand your settlement, and turn a humble refuge into a legendary haven at the edge of darkness.

apps.name: SacriFrogos
apps.short_description: A roguelike strategy and survival game where ever-growing sacrifices are required to keep the mysterious Eternal Flame alive. Build a colony of Frogos and create unique builds every run.

apps.name: Salvo Spire
apps.short_description: Build upward. Defend in 360 degrees. SALVO SPIRE is a sci-fi tower defense game where weapon combinations and construction order shape distinct defensive builds. Expand your tower, upgrade its firepower, and direct focused fire against enemies closing in from every side.

apps.name: SALVOR TOWER DEFENSE
apps.short_description: The enemy fleet approaches your orbital station. Conventional weapons fail — defense now relies on the tactical matter generator. Place crystal figures, match colors, and trigger powerful combos that unleash kinetic missiles, lasers, and barriers. Bigger combos mean stronger strikes.

apps.name: Sand Horde
apps.short_description: Sand Horde is an intense top-down survival shooter. Blast through relentless mutant hordes, explore surface ruins and multi-level sewer networks, craft modular weapons, construct underground bunkers, and drive armed go-karts to locate the "Big Cheese" and extract alive.

apps.name: Saturday AM: Battle Manga
apps.short_description: For the first time ever, Saturday AM’s iconic manga heroes unite in a crossover fighter! Tag in Sano, Cast, and more fan favorites to battle it out in explosive 2.5D combat where worlds collide.

apps.name: SaviorS : Oath of the Blade
apps.short_description: SaviorS: Oath of the Blade is a roguelite action RPG with flexible party building and deep, beat 'em up–style combat. Choose your path on the world map and combine companions, sword skills, spells, and gear to face powerful foes. Grow your favorite party and see the journey through together.

apps.name: Scales: Exiled Girl
apps.short_description: Raise a girl like never before! Experience the story through anime-style storytelling in a fantasy adventure romance game that blends character development, interactive choices, free exploration, and multiple endings.

apps.name: ScarryLand: The Potion Goes Wrong!
apps.short_description: Grandpa’s potion went horribly wrong, animals act like humans, and humans became animals. Explore the cursed island, gather ingredients for a cure, and bring Bonky, a skeleton who thinks you’re his dad.

apps.name: Scoped Assassin
apps.short_description: A town below you, going about its day. Somewhere down in that crowd is your contract. No markers, no arrows, no objective ping - just a scope, a rifle, and the patience to find the right face. Then the hard part: taking the shot before the town notices.

apps.name: SCP-ELM0
apps.short_description: A first-person stealth horror game in an SCP Foundation facility. Hide, listen and never answer the voices: the thing stalking Sublevel D learns how you hide, wears your dead team's voices, and remembers you.

apps.name: Scrambled Ships
apps.short_description: A Yacht Dice Roguelike set on a ship with a mysterious figure, trapped in an endless game night atop a sunset cruise. Think outside the box, buy items, and progress through the rounds, or fall to the ever-increasing score targets.

apps.name: Scramshaw
apps.short_description: The definitive pirate-themed roguelite word game. Use letters from your grid to make words that move you along the treasure map, then obtain tools and powerful charms to keep the expedition going. With a pool of over 300 effects to discover, every run is unique and sometimes there's a coconut.

apps.name: Scratcher Simulator
apps.short_description: A scratch-card roguelike engine-builder in the back room of an Italian bar. You can't pay your tab, so the barista points you to the machine: tickets that exist nowhere else. Scratch them, stack charms into game-breaking combos, beat rising targets. Lose, and it mints a new coin for the jar: yours.

apps.name: Sensual Repair
apps.short_description: Open your repair shop in Sensual Repair! Disassemble and fix devices, recover their data, and hunt for second-hand bargains to build your inventory. Grow your business and uncover the hidden stories behind your customers' files.

apps.name: Seven Nights With Hanako
apps.short_description: Ancient Leylines, a once in a 10 millennia blood moon, and one seriously bratty ghost! Seven Nights, Seven Challenges, Seven Hearts; Survive a week in Hanako's Hell realm or become her eternal play-thing!

apps.name: Sexorcism
apps.short_description: Sexorcism is an adult game combining roulette and spell-build crafting. As Ely runs out of Mana in battle, you become her exclusive “Provider.” Fight monsters by her side with Spells, Artifacts, and a “special” way to replenish Mana and turn fate around.

apps.name: sfsim
apps.short_description:
sfsim is a realistic 3D space flight simulator.
Use an advanced single-stage-to-orbit space craft to take off, orbit the planet, perform reentry, and land back on Earth.
sfsim features a true to scale Earth planet using NOAA elevation data and procedurally generated volumetric clouds.

apps.name: SGS Burning Banners
apps.short_description: Fight among the kingdoms of Kalar in the untamed eastern continent of Kheros. With the arrival of Lilith, one of the immortal sorcerers responsible for the Worldwound, dark times are looming...

apps.name: Shadowdeep
apps.short_description: A top-down action roguelite descent 1000 floors deep. Swing, cast and bomb through procedural, code-drawn dungeons that get stranger every hundred levels; die, and you return to the surface with nothing but your Legacy. Four classes, secrets found but are never explained, couch co-op for two.

apps.name: Shadows of Gloaming
apps.short_description: Shadows of Gloaming is a social deduction party game where 19 unique roles and 3 rival factions clash across tense day votes and hidden night actions. In Party Mode, one player hosts the GameArena while everyone else joins for free through the web app.

apps.name: Shepherd's Keeper
apps.short_description: A Scripture-centered shepherding and homestead game. Tend your flock, grow a garden and make a home through the seasons. Choose your calendar and observance path, with Torah observance central when chosen. Single-player now; multiplayer planned.

apps.name: Shift Chess
apps.short_description: This is a chess variant in which players can “control the board” as a move action. The game supports online play, matches against AI, and local analysis.

apps.name: Shitbox Together
apps.short_description: Shitbox Together is a solo or co-op sandbox where you build, break, and fix your car. Explore the open world, earn money, pay bills, find parts, and keep your shitbox running for as long as possible.

apps.name: Shock
apps.short_description: With only a wheelchair for mobility, Jack, a disabled war veteran, must use stealth, solve puzzles, and crawl into tight spaces to escape a cybernetic creature. Explore a psychological survival horror experience in third person and uncover the truth behind this nightmare.

apps.name: SHOT EDIT
apps.short_description: A rogue-lite nightmare in a shooting range! Hit the score quota with trick shots — or get cut from the film. For good.

apps.name: Sidehand
apps.short_description: A poker roguelite where folding is never wasted. Good poker means folding most hands; here, every card you fold becomes magic: turn a 9 into a King, heal, or hit harder. Learn real Texas Hold'em as you play, with no money at stake.

apps.name: SIFT
apps.short_description: SIFT is a fast 2D action platformer about momentum. Fire your hook, push off thin air to dash and reset your jump, grab the key, hit the door — then do it again, faster. 50+ handcrafted levels. Race the clock, your friends, or everyone at once.

apps.name: Sift Happens: Idle Beach Treasure
apps.short_description:
Someone on the boardwalk just tossed a cigarette butt onto the beach, and now it's buried in the sand. Sift it out, 
watch it fly into a bin and get paid. Hire more throwers, let crabs collect for you and keep this idle beach running 
until the junk turns into treasure.

apps.name: Sigilbound
apps.short_description: A turn-based hero collector RPG you buy once. Recruit champions from six factions, tune their gear and speed until your team acts before the boss does, and farm on Repeat at your own pace. No energy, no shop, no paid summons: every champion is earned in play.

apps.name: Silicon Sprint: Data Center Incremental
apps.short_description: An active incremental about running an AI data center. Sweep your cursor through swarms of data packets to turn them into cash, then pour it into racks, GPUs, drones and more. Keep it cool, keep it powered, and grow your company from one laptop into AGI.

apps.name: SIM Chef: Restaurant management
apps.short_description: SIM Chef is a restaurant sim that starts on an empty lot. Build the dining room and the kitchen, choose from over 200 dishes and drinks from around the world and hire a team that knows how to make your menu. Win over the judges and take home awards.

apps.name: Situation Normal
apps.short_description: Get in. Destroy the boss. Get the hell out. An action platformer where the faster you move, the more chaos you unleash at once.

apps.name: Six is Devil
apps.short_description: An incremental game about rolling dice until all dice land on 6. Improve your odds, corrupt your dice, and place bets to achieve the perfect roll. Can you get all 6s?

apps.name: Sketch Kingdom
apps.short_description: A short, incremental game with notebook aesthetic. Draw your own creatures, gather resources and accumulate gold to unlock upgrades. Complete missions to progress through a skill tree that expands everything you can do. Simple, charming and surprisingly addictive. Can you complete the notebook?

apps.name: SkyHigh
apps.short_description: After ten years behind bars, Isaac breaks free and disappears. But freedom isn't what he imagined. With nothing to his name and the law on his trail, he must earn money, build connections, and survive as he struggles to rebuild his life from nothing.

apps.name: Slender Island
apps.short_description: Slender Island is a first-person survival horror game where you find yourself on an abandoned island with a goal of stealing all the treasures hidden in its dungeons. However, Slender Mouse and other monsters won't give them up without a fight.

apps.name: SlotsNStocks
apps.short_description:
Rig the market in this deckbuilding slot machine roguelite. Draft hundreds of bullish and bearish symbols, build money-making combinations, and manipulate the odds in your favor. 

Adapt to an ever-shifting market and make enough to survive your next margin call.

apps.name: SLOW ORBIT: Idle Planet Conquest
apps.short_description: Slow Orbit puts a tiny, self-running space war in the bottom corner of your screen. Leave your fleet to conquer planets while you do other things, then drop in to buy upgrades, pick promotions and take on tougher defenses.

apps.name: Smart Three Kingdoms : Rewrite History
apps.short_description: Unite the land in Smart Three Kingdoms, a strategy game of warfare, diplomacy, and statecraft. Develop cities, recruit troops, and command legendary officers. Forge your own path through history in a world of ink-wash art.

apps.name: Smash Hit
apps.short_description: Smash Hit is an online party brawler for up to 12 players. Grab a random loadout of ridiculous weapons, knock your friends off the stage and play to the crowd. Climb to the top of the scoreboard and become TV's next SMASH HIT!

apps.name: Soft 17
apps.short_description: A blackjack roguelite where you edit the deck you play from. Gild a card, cut another, stack ninety items that fire in the order you choose. Cheat if you dare: the house is counting, and it sends someone to sit at your table.

apps.name: Solbrand
apps.short_description: 2409. As the new Spook on HMS Solbrand you dive deep into a past steeped in grand norse myth and quiet local legend. Command your submersible, survey sunken ruins, uncover puzzling fragments, commune with the dead, and untangle a pseudo-historical knot of cosmic proportions: Why is the sun so loud?

apps.name: Solitary Singleplayer Offline MMORPG
apps.short_description: Run an MMORPG guild in this incremental management game. Recruit new members, upgrade your guild, promote leaders to automate the busywork, and grind for the best gear. All to earn the Server-First achievements for every raid.

apps.name: SOME: Space Overlay Mining Empire
apps.short_description:
Looking for SOME game right on your desktop that doesn't hijack your monitors?
A space station in a corner of your screen, mining ships that cut asteroids apart block by block and haul the ore home, and upgrades that let the fleet run itself while you pretend to work.

apps.name: SON of SPARTA
apps.short_description: Play as ACTARIUS, the ultimate Spartan warrior as he battles hes way through Hades underworld to be with hes beloved once more...

apps.name: Sonic Terror
apps.short_description: The year is 1984. You are the last band in a tiny Republic invaded by body-snatching space aliens. Music is the only weapon. You are wanted dead or alive. Explore a dystopian world where music is key to saving mankind and every gig is a challenging tactical clash.

apps.name: Sorceress Services
apps.short_description: Starting anew as a rookie Sorceress, complete magical transactions and requests to build your clientele and grow your business! In this narrative-driven fantasy vendor simulator, follow unique quest lines, use persuasive techniques, and cast enchantments on your goods with gestures.

apps.name: Sort My Loot
apps.short_description: A casual dark-fantasy sorting game. Pick up, carry and shelve 574 pieces of loot across seven shops, from rusty daggers to cursed relics. Race the clock, brave fog-shrouded Impossible mode, or sort together in online co-op.

apps.name: SORT THEM ALPACAS: OVERLOAD!
apps.short_description: Sort 5,000 alpaca plushies in a first-person collectathon with a touch of chaos. Spend your sorting earnings on a deep upgrade system, and discover five hidden powers with chaotic upgrades of their own.

apps.name: Sort Them Dice
apps.short_description: Turn a chaotic dice shop into a satisfying collection. Pick up, inspect and sort 4,095 colorful dice into matching sets, fill wooden shelves and unlock handy upgrades in this cozy first-person organizing game.

apps.name: Sort Them Dogs
apps.short_description: Playtime is over at Happy Paws Doggy Daycare, and 4,080 toy pups are piled all over the floor. Scoop them up one at a time and carry every pirate, astronaut, farmer and pumpkin back to its own cubby row in this cozy first-person sorting game.

apps.name: Soul Link - End and Rebirth
apps.short_description: An offline turn-based RPG of card-framed battles, party growth, and a two-act story. Unlock memory fragments, face trials, and choose among three finales. No energy gates or daily login chores—buy once and play through.

apps.name: Soul Shine
apps.short_description: Prohibition ruined your brewery job. So you started a moonshine business. Expand and automate your empire by harvesting souls, trafficking organs, selling to addicts, and serving strange gods.

apps.name: Soul Surge
apps.short_description:
Soul Surge is a stylized third-person action roguelite. 
Fight your way through 3 Domains with challenging boss fights, deep build opportunities, ARPG styled progression and Bullethell elements.

apps.name: SoulMarkWalker
apps.short_description: 《SoulMarkWalker》 is a turn-based action game.Choose your skills and time your dodges and counters in video-driven, turn-based combat. Investigate clues, develop your character, and resonate with ancient heroes.

apps.name: Sound System
apps.short_description: Play the songs you love, including the ones you wrote. Sound System is a rock rhythm game for guitar, bass, and drums, with a built-in chart editor that turns any track into a playable chart. Chase gold in Pro Mode or just jam in Classic. If you can hear it, you can play it.

apps.name: SpaceCorps
apps.short_description: A free-to-play space MMO in early alpha. Enlist with one of three companies, hunt aliens, fight rival pilots in the Danger Sectors, build ships and join a clan. Runs on Space3d, our own game engine written in Rust.

apps.name: Spark of Tales
apps.short_description: Ignite the spark of inspiration while writing tales in a cozy environment where readers become part of the creative process. Follow stories as they're being written, interact with other authors, shape worlds through your ideas, earn reputation, unlock unique abilities, and get rewarded for your aid.

apps.name: SPECTR: Rekindle the World
apps.short_description: Become the Spark that brings a faded world back to life. Gather shards, automate production, and begin new cycles with permanent upgrades. An atmospheric incremental game about growth, discovery, and restoring a ruined valley.

apps.name: Spell Death
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where the alphabet is your deck. Draw letters and spell words to strike, block or hex. Print them on paper stocks that change the rules, and learn each demon's true name to banish it from an art deco city that stopped reading.

apps.name: Spinstack
apps.short_description: Spinstack is a single-player stacking puzzle game. Rotate the square base to guide falling tetrominoes, complete concentric rings, and trigger inward collapses and chain clears. Choose from four modes, master special blocks, build Combos, and chase higher scores as the board expands.

apps.name: Spirit Binder
apps.short_description: A roguelike board game with auto battles for 1 to 4 players. Roam a haunted board that is new every game, bind folk spirits from seven cultures into a team of three, and outplay rival exorcists online, on one PC or against bots.

apps.name: Spiritual Mesh Theory
apps.short_description: Spiritual Mesh Theory is a gamified software simulation that explores the topology of mesh networks in 3D space. A video game designed like medical software meant to be enjoyed like a visualizer. It is as much art as it is logic; giving way to theory. A clever twist on vibecozy gaming and software.

apps.name: St. Mary's 1985
apps.short_description:
You wake up on a red chair in the waiting room of a closed psychiatric hospital. You know this place.
Clothes that aren't yours. A file with your name you don't remember reading.
Your heartbeat rises. The memories come back. Not all of them want to be remembered.
St. Mary's, 1985.

apps.name: Stack the Spells
apps.short_description: Stack the Spells is a fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a step toward your survival. Scale a shifting, procedurally generated path, outsmart grim monstrosities in tactical turn-based combat, and forge a legendary deck to solve the mysteries of a world in ruin.

apps.name: Stackade
apps.short_description: Tower defense where your towers fall as blocks. Drag each piece onto the board, wall in your HQ and turn the gaps into kill zones. Every enemy comes at you its own way, bosses test your build, and between waves the Armory never has enough money for everything you want.

apps.name: STAR FELIDEA
apps.short_description: Pop bubbles, earn foam, and clean the album to recover photos of your adorable cats! Master your tools, chain combos, and discover a cute, colorful, bubbly arcade game packed with surprises. 🐱✨

apps.name: Star TD
apps.short_description: Command your defense in an ever-changing roguelite TD. Harvest resources from mine nodes, explore the fog of war, and repel alien waves. With a deep branching tech tree and permanent progression, every defeat is just a step toward ultimate power. Build. Die. Research. Repeat.

apps.name: Star-Soldier
apps.short_description: Old retro style Sci-fi game from the 80's. This is the classic space invaders format. 114 levels of shooter fun, end level bosses and special weapon power up's.

apps.name: STARDUSTER
apps.short_description: STARDUSTER is a neon arcade game of rhythm and precision. Every move counts. Catch arrows to the beat, dodge spikeballs and master increasingly demanding patterns. Each level hides part of a message no human should be able to decipher.

apps.name: StarFell
apps.short_description: A modern beat ’em up where you battle foul hordes of the Dark Lord in a stylized fantasy world.

apps.name: Starfold
apps.short_description: Build a thriving habitat inside an O’Neill cylinder. Balance residents, resources and income, respond to events, and watch new towers, signs, bridges and lights enrich your curved city. A compact offline management game with free-flight exploration and Chinese/English interfaces.

apps.name: Starforge Pirate
apps.short_description: Starforge Pirate is a fast-paced arcade roguelite in which you will battle cosmic enemies, forge wild weapons, manage weapon heat, upgrade your ship, face deadly bosses, and chase the perfect run.

apps.name: StarsPartyNext
apps.short_description:
2D action game featuring exhilarating gameplay driven by dashes and combos.
Keep an eye on the actions and reactions of Spica—a cool yet adorable boy who wields the power of the stars!
With over 30 stages, the game offers plenty of replay value through features like score attacks and time trials.

apps.name: StarWorks
apps.short_description: A space sim where you build the industry that produces your rockets, then fly them. Genuinely integrated orbits, aerodynamics solved part by part, procedural planets you can walk. From first mine to first interstellar flight.

apps.name: Steel Core
apps.short_description: STEEL CORE is a tactical turn-based strategy about giant mechs defending mining outposts on hostile worlds. Build each mech from parts, fortify your base, and survive an escalating roguelite campaign against an overwhelming alien enemy. Frontier work pays well, for those who survive it.

apps.name: Steel Eats Steel
apps.short_description: Crush enemies, collect scrap, and grow a small tank into a heavy war machine. Steer an always-moving chassis, aim your turret, and combine weapons in this single-player action roguelike. Break through industrial battlefields, choose your upgrades, and decide when to return or push deeper.

apps.name: STEP ASIDE!
apps.short_description: You are an invincible bodyguard. Your only weakness is the person you must protect. Control the crowd, spot the assassin, and execute the mission in this stylish, top-down tactical shooter.

apps.name: Stevedore
apps.short_description:
No more job in the city. Managed to find one in the middle of nowhere. Stevedore. Crane worker. It feels off, but you need money.
Stevedore is a short industrial horror game where you take a role of a crane worker. Lift containers, load ships and complete your contract. What could go wrong?

apps.name: Stick Life: Ye Olde Grind
apps.short_description: Start in the Serf Shack with twenty-five gold. Grow herbs, raise a herd, tan the hides, brew phials, melt a beaten man's harness into a sword, and sell the lot. Then buy the castle. An isometric medieval life sim where every day is a twenty-minute countdown and the rent is still due.

apps.name: Stick N' Sheep
apps.short_description: Join the woolly madness! A chaotic 2 to 8 player party game where an avalanche of crazy minigames awaits you. In a colorful cartoon world, push, betray, and survive to become the smartest… or luckiest sheep!

apps.name: Sticker Mirage
apps.short_description: Play as Sticker Line, a 711 emergency call center worker. He lives his quiet life until strange and unfortunate events begin to occur, and he might be somehow connected. Discover the truth behind Sticker's quiet life in this dreamcore-style visual novel with horror elements.

apps.name: Still Stars Echo
apps.short_description: An atmospheric science-fiction journey across distant alien landscapes. Traverse monolithic structures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the story of a lost civilization written among the stars.

apps.name: Stinky Tofu: Kitchen Survivor
apps.short_description: A chaotic kitchen action-roguelite where you play as stinky tofu, auto-aim through hordes of mutant ingredients, fuse kitchen weapons, mutate mid-run, and fight to stay fresh before you spoil.

apps.name: Stock Escape
apps.short_description: Trade 50 stocks, dodge loan sharks and con men, and blow your fortune on mansions, yachts and private jets. A funny stock market life sim where every hot tip comes with a catch, a kidnapping or a shark. Escape to your dreams.

apps.name: Stolen Frequencies
apps.short_description: Run a pirate radio station from a repair-shop back room in 1980s England. Find cassettes, win listeners and stay ahead of the police. Fix radios, grow local businesses and work towards your own music venue in this single-player simulation.

apps.name: Stompworks
apps.short_description: They fired you, then repossessed your whole town. They missed the mech under the tarp. Build a war machine from 59 parts, put a different gun on each arm, and stomp through 10 levels of wave combat and boss fights to take it all back. One mech. One run. No continues.

apps.name: StoneSpace
apps.short_description: As the lone survivor of an ill-fated starship, embark on the ultimate crafting project: build a vessel from scratch and return to Earth. Explore, gather resources, erect a base, and master hundreds of recipes – from flint tools to nuclear reactors - on a voyage through the entire history of science.

apps.name: Stranded Deep 2
apps.short_description: Survival is just the beginning. Stranded in a desert wilderness, an endless river is your only lifeline. Scavenge resources, craft tools, and build a floating home to brave the treacherous waters and scorching heat. Every bend brings new danger and deeper discoveries. How far will you go?

apps.name: Streak of Power
apps.short_description: Streak of Power is a turn-based strategy game featuring tactical duels. Aim your energy beam carefully, use gravitational stations to alter its trajectory, and take control of them. Outsmart your opponent and destroy their base before they hit yours.

apps.name: Strict Order
apps.short_description: A 3D anomaly and document inspection sim set in a post-civil war dystopia. Match documents and detect hidden entities using gadgets on your diegetic desk. Survive before your booth glass breaks, manage your budget, and face the consequences of your actions on the evening news.

apps.name: Subroutine: Deep Space
apps.short_description: A sci-fi programming puzzle game. Repair corrupted ship cores by wiring executable node graphs — memory, logic, and I/O — then step through playback like a debugger until every validation stream passes.

apps.name: Sudokiller
apps.short_description: Sudokiller is a cozy mystery puzzle game where you place suspects on a sudoku-style grid to unmask a killer hiding in plain sight. Every guest leaves a clue pinning down where they stood at the time of the murder. Deduce your way through case after case in this cozy, cleverly deceptive mystery.

apps.name: SUMO TATAMI
apps.short_description: Cause mayhem in multiplayer arcade battles of Sumo Tatami 🎮🏃‍♂️🏁 Run, roll, rocketjump straight in many game modes. Only agility, ingenuity and a little luck can make you a yokozuna!

apps.name: Sump
apps.short_description: A short baroque atmospheric horror game. Manipulate a labyrinth of levers and unnatural shadows. Find courage in a place that only goes down.

apps.name: Sundered Reach
apps.short_description: Rise from cadet to commander in a living star system. Build your warband, fight real-time fleet battles, board enemy flagships and lead sieges with up to 1,500 soldiers per side, while something stirs at the edge of the Reach.

apps.name: Supa-Market: Japanese Super-Market Simulator
apps.short_description: Manage your own Japanese supermarket! Stock shelves, restock products, hire employees, and expand your store. Manage your finances, serve customers, and turn a small shop into a thriving business in a charming anime-inspired 3D simulation!

apps.name: Super Bomba League
apps.short_description:
Make the ball hit the floor on their side...BY ANY MEANS!
Throw axes, invade their field, or zap anyone in your way!
2v2 ONLINE & LOCAL matches full of chaos, explosive balls, and feisty bunnies.

apps.name: Super Hamburger Builder
apps.short_description:
Throw it! Stack it! Push burgers to the limit!

Build your own burger with 14 quirky ingredients in this physics-based action game. Aim for towering perfection, or pile on whatever your appetite demands. Every finished creation earns a name worthy of its glorious stack!

apps.name: Super Kanji Flash
apps.short_description: A cute anime action runner where you fight off ink aliens by reading the kanji they stole. Answer each one with a single press mid-run, and your brush strikes the alien down. Learn 6,000+ kanji, from zero to JLPT N1 and beyond. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 8.

apps.name: SUPERUSER
apps.short_description: An ASCII bullet-heaven roguelite where you stack weapon modifiers, evolve your arsenal, and fight towering bosses. Turn bullets, blades, and fireballs into cascading destruction. Experiment with powerful combinations as enemies flood the arena.

apps.name: Susanoo: Typing Action
apps.short_description: A Sekiro-like typing game. Defeat enemies through typing and parry their attacks with precise timing.

apps.name: Sussy Schoolgrounds
apps.short_description: a completely original horror game with deep lore and a HIGHLY MARKETABLE colorful mascot!

apps.name: Sweeplings
apps.short_description:
A cute logic puzzle about scanning the board to find Starlings and avoid Boomlings. English UI · No spoken dialogue.

If you love logic puzzles like Minesweeper but want something warmer and more visual — with clues on the board instead of numbers — Sweeplings is for you.

apps.name: Sweet Glassgirl 2
apps.short_description: Sweet Glassgirl 2 - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game featuring five pretty and adorable girls wearing glasses. Enjoy wonderful moments with relaxing music. After completing a level, you can admire the girls' photos in the gallery.

apps.name: Swinging Pier Clean Simulator
apps.short_description: Swing between skyscrapers on a co-op cleaning crew's precarious scaffold, blast years of grime away with foam and pressure washers, and try not to send your teammates flying. Solo zen or 4-player chaos — the choice is yours

apps.name: Switch Shapes
apps.short_description: A high-speed reflex game where the music is born from your performance. Alternate forms, survive the chaos, and drive a procedural soundtrack inspired by Brazilian rhythms, electronica, and psychedelia.

apps.name: Swordcery: Prologue
apps.short_description: Collect a myriad of spellbound blades to defeat an otherworldly evil in this free prologue for Swordcery, a rogue-like ARPG currently in development!

apps.name: Swords and Guns
apps.short_description: Swords and Guns is an intense, cooperative, first-person tower defense where modern weapons clash with fantasy hordes as you defend a castle from skeletons, knights, and other monsters.

apps.name: SX BEYOND
apps.short_description: Traverse derelict cyber-cities overrun by infernal entities in SX Beyond—a brutal FPS Survival Horror. Adapt through tactical stealth, manage limited supplies, and survive the nightmare solo or with your squad.

apps.name: Synthetic Quorum
apps.short_description: A first-person sci-fi social deduction game for up to 8 players. Fix the ship, watch your crewmates, then accuse and vote out the infected. Or be Patient 0: lie, sabotage and vanish. A co-op mode swaps the traitor for a hunter and a ticking clock.

apps.name: Tag!
apps.short_description: TAG! is a fast-paced 2-8 player multiplayer parkour game of tag. Grapple, wall run, slide and outplay friends to avoid being It when the timer hits zero! Customize your look and your unique abilities for the ultimate party game experience.

apps.name: Tale Sweeper
apps.short_description: Tale Sweeper blends incremental progression with light loot mechanics. Hack and slash monsters, complete quests, and gather gold and materials. Use your loot to upgrade a massive skill tree, craft powerful weapons, and buy potions to gear up for your next adventure!

apps.name: Talystro
apps.short_description: Combine cards, dice, and creative logic to defeat your numerical adversaries! Talystro is a deckbuilder with a mathematical twist, namely you have to match the value of your enemies to destroy them! Build your deck, power up your dice and crush your enemies!

apps.name: Tame or Conquered
apps.short_description: You got isekai'd, only to wake up as a cursed saintess. You have 6 months to choose a husband from 7 yandere red flags.. or become a big tree and die. A "simple" psychological horror & dark romance VN.

apps.name: Tank General
apps.short_description: Tank General, a World War II-themed card game with unique gameplay mechanics, deep tactical combat, and an easy entry level. Build your deck, battle against humans and AI, complete campaigns and raids, and explore new cards and headquarters!

apps.name: Tatomic
apps.short_description: Drop linked atoms, build color chains to critical mass, and ignite spectacular combos in a kinetic falling-block puzzle game with 30 escalating levels. Three gameplay modes: Critical Mass, Radioactive Survival, and Puzzle.

apps.name: TauTau
apps.short_description: The ultimate customizable color-matching party game! Play with up to 10 players or bots, build custom decks, and toggle wild house rules—no card DLCs needed, the content is in your hands! Features online/offline modes, real-time comms, and preset decks in a chaotic take on Crazy Eights.

apps.name: TCG Card Chaos
apps.short_description: Sort 5,000+ collectible cards scattered across a chaotic card shop. Inspect their types, rarities, numbers and symbols, open card packs, discover graded cards, and find the correct place for every card.

apps.name: Tending
apps.short_description: Tending is a cozy game about houseplants. Buy plants, figure out where each one likes to live, water them and watch them grow. Take cuttings to grow even more. Nothing dies, so if a plant is struggling, just move it somewhere better.

apps.name: Tenrei
apps.short_description: 2D warband sandbox — roam the map, raise an army, fight turn-based battles.

apps.name: Teo
apps.short_description: Hunt and trade during the day, survive horrifying creatures at night. TEO is a pixel-art action roguelite featuring a dynamic day-night cycle that transforms enemies and the world around you.

apps.name: Terrarium Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build a tiny world in a jar. Layer gravel, charcoal, moss and soil, plant ferns and succulents, then add frogs, a box turtle, snails, ladybugs or a few fireflies. Give it its own weather: a little sun, a rain cloud, a thunderstorm, snow. Share it or sell it on the marketplace and become a tycoon!

apps.name: Terrified Gorillas
apps.short_description:
A co-op VR horror game. You're a gorilla trapped in Primal Dynamics' abandoned test facilities, and the monsters
 know you're here. Climb, run and hide through mazes, sewers and the backrooms with your friends, or become the monster in Monster Hunt.

apps.name: Tessela
apps.short_description: Relax and organize the chaos in Tessela, a 2D pixel art puzzle game designed to play without pressure or clocks. Overcome 99 handcrafted levels featuring colored blocks, different shapes, and challenges meant to clear your mind.

apps.name: TetrEscape
apps.short_description: Jump, climb, dash, and fight for your digital freedom in this challenging rogue-like platformer. Unlock powerful upgrades and discover broken synergies. Will you escape the game, or will your data be deleted forever?

apps.name: That Caveman Theme Park Game
apps.short_description: Build a tribe. Run a prehistoric theme park. Keep the fire alive. Train cavemen, gather resources and create wild timber attractions. Entertain visitors, defend them from dinosaurs and expand your park's warmth while balancing fuel, construction and stone income.

apps.name: That's Exactly What a Wolf Would Say!
apps.short_description: An online social deduction game for up to 10 players. Live the cottage dream by day and survive the wolves by night! You hear howling outside, and the Witch isn't on the line... Coincidence? That's EXACTLY what a wolf would say!

apps.name: The Adventurer's Guide to Another World
apps.short_description: A delightful action adventure set in a mysterious another world! Defeat enemies in satisfying hack-and-slash combat, and explore dungeons filled with puzzles. Combine unique skills and gear to raise the ultimate adventurer and save the continent!

apps.name: The Airline Century
apps.short_description: Build and manage an airline from 1960 to 2030 in a turn-based strategy simulation. Buy or lease aircraft, plan routes, fares and schedules, expand hubs, and navigate oil shocks, financial crises and rival airlines.

apps.name: The Benchmark
apps.short_description: More than thirty quick games of reaction, aim, memory, timing and arcade skill. Glide through caves, clear minefields, dodge, stack and draw a perfect circle. Beat your best, challenge Steam friends and climb the leaderboards. Requires an internet connection.

apps.name: The Car Game
apps.short_description: The Car Game is a game with cars. You become all available tools to design model, liveries, suspension and car powertrain; and take it on your track. The track designer allows to fairly quickly build you own.

apps.name: The Caretaker: Block 9
apps.short_description: "The Caretaker: Block 9" is a horror game set in 2000s Poland. You play as Janusz Nowakowski, former caretaker who returns to his initial occupation. At the beginning everything seems to be just a little scary but at the same moment ordinary...

apps.name: The Clock the Queen and the Door on the Beach
apps.short_description: A first person adventure about helping an inventor start a very unusual and untested reactor, to save a distant civilization. You explore the island, find clues in the environment, and make progress by solving simple, but interconnected and layered puzzles ( see main description for more ). No AI.

apps.name: The Coin Goblin
apps.short_description: You finally made it inside... and there are coins EVERYWHERE! Thousands of them are scattered on the floor, and someone has to pick them up. Start collecting, use your earnings to upgrade your tools, unlock better ways to gather coins, and become more efficient as you venture deeper into the dungeon

apps.name: The Crooked Table
apps.short_description: Four players. Three secret sides. One table full of liars. Play every card face down, claim whatever you like, and bet your chips that someone else is lying. Help your team, sabotage the table, or play everyone for yourself. Just don’t get caught.

apps.name: The Dark Forest Calls
apps.short_description: The world forgot Psara, but the island did not forget you. In this story-driven first-person survival horror, explore its fog-shrouded shores as Elias Whitmore, evade creatures drawn to light and sound, manage scarce supplies, and uncover why Psara vanished from human memory.

apps.name: The Demon Wins
apps.short_description: Build each mercenary from the ground up in a permadeath dark fantasy auto-battler where there are no classes - only combinations. Find powerful loot, mutate attacks, combine skills, choose paths, and turn what you find into the power to win.

apps.name: The Dictatories
apps.short_description: Experience 50 days in a country slowly falling into chaos. Read newspapers and witness the rise of oppression through the eyes of an ordinary citizen. A first-person atmospheric narrative about silence, propaganda, and the collapse of a society.

apps.name: The Dream Machine - The Definitive Edition
apps.short_description: An award-winning point & click adventure about exploring other people’s dreams. Uncover dark secrets in a strange apartment building and wander through a surreal, hand-crafted dreamscape built from clay, cardboard & broccoli.

apps.name: The Edge of the Backrooms
apps.short_description: After discovering a strange anomaly on Jupiter's moon, Europa, you find yourself in the outer reaches of a dangerous, uncanny complex.

apps.name: The Edgelands
apps.short_description: A cyberpunk city builder. Start with a desert wasteland. Build the roads, zone the blocks and turn a stretch of dust into a sprawling megacity of neon and towering Spires. Keep the streets under control, strike deals with megacorps and build your own version of utopia.

apps.name: The First Pixel
apps.short_description: In the beginning there is a white screen and one black pixel. Click it, and it wakes. Grow it into pattern, memory and meaning, hunt 100 lost relics across erased worlds, and discover what a pixel sees once it has gathered everything. A quiet, mysterious incremental.

apps.name: The Fog & Flask
apps.short_description: Run a cozy potion bar on a misty swamp. Pour layered potions that settle by density, grind, chop and heat ingredients, and serve curious guests with secrets of their own. By night, hold back the creeping fog with your lantern and follow the trail of your vanished mentor.

apps.name: The Frozen Cabin
apps.short_description: Trapped in a frozen cabin during a relentless storm, you begin to realize the silence around you isn’t empty… something is watching, waiting, and getting closer.

apps.name: The Gem Alchemist: A Cozy Crystal Workshop
apps.short_description: Run a cozy wizard's gem shop in a world of stained glass! Steer seed crystals across a magical lattice to grow flawless gems, cut them, and sell them to picky customers. Grow stones in your cellar, read tomorrow's omen in the stars, and restore an ancient faceting machine!

apps.name: The Ghost and The Phoenix
apps.short_description: Peer beyond the veil and experience the ethereal in The Ghost and The Phoenix, a captivating neo-classical top-down shooter. Navigate the realms between life and death in this supernatural action-packed adventure.

apps.name: THE GRAVES VIGIL
apps.short_description: The Graves Vigil is an atmospheric psychological horror game with point-and-click elements. Alone in the Graves estate, you must survive until five in the morning: spot anomalies, guard your sanity, and keep the house from sinking into darkness.

apps.name: The Graveyard Diner
apps.short_description: Work the night shift at a small diner next to a cemetery. To cut costs, steal offerings from the graves to cook meals for customers, while keeping the monsters in the cemetery at bay, cleaning up the diner, and following the daily employee rules.

apps.name: The Hushed Metropolis
apps.short_description: Build a business, run a racket, or investigate the people doing both. A real-time card simulation of crime, politics, and the occult, played solo or online. Make deals, uncover forbidden rituals, and fight for control of a city where people can become more than human.

apps.name: The King's Muster
apps.short_description: The King is dead, the Capital sealed. You keep the Muster Roll that still calls men to arms. Draw a line in the dirt and a company falls in on it. Raise a few dozen recruits into a host of a thousand, read the front as it bends, storm their walls and hold yours. A pixel-art real-time wargame.

apps.name: The Landlords
apps.short_description: A story-driven property-trading board game built on The Landlord's Game, Lizzie Magie's 1904 original. Buy land, charge rent and strike deals with characterful rivals or friends online, under her ruthless Monopolist rules or her Prosperity rules, where everyone can win.

apps.name: The Last Broadcast
apps.short_description: You are the sole emergency dispatcher aboard Relay Epsilon-9. Using an authentic 1980s retro terminal, track bio-telemetry, consult engineering schematics, and make life-or-death decisions to guide survivors through a breached vessel.

apps.name: The Last Fireman
apps.short_description: Race the clock in an arcade firefighting game. Plan your route, manage your extinguisher and dodge explosive hazards across five levels. Master each route, beat your best times and take on the entire campaign in Speed Run mode.

apps.name: The Last Marshmallow
apps.short_description: A chaotic school-yard party game for 2–8 friends online. Dodge giant balls, pass the hot pumpkin, paint the playground and push your friends around across 10+ minigames. Only one student will win the last marshmallow.

apps.name: The Last Show
apps.short_description: Every system has an end. You are the glitch. Wake up as a security guard in a ruined museum, search for keys, escape surreal worlds, and survive unsettling entities in a first-person psychological horror seen through a bodycam.

apps.name: THE LAST STONE
apps.short_description: Up to 100 million stones, one tiny toy shovel and one hidden diamond. Dig, haul and sell stones to afford better gear in this absurd first-person incremental game. Start with a yellow plastic shovel. The diamond could be in your very first successful scoop.

apps.name: The Legendary Sortsmith
apps.short_description: A legendary gnome blacksmith forges mythic weapons faster than anyone can put them away. You’re his apprentice. Haul, toss and sort 4,000+ swords, axes, hammers and cursed oddities in this first-person tidying game, solo or with up to 3 friends.

apps.name: The Long Shift
apps.short_description: Build an automated factory on an Earth ruled by machines. As a salvage robot, turn wreckage into working industry, connect distant outposts by electric rail, and reclaim land from hostile machines. Follow a mysterious signal to discover what your work is really for.

apps.name: The OutBreak Protocol
apps.short_description: Escape the outbreak with friends! A survivor horror multiplayer experience that will allow you to fight hordes of zombies, escape unique scenarios and most important of all... Survive the outbreak!

apps.name: The Planet Miner
apps.short_description: Turn a tiny mining ship into a planet-shredding powerhouse. Dig through colorful layers, build game-changing upgrade combos, and let your drones join the fun. Experience this satisfying adventure full of sparkling treasure, adorable wildlife, and enormous buried wonders.

apps.name: The Puncture
apps.short_description: The Puncture is an observation and puzzle horror game that immerses players in a nightmarish world of shifting realities and creatures. The game's objective is to identify and correct divergences within each environment to restore stability.

apps.name: The Restricted Index
apps.short_description: You are Britain’s last librarian. Investigate a world of censorship and secrets in this first-person mystery puzzle game. Analyse clues, deduce which books each patron needs, uncover forbidden stories and decide what knowledge survives.

apps.name: The Serena Villa Files
apps.short_description:
'FMV Queen' Wang Han's First K-FMV!
At your new job as a security guard in a women's only residence,
feelings blossom between you and the charming residents, but strange events also haunt you from your first day.
What mystery awaits you and the five ladies of Serena Villa?

apps.name: The Speedy Moski-Man
apps.short_description: The one and only superhero of the fleur-de-lis people? It's a skiing mosquito! The Speedy Moski-Man is the story of Pablo Picard, a rather intelligent but solitary young student whose life is turned upside down at the beginning of summer vacation.

apps.name: The Tavern at the End of the Road
apps.short_description: SOULS-LIKE Deckbuilder. Every run is the final tale of an Errant. Battle through a cursed road, slay mythical creatures and corrupted heroes, discover forgotten keepsakes, and reach the end to decide the fate of the world.

apps.name: The Touhou Empires
apps.short_description: Touhou meets real-time warfare! Explore maps, gather resources, and build your army! Become the conqueror of Gensokyo!

apps.name: The Traitor's Anvil
apps.short_description: A pixel art roguelite auto battler about a framed royal blacksmith. Smelt, hammer and assemble every weapon and armor by hand, arm five heroes and a rebel squad, set their formation, then lead them across five lands to topple the usurper king. Forge all 40 legends.

apps.name: The Twenty-Ninth
apps.short_description: A first-person descent into a hundred floors nobody has come back from. You carry a lamp. Something down there carries nothing and does not need to. You go a step at a time, and it does not wait for you. Walk, listen, and decide how far the twenty-ninth is going to get.

apps.name: The Twilight Project
apps.short_description: A tourist who gets lost in a forgotten village. As night falls, strange and terrifying creatures begin to appear, and reality starts to shift into something far darker.  A third person survival horror game where you can experience the intense story with unique theme of horror.

apps.name: The Unhidden
apps.short_description: A third-person survival horror. You wake up bleeding in a fog-drowned park, remembering nothing. A cabin in the woods is only the start of a long night: graveyards, ruins, caves and what lives beneath them. Scarce ammo, one pistol and your kicks.

apps.name: The Zibbo Show
apps.short_description:
Be the star of the most exciting game show on TV! 

Pick your dice, place your bets, build your combos, and try not to think too hard about what happens when you lose.

apps.name: Their Personal Organizer
apps.short_description: Become a professional home organizer and take on assignments for five female clients. Navigate through piles of clothing and personal belongings to devise an efficient sorting strategy, placing items into the appropriate storage containers.

apps.name: There's a Cat in My PC
apps.short_description: A completely free desktop pet with no payments, ever! Allergic to cats? You can still adopt! Meet 98 one-of-a-kind cats that drop by every day, right on top of your PC windows~

apps.name: This mountain? Got it from my gramps.
apps.short_description: A tactical SRPG about Veil, heir to a fallen lord, who finds an unexplored cave and funds his trek by leasing land to a persecuted sect. Position unique allies and exploit their synergy to conquer the abyss. Demo: to Ch. 9 (~5 hrs). Full game: to Ch. 20.

apps.name: Those We Serve
apps.short_description:
The king is murdered. You are killed too. But death isn't the end.
Relive the same cursed day in a turn-based RPG where perfectly timed parries, dodges, and your decisions determine whether you survive long enough to uncover the truth.

apps.name: Thou Shalt Be Rich
apps.short_description: Interpret the crystal ball's prophecies to find tomorrow's soaring stocks and bet your entire fortune. Survive the madness of skyrocketing and crashing prices to become rich. You need to take revenge on the Fortune Teller Corp that fired you just for a little bit of embezzlement!

apps.name: Three Kingdoms: Devour the World
apps.short_description: A pixel-art idle strategy game set in the Three Kingdoms. Recruit 193 generals, build your team, set formations and assign treatises, then watch them fight through 57 campaigns, from the Yellow Turban Rebellion to the rise of Jin, and on into the Immortal Trial and the Demon Realm.

apps.name: Throne of Rot
apps.short_description:
Throne of Rot is an RPG inspired by King’s Field, but featuring a far more dynamic and brutal physics-based combat system.

Explore dungeons filled with deadly traps, formidable enemies, and countless other dangers as you uncover the origin of a terrible curse and attempt to save a ravaged kingdom.

apps.name: Through the Shatter
apps.short_description: Enter the fractured realm of The Shatter, armed with nothing but your wits. Through The Shatter is an exploration roguelike where you navigate a foggy world full of threats, manage resources, bargain with survivors, cultivate artifacts, and face a looming Void to discover the secrets beneath.

apps.name: Tidy Town
apps.short_description: Tidy Town is a third person cleaning game where you combine everyday objects to tidy up messes and transform spaces. Help Percy lend a paw one room at a time as he saves a friend’s cafe, rebuilds a city park, refreshes an artist’s studio and tidies his way across town and into his community's heart.

apps.name: Tidy Up the Flower Shop: Christmas
apps.short_description: Return to the flower shop for a Christmas tidy-up. Sort 16 festive flower varieties, stock gifts, decorate the tree, and discover the notes left behind.

apps.name: Tidy Up! Uncle Tony's Toy Store
apps.short_description: Tidy a messy toy store by day, then grab your ghost vacuum when midnight strikes! Sort thousands of toys onto the right shelves, vacuum slime, catch cute ghosts and return them to snow globes.

apps.name: Tidying Up the Witch’s Home
apps.short_description: As the young apprentice of a witch who has passed away, tidy her home with a black kitten. Put things in place, wipe, and sweep in this story-driven tidying game, revisiting memories of your mentor and mother and coming to understand the true feelings you never knew she held in life.

apps.name: Tidyspell
apps.short_description: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magic tidying game. Lift and place every object with your wand, catch invisible thieving spirits, fly on your broom, brew potions and step through doors into rooms that are bigger on the inside.

apps.name: Tikka & Kebab
apps.short_description: Run a tiny charcoal grill house in a Kurdish bazaar. Thread the skewers, fan the coals, flip at just the right moment, and serve a cast of colourful regulars before the meat burns. A cozy cooking game where the fire never waits for you.

apps.name: Tilt Siege
apps.short_description: A pinball roguelite about holding a castle. An army marches down the table toward your keep: smash it with the ball, tilt the whole table to dump soldiers into the spikes, and build towers and bumpers between waves.

apps.name: Time Traveler: Divergence
apps.short_description: A systemic medieval RPG where you play a stranded traveler from the future. Rebuild your device, replicate technology, shape a living kingdom through trade, diplomacy or force, and beware: its people — and History itself — will remember what you do.

apps.name: Time Well Spent: Tidy Up the Watch Shop
apps.short_description: An elegant watch shop lies in chaos: over 1,000 watches are scattered across two floors. Read each dial, recognise its brand and its mechanism, and return every piece to its cabinet in this cozy tidy-up game, all while a narrated story about time and life unfolds.

apps.name: Tiny Cauldron
apps.short_description: Run a pixel-art alchemy shop that lives in the corner of your screen. Pick which crowd to serve each cycle, brew potions to match their tastes, send adventurers for rare ingredients, and grow a humble cauldron into a thriving business.

apps.name: Tiny Havoc
apps.short_description: Smash crates as Tin, a tiny salvage robot with a hammer, and free the memories locked inside ten vaults. A handful of crates grows into total havoc of lightning, saw blades and drones in this 5–7 hour incremental game with a real ending.

apps.name: Tiny Trawler
apps.short_description: A cozy top-down fishing game set on the Norwegian coast. Start with a handline on the dock, then work your way up to your own fleet – from a little dinghy to a shrimp trawler. Chase 55 species, follow the rumours, and sail home under lantern light.

apps.name: Tiny Tycoons
apps.short_description: Build and decorate cozy little businesses for a community of hamsters. Design the layout, choose furniture and style, hire staff to keep things running, and unlock new shop types as you grow.

apps.name: TinyBriks
apps.short_description: TinyBriks is a relaxing minimalist plastic brick building game where there are no objectives, no building instructions, no time pressure and no maximizing shareholder value. Make whatever YOU want. Create fantastic dioramas from a plethora of brick styles and colors. Your imagination is the limit.

apps.name: Tippidy Top
apps.short_description: Climb a ridiculous world of obstacles where one bad jump can send you tumbling back down. Go it alone, race your friends, or get roped together and somehow make it to the Tippidy Top.

apps.name: Tipsy Cherry
apps.short_description: Play as Cherry, a hostess who walks into an exclusive club and sees what she shouldn't. A dom and a domme offer her a lucrative position – but first she has to complete their training. Submit or take control. BDSM, voyeurism, and humiliation in a choice-driven adult visual novel.

apps.name: Tirade
apps.short_description: An idle clicker about playing on 16 chessboards at once. Do you know how to play chess? You won't need it here.

apps.name: To Rule... Bavarin
apps.short_description: A deep single-player kingdom management strategy game where you build, govern, and defend a fragile realm. Balance economy, warfare, diplomacy, quests, and exploration as every decision shapes the legacy of your reign.

apps.name: Toe-tal War
apps.short_description: TOE-TAL WAR is a platformer where you kill people with your foot smell. Run and jump to make your feet smelly, change your shoes and socks to control the smell — then get close to enemies and stink them to death.

apps.name: Toil & Trubble
apps.short_description:
Herbs locate, tonics make, 
So gas deflates, and aches abate.

Brew up some mischief in a witchy life sim with a small but troublesome difference.  

To keep the people of The Nook happy and healthy, Mistress Toil needs to train a young, easily-distracted pig to find magical ingredients.

apps.name: Tollmire
apps.short_description: A dice roguelike in the bog. The witch demands eight tolls, each steeper than the last — you pay in rolls: points times mult. Between tolls you forge special faces onto your dice and gather talismans.

apps.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
apps.short_description: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

apps.name: Tonari Days: Your Desktop Companion
apps.short_description: A desktop companion and study buddy who works right beside you. Tonari runs a Pomodoro focus timer with you, keeps your to-dos and calendar, plays lo-fi music and ambient sounds, and reads your screen aloud. With voice recognition, she also opens apps, sets the volume and more on your PC.

apps.name: Too Big To Fail
apps.short_description: Welcome to the firm. You and your friends get the worst desks in the building and one account between you. Trade, deal, cheat, invest, gamble. The market was made to be exploited. Do well and the firm will be yours, then the world, eventually.

apps.name: Topdeck Automat
apps.short_description: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself! Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.

apps.name: Torchview
apps.short_description: It's the last night of the season at Torchview Summer Camp. Most of the campers and counselors have gone home. Cait and her friends are excited to have one last night together, until an unspeakable nightmare unfolds before them.

apps.name: torpak
apps.short_description: Claim a hex kingdom one roll at a time. Spend your die on connected land, settle wars by opposed rolls, and buy cards that bend the rules. A turn-based land-grab for 2–6 players: online over Steam, or at your own table against the AI.

apps.name: Tossdown
apps.short_description: Run, jump and dash through chaos, dodging hazards and enemies as you deliver packages. Fight back with wacky power-ups and choose from a variety of perks to improve your chances of survival. It’s Crazy taxi meets Jet Set Radio!

apps.name: Total Physics
apps.short_description: Physics study app: 65 topics, 5,616 practice items, lessons, flashcards and mock exams. Limelight: A Physics puzzle game in a theatre of illusions.

apps.name: Totally Safe Moon Project
apps.short_description: BREAKING NEWS! A giant asteroid is about to wipe out Earth, and your only escape is the Moon! Grab anything you can find, stack it high, and build your way to safety, solo or with up to 3 friends! Think Only Up, but YOU'RE the architect. What could possibly go wrong?

apps.name: Trafficity
apps.short_description: A city builder focused on traffic. Build out your city with gridless road tools. Fix traffic jams with roundabouts, fully-customizable traffic lights, and sprawling highway interchanges. Keep traffic flowing as you expand to a vast metropolis.

apps.name: Tree Wreckers
apps.short_description: Best with friends. A 1–4 player online co-op physics comedy about taking trees down without wrecking what's under them. Climb it, top it, rope the limbs down piece by piece, or notch it and yell TIMBER. Every job ends on an itemized invoice with a name next to each piece of damage.

apps.name: TrenchFin
apps.short_description: TrenchFin is a 3rd person behind the character 3D platformer melee combat game that follows Asha Trenchfin, an anglerfish on a mission to reach the top of a spiraling reef to save the magic coral tree from a terrifying Leviathan by using her light to reveal invisible platforms and enemies.

apps.name: Triad of Victory
apps.short_description: Turn the world’s most familiar hand game into an addictive strategy adventure. Combine skills, gear, and progression choices—every decision can change the course of a run.

apps.name: Trillionaire Mercenaries of 21XX
apps.short_description: In 21XX, humanity clings to the remains of a cyberpunk world consumed by the ocean. As corporations fight for what's left, you'll work as a mercenary for the ultra-rich, carrying out covert operations in a third-person stealth adventure that tips the balance of global power.

apps.name: Troubleshooting
apps.short_description: chaotic FPS roguelite inside your old family computer! Blast corrupt files, grab XP, stack weird upgrades, and place desktop junk to shape the arena as the system falls apart in increasingly stupid ways.

apps.name: Truth Scrapper
apps.short_description: You have a case to solve, your memories reset each day, and two mysterious guides are vying for your attention– who will you decide to remember, and who will you decide to push aside…?

apps.name: Trutzburg
apps.short_description: Defend the Trutzburg from endless slime hordes. Build, upgrade and grow stronger with every run — solo or in 2-player online co-op.

apps.name: Tuny and Volty
apps.short_description: The power is out and the forest has gone silent. Plug Volty the battery into Tuny the radio and the music plays, sending hedgehogs rolling, rabbits dashing and owls hooting. A cozy puzzle game with 50 clever levels and charming vector art.

apps.name: Turf Wars: Slumika
apps.short_description: Build a crew and run the streets of a generated city in the country of Slumíka. Cook and deal, fight rival gangs, dodge police heat, buy houses and stash your goods in this top-down crime sim. Every new game is a new city.

apps.name: Turrákata
apps.short_description: Hustle is an open-world survival-crafting game and top-down shooter set on a tiny planet. You're a dude hunting down the guy who stole your red cap, exposing your ugly, putrid, bald head. Shoot, gather, craft, build, expand your map, dodge bullets and fight bosses to seek revenge.

apps.name: Um Hummels willen
apps.short_description: You are Brumhilde von Hummelbommel. You wake up alone in February: find a hole in the ground, gather pollen and nectar, raise your daughters and build your nest. Nine months against wasps, birds, storms and heat. In November only one thing counts: is your colony still standing?

apps.name: Unabandoned
apps.short_description: An online co-op horror game for 1 to 4 players. Find and destroy cursed objects to weaken the ghost before dispatching it for good. Whether exploring alone or with friends, something menacing could be lurking behind every door you unlock, so remember to bring a flashlight and don’t let it get you.

apps.name: Uncanny Diary
apps.short_description: Uncanny Diary is a narrative-driven investigative dungeon crawler set in a village in Japan. Investigate the disappearance of Ren Akiyama's twin brother by gathering clues during the day, and fight monsters at night to get the help of a mysterious supernatural diary.

apps.name: Uncatalogued
apps.short_description: Take one oil lamp into an underground library that rearranges itself every night. Your items are reclaimed when the light goes out — only what you catalogue stays. A first-person roguelite of reading, deduction, and burning oil, in handheld-sized retro 3D.

apps.name: UNCODED HEART
apps.short_description: UNCODED HEART — A visual novel set in 2049. Investigate digital crimes, expose fakes, uncover a cyberterrorist conspiracy, and build relationships with six heroines and a mysterious character. Who will you trust — humans or artificial intelligence?

apps.name: Undead Night Crew
apps.short_description: You are a manager at the Undead Cleaning Services. Your only job is to build up a crew of auto attacking followers to clean up thousands of the undead. Jump in online with friends and maximize wild synergies! Sign contracts, complete missions, get money, get stronger, do it again!

apps.name: Under the Aurora
apps.short_description: A mystery quest exploring life, death, and the path to return.

apps.name: Unended
apps.short_description: Scavenge and survive across strange biomes and other dimensions in a smooth, fully destructible world. Dig anywhere, build a base, tame creatures, and possess them to fly, swim, or burrow. Challenge its ruling lords alone or with other players online.

apps.name: Unpatched
apps.short_description: "Unpatched" is an action RPG where you're a tester trapped in the body of an undead assassin inside your own MMORPG. Your boss is in danger. Heroes are charging in - and your weapons are blades and knowledge of bugs that were never meant to exist.

apps.name: Until the Last Machine
apps.short_description: Build a sprawling base, power it with energy and alloy, and send hundreds of mechs, tanks and jets into one massive battle. Hide behind shield domes, research new technology, and when the time comes, launch the nukes. A sci-fi RTS fought until the last machine.

apps.name: Up, Up! Neon Stairs
apps.short_description: Two buttons: climb, or turn and climb. One wrong press and you fall. A neon stair-climbing game of pure focus — rise from the city through the sky and space, all the way to the sun. Play 1v1, 4-player races with items, 2v2 or co-op online, plus a new daily course every day. Free to play.

apps.name: Uphill Both Ways
apps.short_description: Two penguins, one snowball. Balance on top of it together and steer it down a mountain of six wild worlds as it grows, melts and sends you flying. Then ride it all the way back up. A co-op physics comedy for two, online or on one PC.

apps.name: UpperCart
apps.short_description: UpperCart is a chaotic physics-based arena brawler where toy cars roll out of the drawer and fight for bedroom glory, solo or with up to 6 players. Punch, crash, wreck the other toys, and stay in one piece before the kid’s hand cleans up the mess.

apps.name: USB Unemployment Speedrun Behavior
apps.short_description: Plug in as many USBs as you can!

apps.name: VALD in EUROPA
apps.short_description: Unite Europe in 50 turns. Over 30 nations and lands, over 100 characters. Actions each turn are limited — what you put off is the strategy. Take a country and judge its queen: execute, recruit, or release. 7 rivals court the princesses you haven't won yet. 4 routes. 1,000+ watercolour-style images.

apps.name: VALTERION: THE LOST EARTH
apps.short_description: VALTERION: THE LOST EARTH is a sci-fi colony-building strategy game. Lead 50 survivors on Elyra, build a thriving colony, develop its economy and research, return to the stars, and search for the lost path back to Earth.
