apps.name: Vampire Must Die: Chain Divine
apps.short_description: Inscribe Sigils and defend the Crystal from vampire hordes in this pixel-art tower defense roguelite. Launch enemies skyward, blast them with Holy Fire Barrels, and smash them into each other for chain reactions. Pick the best upgrades from ever-changing choices, or fight with your own weapons.

apps.name: Varketh’s Prison
apps.short_description: Descend into an old school, dark fantasy dungeon crawler. Featuring real time combat, procedurally generated floors, powerful loot, lore and challenging bosses. Choose from three unique classes, develop your build, and uncover the secrets hidden within!

apps.name: Vast Mines
apps.short_description: A simple but addictive isometric mining game, get upgrades, forge pickaxes, and travel deeper into the mines.

apps.name: Vehicle Game
apps.short_description: It is a game where you gather resources, secure food, and build structures to survive to the very end.

apps.name: Veinrider
apps.short_description:
Veinrider is a scifi incremental game about traversing alien caves and escaping a strange planet.
Fly, collect and upgrade your gravity-flipping craft to break deeper, faster and stronger!

apps.name: Vending Park: Sort & Stock
apps.short_description: Vending Park: Sort & Stock is a cozy organizing game where you sort over 1,000 scattered products and put them back into their correct vending machines. Unlock helpful abilities, tidy up at your own pace, and enjoy the satisfaction of restoring order to a messy vending park!

apps.name: Verdant Requiem
apps.short_description:
“SRPG in Search of Balance"
On a continent where three nations’ ideals clash, what will you choose, and what will you protect? Verdant Requiem is a SRPG about a war for balance beyond good and evil, featuring detailed 2D maps, branching storylines, resource management, and elemental balance.

apps.name: Very Tasty Story
apps.short_description: Open a restaurant in an ancient city, a steppe settlement or a metropolis. Listen to your customers' stories and learn what they like. Gather local ingredients to recreate traditional dishes or invent new ones. The same ingredients can become hundreds of different dishes—there is no fixed answer!

apps.name: Victor's Video Vault
apps.short_description: It's 1995. The video store is alive. When the last customer leaves, the final rental rewrites reality.

apps.name: Video Game Store: Tidy Up
apps.short_description: Sort 3,000 scattered pieces in a cozy retro video game store. Clean discs and manuals, rebuild 1,000 games and stock the shelves. Serve customers, pack orders, unlock helpful upgrades and hire staff to turn complete chaos into a thriving shop.

apps.name: VITA: Observa.Momento.Adservo.
apps.short_description: VITA is a third-person exploration game centered on observation, discovery, and the relationship between mother nature and human nature. You play as VITA-UNIT-05, an autonomous Ecological Observation Unit that awakens on an unfamiliar Earth.

apps.name: VOCABLUFF
apps.short_description: VOCABLUFF is an online social deduction game for 3–8 players built around words, bluffing, hidden roles, and voice chat. Read the room, deceive your friends, expose the liar, and jump into fast rounds inside a lively first-person bar.

apps.name: Void Havoc
apps.short_description: In this sci-fi action/strategy game, you're the only trump card left to stop the Contingency in their destructive march. Man your ship, build your arsenal and blow away the waves sent to stop you in your tracks.

apps.name: Volcaldera Ashfall
apps.short_description: James is a human living in a world populated by colorful dinosaur people. The problem is, dinosaurs have teeth. They have claws. They're usually not afraid to use them carelessly. James is the only one that seems to have a problem with this, but he finds himself living in a house with four of them.

apps.name: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed
apps.short_description: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is a spectacular remaster of the original remake of the unreleased action-platformer starring the most famous video game mascot of all time.

apps.name: Voyager III
apps.short_description: Robert, a 25 year-old intern at the biggest name in Space Exploration, is tasked with managing the Voyager III, an experimental probe that can warp to distant stars and worlds in the name of exploration. But as the months pass, Robert begins discovering horrors he wasn't meant to see.

apps.name: Vroom Room
apps.short_description: The ultimate cozy idle multiplayer toybox. Collect dozens of toys, watch them drive and stunt around in handcrafted 3D physics-based spaces, then jump in and take the wheel whenever you like. Embrace the joy of discovery as you chill with friends, hunt for secrets and unlock rare toys.

apps.name: Waifu Desire
apps.short_description: Move all parts to form the complete image.

apps.name: Wake Protocol
apps.short_description: An atmospheric first-person sci-fi survival mystery. Maintain a failing colony ship, investigate its buried history, and speak naturally with CORA, the AI keeping you alive. Between you and a distant world lie years of silence—and 1,500 lives.

apps.name: Walk-In: Fold It Together
apps.short_description: Three thousand pieces of clothing just hit the floor. Iron out every crease, fold each one by hand, and file it back where it belongs. A cosy first-person tidying game that slowly automates your own ritual. Invite some friends to help, up to 8 players!

apps.name: Walkers
apps.short_description: Walkers is an open-world zombie survival game with advanced base building and NPC systems. Scavenge, craft, and loot across a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Recruit survivors from the streets, assign them as workers, guards, or companions.

apps.name: Wall Brawl
apps.short_description: Hold the line! Team up in this tactical multiplayer castle‑brawler where players raise fortresses, set up defenses, and smash through enemy strongholds with physics‑driven destruction. Heroic last stands! Questionable tactics! Bricks moving at unsafe speeds!

apps.name: Wardens of the Deep
apps.short_description: Dig a persistant dungeon out of living rock, raise its halls, train and arm Host to guard them. Then step into any creature in first person, lead your champion down the stairs and delve into a Deep with no bottom — where every floor is worse than the last.

apps.name: Warlocks Nexus
apps.short_description: In Warlocks Nexus, your medieval realm faces an existential threat: an invasion from beyond. This isn't just about survival; it's about adaptation. Explore a fully destructible, voxel world, scavenge for resources, and craft your way through  incursions.

apps.name: Warm Worm: Together
apps.short_description: A co-op puzzle game for two tiny worms. Split and reunite your bodies, plan your routes together, and find a way through the garden. Play locally or with Steam Remote Play Together.

apps.name: Warrior Quest
apps.short_description:
What would you say to a goblin if you could speak to it in your own words? Bribe it, lie to it, threaten it... or just chop its head off. Warrior Quest is an old-school dark-fantasy dungeon crawler where you can fight, sneak, bluff, or bargain your way through. 
Whatever you do, roll well!

apps.name: Watermellionaire
apps.short_description: Watermellionaire is a dark battle royale fruit-matching game. Pitted against other employees, you compete to become the Most Valuable Packer (MVP) - those who fail are fired. Faced with nothing but a box, some fruit and a guard watching your every move, only one person can come out on top.

apps.name: Way Too Many Eggs
apps.short_description: Way Too Many Eggs is an incremental game about turning a tiny chicken farm into egg-filled chaos. Collect eggs, grow your flock, hire helpers, crack giant eggs and unlock permanent upgrades in the skill tree!

apps.name: Waymaker
apps.short_description: Fly a second-hand ship alone past the edge of the charted stars. Dive from orbit through the clouds of a world nobody has named, land anywhere and step out of the airlock. Chart its rivers, caves and species, name it, claim it… or go too far to ever come back.

apps.name: We need more boiler
apps.short_description: Intercept meteors, gather resources, and keep the boilers running in a polluted Antarctica. Upgrade your base and grow a penguin civilization in this desktop idle game that runs while you do other things.

apps.name: What Killed Rachel
apps.short_description:
A story-driven psychological horror that chases the truth behind Rachel's death. 
As you follow scattered memories, you slowly come face to face with the reality of the tragedy.
Blaming someone is easy.
But answering what truly killed her is not.

apps.name: When Life Gives You Lemons
apps.short_description: Run a lemonade stand with or against 3 of your friends! Cooperate or sabotage each other while you, mix ingredients, craft the perfect recipe, squeeze fresh juice, and keep your customers happy. Order fruits and equipment, unlock upgrades and grow your stand into the ultimate business empire.

apps.name: Who Inked Me?
apps.short_description: Sumo wrestlers aren't allowed tattoos. So they drink. Whoever passes out gets tattooed by his friends, then wakes up and has to guess who did it. Guess wrong and it stays on him. An online party game for 4–6 players, starring your own face.

apps.name: Why V Got AKs?
apps.short_description:
No voting. No meetings. Everyone has the power to execute!
Expose the impostors, protect your crew, and survive in this 4-8 player social deduction game. Enforce justice with your multi-mode AK-47. Pure chaos with built-in proximity voice! 🔊💥

apps.name: Wildegrove
apps.short_description:
Wildegrove is a fast-paced roguelike isometric bullet hell where you wield powerful spells as a gnome chosen by the gods.
Battle the relentless waves of enemies, collect runes that compliment your playstyle, and upgrade your favorite spells to unleash devastating blows to save Wildegrove!

apps.name: Wildmark
apps.short_description: A cozy idle RPG in an illustrated woodland. Chop, forage, fish, mine, craft and cook through ten gentle skills as the seasons turn, raise a homestead building by building, and defend the wilds on patrol.

apps.name: WingsSimulations Flight Simulator 2027
apps.short_description: Fly anywhere on Earth with realistic weather, detailed aircraft, and thousands of airports. Design your own planes, tackle landing challenges, and experience full-fidelity flight simulation without the usual performance cost.

apps.name: With A Heavy Heart
apps.short_description: Control a fragile balloon lifting a weary soul through the beautiful, surreal maze of his dying memories. A cozy but deeply emotional 2D platformer about what it means to hold on 💙

apps.name: Wizalign
apps.short_description: A match-3 adventure RPG where every action happens on the puzzle board. Battle monsters, collect keys, discover powerful dungeon items, manage health and shields, and defeat bosses as you explore overworlds and dungeons inspired by classic adventure games.

apps.name: Wizard Towers
apps.short_description: Upgrade your base, strengthen your waves, and bring down enemy towers. In this fantasy lane strategy game, armies fight automatically while you decide how to spend your gold, which lane to reinforce, and when to cast a decisive spell. Compete in online matches for 2–4 players.

apps.name: Wok the Deck
apps.short_description: Serve up sushi, hotpot and BBQ in a restaurant roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit animal staff, pair them with utensils, and season your cards to beat sales targets with limited plays and discards. Choose your route through shops, events and three chapters of boss challenges.

apps.name: Woks & Works
apps.short_description: Build and automate your restaurant empire. Manage chefs, customers, supplies, and production chains in a living food economy.

apps.name: X-Ninja
apps.short_description: Take control of X and fight your way through 42 VERY challenging levels! Every enemy on the screen must be defeated before you can escape, but the time limits are tight, so don't hang about! If you really want to push it, try grabbing a gem before making your exit

apps.name: Xhaust
apps.short_description: Xhaust is a weaponized vehicular combat game. Brawl in the arena, wreak havoc on the roads! Go solo or battle friends and bots in multiplayer (split-screen and online).

apps.name: Xmas Squad
apps.short_description: Physics co-op comedy for up to 4 players: deliver presents, steal cookies and save your friends from monsters. One more house and we're outta here. Promise.

apps.name: YOU
apps.short_description: Wander through the mysterious forests surrounding you; explore places you would never otherwise venture into. Discover interesting things and things that might make you rethink the decisions you’ve made regarding him.

apps.name: Young Mysteries: The Secret of the Old Clock (1930)
apps.short_description: River Heights, 1930. Josiah Crowley promised to provide for those who had been good to him, then died, and the snobbish Tophams got everything. A sixteen-year-old with a blue roadster and no patience for snobs goes looking for a missing will, in a branching mystery from the original 1930 novel.

apps.name: Your party died again
apps.short_description: Fight through evil monsters and demons in this Incremental RPG. Collect loot, unlock upgrades and recruit party members to destroy the Demon King. Use abilities strategically or set them to autocast and enjoy the ride.

apps.name: Zephyr's World
apps.short_description: Meet Zephyr, a curious little bird powered by AI running locally on your computer. Leave him notes, explore his town, and watch him discover hobbies, make friends, build games, and create videos. A cozy companion game about a little bird with a life of his own.

apps.name: Zoe's Game
apps.short_description: Escape from a mansion full of puzzles, traps and characters who may not be what they seem! Can you survive to this deadly birthday party?

apps.name: Zombie Motel 96
apps.short_description: Command a rooftop squad with one aim circle in this incremental zombie game. Collect loot in short battles to grow your squad, develop weapons and buy permanent upgrades. Find artifacts in battle. Your outpost gathers materials between fights.

apps.name: ZombieTrain
apps.short_description: Zombie Train is a roguelite survival defense game. Fight endless zombie hordes, defend your base camp, and cooperate or compete with other survivors. Combine weapons and cards to build your ultimate armored train. Every choice matters!

apps.name: Zoo Peaks : Riders
apps.short_description: Zoo Peaks: Riders is an arcade snowboarding game: race six rivals or ride freestyle for score. Every trick fills your boost meter. Max it out to unlock Uber tricks, then land five Ubers in one run and your boost lasts all the way to the finish. Solo or two-player split-screen.

apps.name: Zumba - The Dragon's Marble Trial
apps.short_description: The dragon’s marbles are rolling—only you can stop them! In Zumba – The Dragon’s Marble Trial, shoot, match, and explode marbles before they reach the end. Unleash draconic power-ups, and blaze through mythical worlds. Grab your fire-breath and let the marble-matching magic begin!

apps.name: ZX Allstar Holdem
apps.short_description: 18+ erotic No-Limit Hold'em. Bust the heroines and watch them happily reveal their secret rewards. Sponsor them, unmask the Dealers, collect every story.

apps.name: Špatná noc
apps.short_description: A very short horror game featuring a few choices. Experience an unusual evening with Petr, play several minigames, and find out if you will survive.

apps.name: いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -
apps.short_description: 『いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -』は、探索するほど老いていく、孤島館ホラーADV。若さを奪う館の真相を暴き、偽装工作で敵を欺き、崩れゆく島から脱出せよ。

apps.name: がむしゃらギルド-Scrappy Guild-
apps.short_description:
Team up with your friends, pool your wisdom, and take on the Demon King with the ultimate deck.
Gamashira Guild is a cooperative deck-building roguelike where discussing strategies with friends is the key to victory.
Let’s all team up and take down the Demon King!

apps.name: アスクギア リブースト
apps.short_description: A new, straightforward RPG! Hot scenarios and battles that go right to the heart of JRPGs. For those of you who still feel your youth in the RPGs of the PS1 and PS2 generations, this is the game for you.

apps.name: キメキャワ♥限界ビートちゃん
apps.short_description:
Smash the cute monsters with fun!
This is a rhythm game with easy controls!

apps.name: コロコロフレンズ
apps.short_description:
Roll, stick, and carry everything.
"Coro-coro Friends" is a chaotic physics puzzle action game where you roll a sphere, cling to objects, and solve challenges in creative ways.
Play solo or with a friend—cooperate or sabotage your way to the goal.

apps.name: ソフトクリーム、まだ巻けます。
apps.short_description: Just one more swirl. Move the cone with your mouse and build the tallest soft serve you can in this small 3D game. Finish before it falls and beat your own record. How high will you dare to go? Japanese interface only.

apps.name: プライマリ・ブルーム
apps.short_description: 高度なAI技術の発展により、大きく変化した世界。主人公のザニアはただ一人、人の手から生み出された植物たちを取り戻すため、研究を続けています。部屋で植物を育て、咲いた花をSNSで世界に広めていく、ドット絵・横スクロールのSF×ガーデンシミュレーションです。

apps.name: 一念万剑
apps.short_description: Begin with one flying sword in this cultivation-themed survivor roguelite. Combine flying, heavy and orbiting blades, dash through swarms, and unleash a storm of swords. Claim elite caches, awaken your build, and carry earned progress into your next run.

apps.name: 七罪之淵
apps.short_description: Harold, a young man full of ideals, will struggle in a world full of malice. Through countless choices and sacrifices, he will gradually uncover the buried truth and face various different endings.

apps.name: 三国志-乱世如梦
apps.short_description: SanChaosDream is a role-playing strategy game set in war-torn China in 194 CE. Play as a warlord, loyal officer, or wandering free spirit across a vast Han-era map, governing cities, recruiting heroes, marching to war, and shaping your own life in the age of chaos.

apps.name: 下凡
apps.short_description: 《下凡》是一款俯视角角色扮演模拟经营游戏。怀揣憧憬，你告别故土踏入喧嚣陌生的大城。前路万千，没有唯一的活法：务工谋生、寻玉赌石、卜算吉凶、赶海远航，在市井烟火与机缘变数里，邂逅羁绊，书写属于你的人间际遇。

apps.name: 东方形启舞
apps.short_description: A 2D Touhou Project fan action game set in the Bamboo Forest of the Lost. Play as Fujiwara no Mokou, Kirisame Marisa, or Izayoi Sakuya, combine melee combat with spell card builds across node-based runs, and face challenging boss duels.

apps.name: 中国球王之路
apps.short_description: Shanghai, 1994. A young footballer refuses to quit after losing his place. Move one player as AI teams play around you, pause to choose key actions, and seek another trial through local jobs, 3v3 matches and ten club training games.

apps.name: 乐铲小队
apps.short_description: Joy Loader Crew is a cozy 1-4 player co-op construction party game. Drive loaders and bulldozers to build sites and complete disaster rescue missions. Cute cartoon graphics and simple controls suit family and friend parties. Realistic physics create hilarious crashing moments. Come drive loaders!

apps.name: 乱世弈将
apps.short_description: Lead the heroes of the Three Kingdoms against an invading Abyss in this roguelite strategy game. Build powerful teams, plan formations, combine heroes, equipment, treasures, and Seals, explore changing maps, and overcome bosses with unique mechanics.

apps.name: 余烬列车 - Ember Express
apps.short_description: Ember Express is a sci-fi light yuri narrative adventure. Step into the role of a junior researcher at megacorporation COSMIC, uncover the truth behind the "Ember" incident, and rekindle a buried memory with your mysterious superior.

apps.name: 你好！我们还有场恋爱没谈2
apps.short_description: 2030: AI companions reshape romance. As an emotion engineer with missing memories, you awaken in a tangled love affair. A commanding boss, an awakened AI, an anti-AI rebel, and a mysterious system enter your life. Each choice rewrites fate. Is algorithmic love still love?

apps.name: 升学模拟器
apps.short_description: This is a strategy card game that simulates the modern education system's pathway to higher education.

apps.name: 古今東西ダービー
apps.short_description: Horse racing meets Kokontozai, the Japanese party game of naming things in a category! Name your racehorse to fit the category, and the name alone decides its stats. Then watch a 3D race where the commentator calls your horse by name. A quick party game for 1 to 8 players.

apps.name: 四季餐厅
apps.short_description: Four Seasons Restaurant "is a restaurant management game that combines classic simulation management with a warm and healing art style. Whether you're reliving the classic joys of the past or experiencing the refreshing gameplay of the four seasons, this place will be your culinary sanctuary.

apps.name: 回溯2035
apps.short_description:
You wake up in the laboratory and notice someone approaching you. He walks to the bedside and says, "Welcome to the Spacetime Laboratory.",
Take you to the time machine and say: This is the time machine you control. You need to go to different timelines to bring back upgrade parts

apps.name: 妹调教日记
apps.short_description: ○学生の生意気な妹を調教するADVゲームがスチームで高画質化！

apps.name: 孤独勇者之旅
apps.short_description: A retro pixel-style JRPG. Centuries ago, Academy, Church and Knights sealed the Demon Clan in another dimension. As generations passed, the ancient seal weakened, unleashing monsters once more. The new-generation factions dispatched their marginal figures to address crises symptomatically.
developers: Beijing Mayfly & Grain Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Beijing Mayfly & Grain Technology Co., Ltd.

apps.name: 它说山雨欲来
apps.short_description:
50+ endings! 
A purely fictional fantasy world!
Comedy script, dark plot — and the endings? Pitch-black.
Swept into a storm, you need a boss. The revolutionary, the merchant, or the cult leader? Your pick unlocks different paths. You're a cheater with buffs — you'll survive. Go!

apps.name: 将棋
apps.short_description: Play shogi in a peaceful ink-wash setting. Face the computer or a friend on the same device, learn promotions and drops through interactive lessons, practice tactics, and import your own game records for move-by-move review.

apps.name: 小年的异世界幻想
apps.short_description: A side-scrolling survival-builder merging modern industry and martial arts. Explore a spore-ravaged world: gather resources, build shelters, develop tech to craft guns and mechs, or master melee combat. Farm, tame creatures, and battle terrifying mutants to survive.

apps.name: 幻兽栏：桌面咕咕
apps.short_description: A cozy desktop idle game with two pet species: a mining duck and a leaf-topped mushroom. Sweep up crystals and timber, sell resources, feed your helpers, and combine duck talents. Adjust music and desktop settings to suit your day.

apps.name: 庭小人の庭
apps.short_description: The Garden of the Garden Gnomes is a deck-building roguelike where you grow plants in your garden and battle with them. Deeply blending deck-building with tactical RPG strategy, plant seeds, cultivate your plants, and fight enemies with the power of the cards you've nurtured.

apps.name: 异世问道
apps.short_description: An open-world xianxia RPG. Cultivate techniques, break through realms, collect affix equipment. Every NPC has a will of their own — they trade, team up, duel, and remember your every deed. A marketplace shared by players and NPCs, plus thrilling siege defenses. Your legend begins now.

apps.name: 弾幕の戦乙女 -Barrage of Valhalla-
apps.short_description: A bullet-hell shoot 'em up meets hack-and-slash RPG. Become a valkyrie, weave through neon barrages under a sky of iron, hunt loot, forge gear, and fish, farm, cook between sorties. Can't dodge? Grind through it. Can? Chase top ranks. No stamina, no pay-to-win — buy once, play it all.

apps.name: 彈幕憶星環 ~ Danmaku Surround Starry Sky
apps.short_description: 「彈幕憶星環 ~ Danmaku Surround Starry Sky」is a small-scale bullet hell shoot 'em up featuring simplified mechanics.  forming an unnatural starry sky at high altitude that was visible to the naked eye. As a spatial administrator, Mekai sets off to investigate in accordance with her duty,

apps.name: 念念老汤
apps.short_description: Along the snack street by the Naihe Bridge, The protagonist crafts the "final meal" for spirits on the brink of rebirth: each pot of savory spicy hot pot not only satiates their hunger, but also dissolves the obsessions tied to their past-life memories.

apps.name: 我不加班 - I Don't Do Overtime
apps.short_description: Your coworkers won't let you clock out. Fight your way from rush hour to your company's cosmic HQ in this darkly comic FPS. Bullets don't hurt coworkers directly—use knockback to slam them into obstacles! Survive absurd encounters, uncover corporate secrets, and get home without overtime.

apps.name: 挂机伏魔录
apps.short_description: Gather a party of wandering heroes and follow a path of cultivation and demon slaying. Build your team with combat styles, talents, manuals and equipment, then take on haunted mountain trails, secret-realm bosses and an endless tower in this single-player Chinese fantasy idle RPG.

apps.name: 故地春寻
apps.short_description:
“桥本可以连接一切，过去与未来，繁荣与衰败...可...断掉的桥呢？”
这是一款由新人制作团队weave为大家带来的galgame。在本游戏中，玩家将作为男主角“辛诚”，与本作女主角——桥神“古桥”相遇。玩家可以在游戏中通过选择不同选项触发不同剧情，沉浸式体验与古桥在一起的日常，并通过点击屏幕浏览文本，欣赏配音，鉴赏插画cg，与古桥在平凡的每日中加深了解，相互理解，并一起开启一段令人激动的寻找之旅，寻找那些遗忘的，隐藏的事物。
希望大家可以在我们的游戏中获得欢乐，同时也欢迎大家向我们提出不足。
欢迎大家来体验。

apps.name: 敲叽
apps.short_description: Turn everyday typing into a cozy desktop adventure! Watch a little monk bird tap away as you work, earn coins, open treasure chests, and unlock charming outfits. Upgrade your tapping abilities, then bring your earnings home to care for an adorable bird companion.

apps.name: 时空流亡：重庆1941
apps.short_description: Please note: This game is available in Simplified Chinese only. No English localization is available at this time.

apps.name: 木鱼敲敲有限公司
apps.short_description: With just a tap of your fingers, you can raise small woodfish on your desktop Seven adorable and quirky little woodfish are at your beck and call. They'll become your work (slack-off) buddies, keeping you company through day and night. Happy or not, just give their little heads a knock!

apps.name: 株式会社みなみ
apps.short_description: Kasumi, a maid café waitress in Akihabara, inherits her late father's safety-pin factory. Make pins, ship them, upgrade wacky machines, retool for global trends, and join her mom and sisters in chasing No.1 world share and a planet of safety pins. A pixel-art incremental factory comedy.

apps.name: 桥牌
apps.short_description: Enjoy classic contract bridge on a clean, pixel-styled table. Practice offline with three AI difficulty settings, or invite friends with a four-digit room code. Play through bidding, dummy and all 13 tricks, with customizable backgrounds and card backs.

apps.name: 橙子妹妹
apps.short_description: Orangie is a 3D AI desktop companion for RPGs! She watches your gameplay, follows the story, remembers past adventures, and chats with you on her own. Explore, laugh, and share every moment together!

apps.name: 江南百味铺
apps.short_description: Run a cozy restaurant in a Jiangnan water town. Cook scallion pancakes, brew tea, and assemble dishes to match each customer's order. Earn coins, upgrade your kitchen, unlock new restaurants, and aim for three stars as the morning rush picks up.

apps.name: 池田バルブ株式会社
apps.short_description: Japan, 2016. In your sixth year at Ikeda Valve Co., Ltd., work in sales and guide newcomer Miura through a year at a mid-sized manufacturer with just under 300 employees. Four endings.

apps.name: 沉渊归航 Escape The Abyss
apps.short_description: Escape The Abyss is a Lovecraftian deep-sea extraction game. Oxygen is your timer, and every dive is a gamble: scavenge sunken ruins, upgrade your submarine and gear, and get out before the horrors get you or your air runs out. Humanity's last hope is down there.

apps.name: 烽烟三国/Warfires of the Three Kingdoms
apps.short_description: Warfires of the Three Kingdoms is a turn-based strategy game set in the Three Kingdoms era. Build teams from Heroes, Skills, and Formations, exploit unit counters, climb the Tower with three parties, collect Equipment, and adapt your tactics to each enemy lineup.

apps.name: 爱幽的密室
apps.short_description: Locked-room mystery meets sweet romance in this immersive visual novel! Solve tricky chamber puzzles and meet lively girls. Dynamic sprites, multiple endings shaped by your choices. Want more? The official anime adaptation is on Crunchyroll. Search X&Y for extra stories!

apps.name: 牛丼店シミュレーター
apps.short_description: Made by someone with nearly 10 years in a gyudon (beef bowl) shop. A first-person shop sim where you wash rice, simmer beef, plate bowls, juggle IH burners and ring up orders like the real job. Run out of rice and the shop closes. Shout through the lunch rush solo or with up to 4 friends online.

apps.name: 疾风群侠传
apps.short_description: 《疾风群侠传》是一款武侠题材的多周目养成Roguelike游戏。在不断推进的江湖岁月中，自由修炼武学，加入风栖谷或凌霄门，踏上截然不同的门派道路。邂逅多位性格各异的红颜，在随机见闻、奇遇抉择与生死战斗中积累实力，探寻身世之谜，决定正邪立场，谱写独属于你的侠客传奇。

apps.name: 白线
apps.short_description: 《Hakusen》is a campus and racing-themed romance visual novel developed by PlanC. Told from the perspective of the protagonist, Jiang Yao, the story chronicles his journey of mutual growth alongside the heroines as they join hands to make their youth shine with a unique brilliance.

apps.name: 碧曦影韵2(Pixi Vibe2)
apps.short_description: "Pixi Vibe2" is a single-player casual game of the pinball genre. Players need to use the mouse to control the direction and strength of the ball's launch, bouncing it off bricks of different shapes to reach the end of each randomly generated level.

apps.name: 箭在人在
apps.short_description: Rocket Together is a chaotic rocket-launch co-op game for 1–4 players. Team up with friends to assemble the rocket during the launch countdown. Patch the hull and make sure everyone boards safely. Once you reach orbit, work together to complete orbital missions. Grab your friends and blast off!

apps.name: 红楼梦：林黛玉与北静王
apps.short_description: 在大观园的繁华与幻境之间，跟随失忆的贾宝玉，找回被掩埋的记忆，并在一次次抉择中改写众人的命运。

apps.name: 组长！怨念请查收！

apps.name: 象棋

apps.name: 贪吃鸡
apps.short_description: You play as a mother hen, and your main job is to protect the chicks. Eat rice, hatch chicks, and dodge predators to keep your chick squad growing.

apps.name: 迷失小镇

Fight mutant hordes, earn XP, unlock random skills and upgrades, and build unique combat styles. Each run changes; death restarts. Find the escape route and uncover the town's secret.

A sudden downpour turns everyone caught in the rain into frogs. 
Now I’m surrounded by frogs, and I can’t tell my teachers from my classmates.
